items.title: Author Correction: Large recoverable elastic energy in chiral metamaterials via twist buckling
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11189-w Author Correction: Large recoverable elastic energy in chiral metamaterials via twist buckling
items.authors: Xin Fang

items.title: Chiral oxazolidinones via biocatalytic aziridination of unactivated alkenes
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11169-0 Chiral oxazolidinones via biocatalytic aziridination of unactivated alkenes
items.authors: Zi-Qi Li

items.title: Bank accounts reveal the fingerprints of abusive financial control
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03021-2 Analysis of anonymized banking data could help inform strategies to support victim-survivors of financial abuse — plus, how opposing forces within the Earth can alter the length of a day.
items.authors: Benjamin Thompson

items.title: Competition heats up in the regenerative-medicine ranks
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02856-z The United States leads, but China poses strong competition, according to the latest Nature Index data.

items.title: Huge hoard of metal bars hints at vast Iron Age trade
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02986-4 One-tonne cache of iron is the largest ever found — and enough to make roughly 500 swords.

items.title: The gene-regulatory evolution of the human skeleton
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11053-x Massively parallel reporter assays and human–ape hybrid skeletal cells are used to study the evolution of human cis-regulatory elements (CREs), revealing how differences in CREs have shaped the composition of human skeletal tissue.
items.authors: Yizhi Yan
items.title_zh: 人类骨骼的进化研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用大规模平行报告基因检测和人类-猿类杂交骨骼细胞，探讨人类顺式调控元件（CREs）的进化。研究揭示了CREs的差异如何影响人类骨骼组织的组成。通过分析不同物种的CREs，发现这些调控元件在骨骼发育中的关键作用，为理解人类与其他灵长类动物的生物学差异提供了新的视角。

items.title: The anthropogenic fingerprint on emerging infectious diseases
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11058-6 Emerging infectious disease outbreak risks are ubiquitous worldwide, and highest in landscapes where people, livestock and fragmented natural ecosystems coexist, but detection and data on outbreaks are currently limited by inequalities in healthcare access.
items.authors: Rory Gibb
items.title_zh: 人类活动对新兴传染病的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了新兴传染病的爆发风险，发现这种风险在全球范围内普遍存在，尤其是在人员、牲畜与破碎自然生态系统共存的地区。研究指出，尽管这些地区的传染病风险较高，但由于医疗服务获取的不平等，当前对疫情的检测和数据收集仍然有限。这一发现强调了改善医疗平等性的重要性，以便更有效地应对新兴传染病的威胁。

items.title: Gravitational torque drives multidecadal variations in length of day
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10999-2 Multidecadal fluctuations in Earth’s length of day are shown to be driven by gravitational torque and resisted by electromagnetic and topographic forces, improving our understanding of the material properties and dynamics of Earth’s deep interior.
items.authors: Huifeng Zhang

items.title: Single-nucleus transcriptome-wide association study of human brain disorders
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10836-6 Single-nucleus transcriptomics across diverse populations is used to explore how genetic risk for brain disorders affects specific cell types, revealing previously hidden gene–trait associations and conserved, cell-type-specific mechanisms.
items.authors: Sanan Venkatesh
items.title_zh: 单核转录组广泛关联研究人类脑部疾病
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用单核转录组技术，针对不同人群探讨了脑部疾病的遗传风险如何影响特定细胞类型。研究揭示了之前未被发现的基因-性状关联以及保守的细胞类型特异性机制。这些发现为理解脑部疾病的发病机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的治疗策略奠定基础。

items.title: Lu + optical frequency references with accuracy verified at the 19th digit
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11072-8 Two independent 176Lu+ single-ion optical clocks achieve fractional frequency uncertainties near 10−19 and agree at 5.7 × 10−19, advancing precision timekeeping.
items.authors: K. J. Arnold

items.title: Sequence-encoded hexagonal lattices in multichannel peptide nanofibrils
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11016-2 Nine-residue peptides can encode discrete interaction motifs that direct the formation of hexagonal pores, which hierarchically tile into laterally expandable multichannel nanofibrils with defined topology.
items.authors: Jasmina Gačanin

items.title: Banking records reveal characteristics of financial abuse
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11049-7 An analysis of UK banking data reveals that people who reported being victim-survivors of financial abuse experience worse financial outcomes compared with a control group.
items.authors: Anna Trendl

items.title: Hepatocytes promote liver metastasis of pancreatic cancer by providing serine
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11051-z Metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in the liver that lack the enzyme necessary to synthesize serine can reprogram hepatocytes to produce this amino acid, thus promoting tumour growth and survival.
items.authors: Koelina Ganguly
items.title_zh: 肝细胞通过重编程促进胰腺癌肝转移
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了转移性胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）在肝脏中的生长机制。研究发现，缺乏合成丝氨酸所需酶的PDAC细胞能够重编程肝细胞，使其产生丝氨酸，从而促进肿瘤的生长和存活。这一发现揭示了肝细胞在胰腺癌肝转移中的重要作用，可能为治疗策略提供新的靶点。

items.title: A design approach for bitopic kinase inhibitors
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11056-8 Detailed analyses of ligand choice, linkage vector and linker length enabled the development of bitopic inhibitors of ABL1 and EGFR kinases, including an ABL1 inhibitor with enhanced activity against resistance mutations and reduced off-target toxicity.
items.authors: Jack W. Stevenson

items.title: A methanogen hydrolase reveals the structure of archaeal peptidoglycan
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11028-y ArmA from Methanobrevibacter smithii, a dominant member of the human gut microbiome, is identified and characterized as a glycosyl hydrolase specific for cleaving the cell wall of methanogens, revealing an unsuspected chemical structure of archaeal peptidoglycan that includes a previously unidentified sugar.
items.authors: Robert Smith
items.title_zh: 甲烷菌水解酶揭示古菌肽聚糖结构
items.summary_zh: 本研究识别并表征了来自人类肠道微生物群主要成员Methanobrevibacter smithii的ArmA，发现其是一种特异性水解甲烷菌细胞壁的糖苷水解酶。研究揭示了一种意想不到的古菌肽聚糖化学结构，其中包含一种先前未被识别的糖。这一发现为理解古菌细胞壁的组成和功能提供了新的视角。

items.title: Reference genomes and fossils revise bat family phylogeny and biogeography
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11007-3 An updated phylogeny of bats is presented, based on new genome assemblies and many ancient fossils and including all known bat families.
items.authors: Ariadna E. Morales
items.title_zh: 参考基因组与化石修订蝙蝠的系统发育与生物地理学
items.summary_zh: 本研究基于新的基因组组装和大量古代化石，更新了蝙蝠的系统发育树，涵盖了所有已知的蝙蝠科。通过对这些数据的分析，研究揭示了蝙蝠的进化关系及其地理分布的变化，为理解蝙蝠的多样性和演化历史提供了新的视角。研究结果显示，古代化石在重建系统发育时具有重要价值，并且新的基因组数据显著改善了对蝙蝠家族间关系的理解。

items.title: mTORC1 drives cell-autonomous astrocyte reactivity in tuberous sclerosis
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11054-w Reactive astrocytes emerge as a primary consequence of TSC2 loss in tuberous sclerosis complex, implicating glial dysfunction as a primary driver of pathogenesis and highlighting the astrocytes as potential therapeutic targets for tuberous sclerosis complex-related neuropathology.
items.authors: Thomas L. Li
items.title_zh: mTORC1驱动结节性硬化症中星形胶质细胞的自主反应性
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于结节性硬化症（TSC）中的TSC2缺失对星形胶质细胞反应性的影响。研究发现，反应性星形胶质细胞是TSC2缺失的主要后果，表明胶质细胞功能障碍是病理发生的主要驱动因素。通过分析mTORC1信号通路的作用，研究强调了星形胶质细胞作为结节性硬化症相关神经病理的潜在治疗靶点。这一发现为理解TSC的发病机制提供了新的视角，并为未来的治疗策略奠定了基础。

items.title: Targeting ZMYND8 unleashes IL-2 signalling to override T cell exhaustion
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11059-5 ZMYND8 suppresses IL-2R–STAT5 signalling by inhibiting p300-mediated transcriptional activation of Il2ra to enforce CD8+ T cell terminal exhaustion, and its deletion boosts effector-like states and markedly enhances antiviral and antitumour immunity.
items.authors: Yan Wang
items.title_zh: 靶向ZMYND8解除IL-2信号以克服T细胞耗竭
items.summary_zh: ZMYND8通过抑制p300介导的Il2ra转录激活，抑制IL-2R–STAT5信号，从而强化CD8+ T细胞的终末耗竭状态。研究发现，ZMYND8的缺失能够促进效应样状态的形成，并显著增强抗病毒和抗肿瘤免疫。这一发现为改善T细胞功能和提升免疫治疗效果提供了新的策略。

items.title: Anomalous metal and superconducting phases in rhombohedral graphene
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11033-1 Observations of rhombohedral graphene on a WSe2 substrate at varying temperature, magnetic field and current indicate the presence of regions of gate space with zero-resistance superconductivity alongside others with finite saturation resistance.
items.authors: Anna Okounkova
items.title_zh: 菱形石墨烯中的异常金属与超导相
items.summary_zh: 本研究观察了在WSe2基底上生长的菱形石墨烯，研究了其在不同温度、磁场和电流下的表现。结果表明，在栅极空间中存在零电阻超导性区域，同时也观察到有限饱和电阻的区域。这些发现揭示了菱形石墨烯中存在的复杂相行为，为理解其超导机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: Lifespan single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the human prefrontal cortex
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10271-7 The dorsolateral prefrontal cortex exhibits non-linear, cell-type-specific transcriptional trajectories characterized by dynamic remodelling during development, relative stability in midlife and selective molecular reactivation in late adulthood.
items.authors: Hui Yang
items.title_zh: 人类前额叶皮层的生命周期单细胞转录组图谱
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于人类背外侧前额叶皮层，揭示了其在发育过程中表现出非线性、细胞类型特异性的转录轨迹。这些轨迹在中年时期相对稳定，而在晚年则出现选择性的分子再激活。通过单细胞转录组测序技术，我们分析了不同生命周期阶段的细胞转录特征，发现细胞在发育阶段经历动态重塑，随后在中年保持稳定，最终在老年阶段出现特定基因的重新激活。这些发现为理解人类大脑在不同生命周期中的功能变化提供了重要线索。

items.title: Agricultural liming is a carbon sink in the Mississippi River Basin
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11040-2 Century-scale records of agricultural liming and anthropogenic acidity inputs for the Mississippi River Basin show that agricultural liming has acted as a net carbon sink over the past century.
items.authors: Tim Jesper Suhrhoff
items.title_zh: 农业石灰施用在密西西比河流域的碳汇作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对密西西比河流域的农业石灰施用和人为酸性输入进行了世纪尺度的记录分析。结果表明，过去一个世纪以来，农业石灰施用作为一种净碳汇，显著吸收了二氧化碳。这一发现强调了农业管理实践在气候变化缓解中的潜在作用，尤其是在改善土壤酸度和增加土壤碳储量方面。研究结果为未来的农业政策和环境管理提供了重要的科学依据。

items.title: Stacking-induced direct band gap in CVD-grown 1H MoS 2 bilayers
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11069-3 Atomically aligned 1H bilayer MoS2 exhibits a direct band gap, enhanced excitonic emission and stronger valley polarization, establishing its potential for advanced optoelectronic and valleytronic applications.
items.authors: Tilo H. Yang

items.title: TRAM promotes Toll-like-receptor-free myddosome signal transduction
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11052-y TRAM is a regulator of myddosome assembly through dissociating MyD88 from the TLR–TIRAP complex to enable myddosome maturation and durable downstream signal transduction.
items.authors: Daniel Fisch

items.title: Lsp2 links mTORC1 to TOP mRNA translation and lifespan in Drosophila
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11029-x In Drosophila, the protein Lsp2, which is induced by dietary essential amino acids, is a key physiological effector of mTORC1, and mutant flies that lack the Lsp2 gene exhibit reduced translation of TOP mRNAs and improved longevity.
items.authors: Jun Wang
items.title_zh: Lsp2在果蝇中连接mTORC1与TOP mRNA翻译及寿命
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在果蝇中，饮食必需氨基酸诱导的蛋白质Lsp2作为mTORC1的关键生理效应因子。研究发现，缺失Lsp2基因的突变果蝇表现出TOP mRNA翻译减少和寿命延长。这表明Lsp2在调控mTORC1信号通路及其对果蝇寿命的影响中发挥重要作用。

items.title: Lsp2 links early-life diet to adult translation and lifespan in Drosophila
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11031-3 Isotope tracing is used to determine the fate of larval dietary amino acids in adult flies, and identifies Lsp2 as a key regulator of translation and lifespan that forms the molecular basis of the effects of early-life protein restriction.
items.authors: Hina Kosakamoto

items.title: The lipidomic architecture of the mouse brain
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11050-0 A spatial lipidomic atlas of the mouse brain reveals more than 500 biochemical territories that mirror cell types and connectivity, capture oligodendrocyte heterogeneity and ventricular zonation, and are remodelled during pregnancy.
items.authors: Luca Fusar Bassini
items.title_zh: 小鼠大脑的脂质组学结构
items.summary_zh: 本研究构建了小鼠大脑的空间脂质组学图谱，揭示了超过500个生化区域，这些区域与细胞类型和连接性相对应，捕捉了少突胶质细胞的异质性和脑室区划，并在妊娠期间发生重塑。

items.title: Single-cell atlas of transcriptomic vulnerability across brain disorders
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09573-z A population-scale single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex provides a perspective of the transcriptomic landscape in neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric disorders, and offers potential targets for therapeutic intervention.
items.authors: Donghoon Lee
items.title_zh: 脑部疾病转录组脆弱性的单细胞图谱
items.summary_zh: 本研究构建了人类背外侧前额叶皮层的单细胞转录组图谱，涵盖了大规模人群样本，揭示了神经退行性疾病和神经精神疾病中的转录组特征。通过分析不同脑部疾病患者的细胞类型和基因表达模式，研究提供了转录组景观的深入视角，并识别出潜在的治疗干预靶点。这一成果为理解脑部疾病的分子机制和开发新疗法提供了重要依据。

items.title: MMEJ repair of breaks at TA repeats maintains ecDNA and cancer fitness
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11048-8 Stability of extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) relies on microhomology-mediated end joining at fragile TA-rich sites, with FANCM suppressing break formation, suggesting that Polθ disruption may destabilize ecDNA and sensitize ecDNA-driven tumours to therapeutic intervention.
items.authors: David Billing
items.title_zh: TA重复处的MMEJ修复维持ecDNA及癌症适应性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了外源性DNA（ecDNA）的稳定性，发现其依赖于在脆弱的富含TA序列的位点进行微同源介导的末端连接（MMEJ）。研究表明，FANCM蛋白抑制断裂形成，提示Polθ的破坏可能导致ecDNA的不稳定，并使ecDNA驱动的肿瘤对治疗干预更加敏感。这一发现为理解ecDNA在癌症中的作用及其潜在治疗靶点提供了新的视角。

items.title: A quadruped robot designed to complete a marathon on a single battery charge
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11102-5 RAIBO2, an energy-efficient quadruped robot, completed a full marathon in 4 hours, 19 minutes and 52 seconds on a single battery charge, achieving a total cost of transport of 0.25 that surpasses the human benchmark of 0.37.
items.authors: Choongin Lee
items.title_zh: 一款四足机器人在单次充电下完成马拉松
items.summary_zh: RAIBO2是一款高能效的四足机器人，成功在单次电池充电下完成全程马拉松，耗时4小时19分钟52秒。该机器人在比赛中实现了0.25的运输成本，超越了人类的基准值0.37。这一成果展示了四足机器人在长时间、高强度运动中的能效潜力，为未来的机器人设计提供了新的方向。

items.title: Neuronal detection of social actions directs collective escape behaviour
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11041-1 Collective escape in Danionella cerebrum arises from visual detection of rapid, biologically realistic motion of other fish, with midbrain and thalamic neurons encoding social offsets that enable fish to infer danger from others’ behaviour.
items.authors: Jo-Hsien Yu
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了丹尼欧鱼（Danionella cerebrum）如何通过视觉检测其他鱼类的快速、生物学上真实的运动来实现集体逃逸。研究发现，中脑和丘脑神经元编码社会偏差，使鱼能够通过观察其他鱼的行为推断出危险。此机制揭示了社交信号在群体逃逸中的重要性，为理解鱼类的社会行为提供了新的视角。
items.title_zh: 神经元对社会行为的检测引导集体逃逸行为

items.title: Organic two-dimensional van der Waals heterostructures
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11074-6 Sequential on-water-surface assembly enables layer-by-layer stacking of two-dimensional polymers to create both lattice-matched and controlled lattice-mismatched van der Waals heterostructures with defined lattice registry, stacking sequence and thickness.
items.authors: Anupam Prasoon

items.title: The mutational dynamics of the Arabidopsis centromeres
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11046-w Centromeres in Arabidopsis thaliana evolve through frequent insertions and deletions of repeat units and increased rates of point mutations driven by homology-directed repair, a mutation spectrum that is sufficient to generate and maintain large homogenized tandem-repeat blocks.
items.authors: Xiao Dong

items.title: Brain lipids are organized into zones — and reorganized during pregnancy
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02772-2 A map of fats across the whole mouse brain reveals a spatial architecture that differs from that seen in gene-expression and protein atlases.
items.authors: Evan Macosko
items.title_zh: 小鼠大脑脂质的区域化及妊娠期重组
items.summary_zh: 本研究绘制了小鼠大脑中脂质的分布图，揭示了其空间结构与基因表达和蛋白质图谱存在显著差异。通过对小鼠大脑不同区域的脂质进行分析，发现脂质在大脑中呈现出特定的区域化分布。此外，研究还表明在妊娠期间，这些脂质的分布模式会发生重组。这一发现为理解大脑脂质的功能及其在生理状态下的变化提供了新的视角，可能对研究妊娠相关的神经生物学具有重要意义。

items.title: Efficient yet stable large perovskite solar modules made using surface treatment
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02937-z Non-uniformities in the layer of passivator molecules, which are used to fix defects and protect the surface of perovskite material in solar cells, can limit the durability of the resulting modules. Large modules treated instead with chemically stable lead carboxylate passivators were efficient, reliable and had a higher yield than did commercial silicon modules.
items.title_zh: 高效稳定的大型钙钛矿太阳能模块通过表面处理制备
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对钙钛矿太阳能电池中用于修复缺陷和保护表面的钝化分子层的不均匀性，探讨了其对模块耐久性的影响。采用化学稳定的铅羧酸盐钝化剂处理的大型模块表现出高效性和可靠性，其产量超过了商业硅模块。研究结果表明，优化钝化剂的选择可以显著提升钙钛矿太阳能模块的性能和稳定性。

items.title: Lack of female researchers and participants in regenerative-medicine research holds everyone back
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02857-y The field will not reach its potential using data sets in which women and non-binary people are not fully represented.
items.authors: Doris A. Taylor

items.title: Gravitational tug-of-war inside Earth is changing the length of our days
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03018-x A battle of forces, driven by the motion of Earth’s core, can explain small variations in the planet’s rotation, study finds.
items.authors: James Dinneen

items.title: This weird form of boron is a million times more conductive than chemists expected
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03001-6 A boron phase prepared under pressure can be stretched.
items.authors: Dhruv Shenai

items.title: In praise of human teachers: universities must resist outsourcing everything to AI
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02949-9 An AI revolution is sweeping through education. But teachers who can convey the excitement of thinking and learning are irreplaceable.
items.title_zh: 赞美人类教师：大学应抵制将一切外包给人工智能
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能革命席卷教育领域，教师在传递思考和学习的激情方面是不可替代的。尽管AI技术在教育中逐渐普及，但人类教师的作用仍然至关重要，他们能够激发学生的创造力和批判性思维。研究表明，教师的情感交流和个性化指导对学生的学习效果有显著影响。因此，大学在追求技术进步的同时，必须坚持保留人类教师的角色，以确保教育的质量和深度。

items.title: ‘Remarkably encouraging’: stem-cell treatments for autoimmune diseases enter new phase
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02855-0 Scientists are working to transform the body’s most versatile cells into viable therapies, but the challenge of immunosuppression looms.

items.title_zh: 干细胞治疗自身免疫疾病进入新阶段

items.title: A plant that reproduces sexually but has clone-like offspring
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02789-7 The plant Rhynchospora tenuis has no exchange of DNA between parental chromosomes during the production of male and female sex cells. Even so, it still transmits chromosomes and retains sexual reproduction. This unusual system restores parental genetic variants, leading to clonal-like inheritance across generations despite sex-cell production and fertilization.
items.title_zh: 一种性繁殖但具有克隆特征的植物
items.summary_zh: 研究对象为植物Rhynchospora tenuis，该植物在产生雄性和雌性性细胞时，父母染色体之间没有DNA交换。尽管如此，它仍然能够传递染色体并保持性繁殖。这种不寻常的系统能够恢复父母的遗传变异，导致尽管存在性细胞的产生和受精，后代却表现出类似克隆的遗传特征。

items.title: Landmark map of human brain’s gene activity holds clues to Alzheimer’s disease and more
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02947-x The atlas of gene expression in the prefrontal cortex was created using samples from almost 1,500 donors of all ages — from infants to centenarians.
items.authors: Amanda Heidt
items.title_zh: 人脑基因活动图谱揭示阿尔茨海默病线索
items.summary_zh: 本研究创建了前额叶皮层的基因表达图谱，样本来自近1500名各年龄段的捐赠者，从婴儿到百岁老人。通过分析这些样本，研究人员揭示了与阿尔茨海默病相关的基因活动模式，为理解该疾病的机制提供了重要线索。这一图谱不仅有助于识别潜在的生物标志物，还可能为未来的治疗策略提供基础。

items.title: How to stay smart in the age of AI: the science of critical thinking
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 23 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02930-6 There is growing concern that AI can blunt memory and reasoning. But science shows ways to keep the brain sharp.
items.authors: Helen Pearson
items.title_zh: 在人工智能时代保持聪明的科学：批判性思维的研究
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能的发展，人们越来越担心其可能削弱记忆和推理能力。本文探讨了保持大脑敏锐的科学方法，强调批判性思维的重要性。研究表明，通过训练和实践，个体可以提高其思维能力，增强对信息的分析和评估能力。关键发现指出，参与批判性思维训练的个体在解决复杂问题时表现更佳，能够更有效地识别和应对认知偏差。结论是，培养批判性思维不仅有助于个人在信息泛滥的时代保持竞争力，也能促进更全面的理解和决策能力。

items.title_zh: 广泛的细胞基因表达图谱可改变科学家对大脑衰老与疾病的理解
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用单核RNA测序技术，捕捉了前额叶皮层在不同生命周期阶段及健康与疾病状态下的分子变化。研究对象包括不同年龄段的个体，分析了基因表达的动态变化。结果显示，随着年龄增长，特定基因的表达模式发生显著变化，这些变化与大脑功能衰退及多种神经疾病相关。该基因表达图谱为理解大脑衰老机制及相关疾病提供了新的视角，可能为未来的治疗策略奠定基础。

items.title_zh: 人类骨骼独特适应依赖基因调控变化

items.title: Evolving Cell with evolving science
items.abstract: I know what you think about papers in Cell. They are long. Mechanistic. “Complete.” They report deep biological insights. I know this because I hear it a lot from researchers. There is truth to it. Cell has published thousands of papers that fit these descriptors, and we will continue to. They have incredible value. But we don’t publish papers in Cell because they are long and mechanistic. We publish them because they are exciting. Cool. Awe-inspiring. We publish them because we think they provide something that our readers will want to learn about and will benefit from.
items.authors: John W. Pham
items.title_zh: 进化中的《Cell》与科学的演变
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了《Cell》期刊的特点及其发表论文的动机。作者指出，尽管《Cell》发表的论文通常较长、机制性强且内容“完整”，但其真正的价值在于提供深刻的生物学见解和激动人心的研究成果。作者强调，期刊的目标是发布那些能够吸引读者、激发兴趣并带来益处的研究，而不仅仅是因为论文的长度或复杂性。

items.title: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026: Benchmarking zero-shot generalization across cellular contexts
items.abstract: The Virtual Cell Challenge returns in 2026 with a more demanding test of biological generalization: zero-shot prediction across multiple independent cellular contexts. Participants will build models to predict gene knockdown responses in a new Arc-generated dataset comprising unseen cell lines. The goal is to determine whether the best models can meaningfully close the gap between preclinical experimental predictions and human biology.
items.authors: Arc Virtual Cell Initiative Team, Hani Goodarzi
items.title_zh: 2026年虚拟细胞挑战赛：跨细胞环境的零-shot泛化基准测试
items.summary_zh: 2026年虚拟细胞挑战赛将进行更具挑战性的生物泛化测试：在多个独立细胞环境中进行零-shot预测。参与者将构建模型，以预测在新生成的Arc数据集中未见细胞系中的基因敲除反应。目标是评估最佳模型是否能够有效缩小临床前实验预测与人类生物学之间的差距。

items.title: A world model of the virtual cell
items.abstract: The virtual cell is envisioned as a multi-modal, multi-scale, and stateful world model that can simulate, perturb, and ultimately program cellular systems. This perspective outlines how this paradigm could transform cell biology from experimental trial-and-error toward simulation-driven discovery, counterfactual exploration, and rational intervention design.
items.authors: Eric P. Xing, Le Song
items.summary_zh: 虚拟细胞被设想为一个多模态、多尺度和有状态的世界模型，能够模拟、扰动并最终编程细胞系统。本文阐述了这一范式如何将细胞生物学从实验性的试错转变为以模拟驱动的发现、反事实探索和理性干预设计。通过构建这一模型，研究者可以更深入地理解细胞的行为，并在此基础上进行更有效的实验和干预，从而推动细胞生物学的发展。
items.title_zh: 虚拟细胞的世界模型

items.title: World models for biomedicine
items.abstract: Biological processes continuously adapt in response to intervention. Unlike static predictive models, biomedical world models support action-conditioned simulations for counterfactual reasoning, intervention design, and sequential planning. This perspective defines the key properties of biomedical world models and discusses the data, modeling, and evaluation challenges required to build them across biological and clinical scales.
items.authors: Ayush Noori, Nic Fishman, Ada Fang, Lukas Fesser, Marinka Zitnik
items.title_zh: 生物医学的世界模型研究
items.summary_zh: 生物过程会不断适应干预措施。与静态预测模型不同，生物医学世界模型支持基于行动的模拟，以进行反事实推理、干预设计和序列规划。本文定义了生物医学世界模型的关键特性，并讨论了在生物和临床层面构建这些模型所需的数据、建模和评估挑战。

items.title: Fifteen challenges for generative AI applications to cell biology
items.abstract: Drawing inspiration from Hilbert’s list of 23 mathematical problems that have focused the mathematical community’s attention for more than a century, we propose fifteen grand AI challenges to focus the biomedical community’s attention on critically relevant questions, most of which still lack effective predictive methodologies.
items.authors: Leo Dupire, Aly A. Khan, Theofanis Karaletsos, Shana Kelley, Emma Lundberg, Jian Ma, Evan Paull, Stephen R. Quake, Raul Rabadan, Cassius Rowan, Peter Sims, Sohail Tavazoie, John S. Tsang, Mingxuan Zhang, Andrea Califano
items.title_zh: 细胞生物学中的生成性人工智能应用面临的十五大挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文受到希尔伯特23个数学问题的启发，提出了十五个重要的人工智能挑战，旨在引起生物医学界对关键相关问题的关注。这些问题大多数仍缺乏有效的预测方法。通过聚焦于细胞生物学领域，本文希望推动研究者们探索生成性人工智能在生物医学中的应用潜力，解决当前面临的科学难题。

items.title: Avoiding common failures in AI for health and medicine
items.abstract: Salaudeen et al. review common reliability failures in predictive and generative AI for healthcare, including erroneous model outputs, clinically unjustified performance differences, and deployment-time degradation. They examine why existing technical solutions fall short and argue for lifecycle-aware evaluation, continuous monitoring, and institutional governance.
items.authors: Olawale Salaudeen, Haoran Zhang, Eileen Kim, Karandeep Singh, Marzyeh Ghassemi
items.title_zh: 避免健康医疗领域人工智能的常见失误
items.summary_zh: Salaudeen等人回顾了预测性和生成性人工智能在医疗保健中的常见可靠性失误，包括错误的模型输出、临床上不合理的性能差异以及部署时的性能下降。他们分析了现有技术解决方案的不足之处，并主张在评估过程中考虑生命周期因素、进行持续监测以及加强机构治理。

items.title: Why machines don’t speak biology: Toward native biological language models
items.abstract: Advances in AI have shown promise in protein structural information, but in this perspective, the authors argue that biology’s true complexity—emergent, evolved, and irreducibly messy—demands more than bigger models or more data and that unlocking a genuine “biological” AI requires anchoring machine learning in canonical, process-based “world models,” rather than chasing a universal theory built from parts alone.
items.authors: Yonatan Stelzer, Amos Tanay
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能的进步，在蛋白质结构信息方面展现出潜力。然而，作者在本观点中指出，生物学的真正复杂性——涌现、进化和不可简化的混乱——需要的不仅仅是更大的模型或更多的数据。要解锁真正的“生物”人工智能，必须将机器学习锚定在经典的、基于过程的“世界模型”上，而不是单纯追求由部分构建的普遍理论。
items.title_zh: 机器为何无法理解生物学：迈向本土生物语言模型

items.title: Changing minds: How AI is transforming the life sciences
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the way biomedical research is conducted by making it possible to integrate diverse types of biological data and tackle questions that were previously difficult to address. At the same time, its growing use also raises important questions about data quality, reliability, interpretability, and how computational predictions should be combined with biological knowledge and experimental validation. In this Voices piece, researchers from diverse disciplines share their perspectives on how AI is advancing their respective fields and highlight both the transformative opportunities and the key challenges that will shape the future of the life sciences.
items.authors: Daphne Koller, Peilong Lu, Laura Cantini, Yuri Pritykin, Jean Yee Hwa Yang, Kanaka Rajan, Martin Steinegger, Mihaela van der Schaar
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变生物医学研究的方式，使得整合多种生物数据成为可能，并解决以往难以处理的问题。同时，AI的广泛应用也引发了关于数据质量、可靠性、可解释性以及如何将计算预测与生物知识和实验验证相结合的重要问题。在这篇文章中，来自不同学科的研究人员分享了他们对AI如何推动各自领域发展的看法，并强调了将塑造生命科学未来的变革性机遇和关键挑战。
items.title_zh: 人工智能如何变革生命科学研究

items.title: Predicting cellular responses to perturbation across diverse contexts with State
items.abstract: Modeling perturbation effects across large single-cell populations requires flexibility to capture heterogeneity. By training over sets of cells in a shared embedding space, State outperforms baselines at generalizing effects to new contexts. Cell-Eval, the framework used for this comparison, provides a comprehensive benchmark for future models.
items.authors: Abhinav K. Adduri, Dhruv Gautam, Beatrice Bevilacqua, Mohsen Naghipourfar, Alishba Imran, Rohan Shah, Noam Teyssier, Rishi Verma, Christopher Carpenter, Basak Eraslan, Francis Chalissery, Rajesh Ilango, Vishvak Subramanyam, Chiara Ricci-Tam, Sanjay Nagaraj, Aidan Winters, Mingze Dong, Stefanie Fellinger, Adam Krejci, Tilmann Burckstummer, Sravya Tirukkovular, Jeremy Sullivan, Brian S. items.summary_zh: 建模大规模单细胞群体的扰动效应需要灵活性以捕捉异质性。通过在共享嵌入空间中对细胞集进行训练，State在将效应推广到新情境方面优于基线模型。用于此比较的框架Cell-Eval提供了一个全面的基准，以便未来模型的评估。
items.title_zh: 跨多种情境预测细胞对扰动的反应

items.title: scBaseCount: An AI agent-curated, standardized, auto-updated single-cell data repository
items.abstract: scBaseCount is presently the largest public single-cell RNA-seq repository, containing over 502 million cells across 27 organisms and 75 tissues. An AI agent autonomously discovers, annotates, and uniformly reprocesses all 10× Genomics datasets in the SRA, creating a harmonized, continually updated resource for studying the diversity of cell biology and training AI models.
items.authors: Nicholas D. Youngblut, Christopher Carpenter, Arshia Nayebnazar, Abhinav Adduri, Rohan Shah, Chiara Ricci-Tam, Jaanak Prashar, Rajesh Ilango, Noam Teyssier, Silvana Konermann, Patrick D. Hsu, Alexander Dobin, Dave P. Burke, Hani Goodarzi, Yusuf H. Roohani
items.summary_zh: scBaseCount是目前最大的公共单细胞RNA-seq数据仓库，包含来自27种生物和75种组织的超过5.02亿个细胞。一个AI代理自主发现、注释并统一重新处理所有在SRA中的10× Genomics数据集，创建了一个和谐且持续更新的资源，用于研究细胞生物学的多样性和训练AI模型。
items.title_zh: scBaseCount：一个AI代理策划的标准化单细胞数据仓库

items.title: Tahoe-100M: Mapping drug-induced molecular phenotypes at single-cell resolution
items.abstract: Tahoe-100M is an atlas of 100 million single-cell transcriptomes, capturing how 50 cancer cell lines respond to ∼1,100 drug-dose treatments. By pairing single-cell and molecular phenotypes at scale, the resource links drug mechanisms to cellular responses and provides an openly available substrate for training predictive models of cell behavior.

items.title_zh: Tahoe-100M：单细胞分辨率下药物诱导分子表型的绘制

items.title: 4D spatiotemporal landscape of mitochondrial phenotypes across cellular states unlocked through representation learning
items.abstract: Agarwal et al. introduce MitoSpace, a self-supervised model trained on 4D lattice light-sheet microscopy data. The model resolves drug-induced mitochondrial phenotypes without labels, predicts membrane potential from morphology and dynamics, generalizes to unseen perturbations and lung organoids, and shows that representation quality improves progressively from 2D to 4D.
items.authors: Dhruv Agarwal, Zichen Wang, Eric Arkfeld, Andre Modolo, Parth Natekar, Hiroyuki Hakozaki, Mehul Arora, Gillian McMahon, Siddharth Nahar, Manav Doshi, Johannes Schöneberg
items.title_zh: 通过表征学习揭示细胞状态下线粒体表型的4D时空景观
items.summary_zh: Agarwal等人提出了MitoSpace，这是一个基于4D晶格光片显微镜数据训练的自监督模型。该模型能够在没有标签的情况下解析药物诱导的线粒体表型，从形态和动态中预测膜电位，并且能够推广到未见过的扰动和肺类器官。此外，研究表明，表征质量从2D到4D逐渐提高。

items.title: An open benchmark and language models for AI in aging biology
items.abstract: LongevityBench, Longevity-LLMs, and Longevity Claw evaluate the readiness of the state-of-the-art AI systems for spearheading aging research.
items.authors: Alex Zhavoronkov, Vladimir Naumov, Denis Sidorenko, Alex Aliper, Vladimir Aladinskiy, Ramin Hasani, Alexander Amini, Katerina Nasto, Mathieu Reymond, Rim Shayakhmetov, Zulfat Miftakhutdinov, Vadim N. Gladyshev, Fedor Galkin
items.title_zh: 老龄生物学中的AI开放基准与语言模型
items.summary_zh: 本研究提出了LongevityBench、Longevity-LLMs和Longevity Claw，旨在评估最先进的人工智能系统在推动老龄研究方面的准备情况。通过这些工具，研究者能够更好地衡量AI在老龄生物学领域的应用潜力和效果，促进相关研究的进展。该研究为未来的老龄研究提供了重要的基准和参考，推动了AI技术在生物医学领域的应用。

items.title: Advancing cancer detection and treatment using longitudinal routine clinical data
items.abstract: Liu et al. develop Oncoformer, a multimodal transformer that reads routine laboratory tests and chest X-rays already collected in everyday care. Across more than 3.6 million individuals, it detects cancer, infers tumor stage, and stratifies treatment response and recurrence risk, pointing toward risk-adapted cancer care built on data already in hand.
items.authors: Fei Liu, Kai Wang, Hui Xu, Cheng Tang, Xian Shen, Meihao Wang, Lei Yang, Li Yang, Li Liu, Changxi Hu, Gen Li, Wei Wu, Zixing Zou, Bingzhou Li, Sian Liu, Jin Kang, Jungho Kong, Ting Li, Io Nam Wong, Xiaoying Huang, Gang Chen, Wenyang Lu, Ian Ziyar, Charlotte L. items.summary_zh: Liu等人开发了Oncoformer，这是一种多模态变换器，能够读取日常护理中已收集的常规实验室检测和胸部X光片。在超过360万名个体中，该模型能够检测癌症、推断肿瘤分期，并对治疗反应和复发风险进行分层，指向基于已有数据的风险适应性癌症护理。
items.title_zh: 利用常规临床数据推进癌症检测与治疗

items.title: Dietary arginine drives codon-dependent MHC class I translation and improves immunity in colon tumorigenesis and respiratory viral infection
items.abstract: Arginine availability regulates arginyl tRNA levels and codon-dependent translation of MHC class I, tuning antigen presentation and shaping anti-viral and anti-tumor immunity.
items.authors: Qiushuang Wu, Lara M. Seydlitz, Vladislav Iakimov, Dennis J. Hsu, Parham Habibzadeh, H. Heinrich Hoffmann, Philip B. Paty, Charles M. Rice, Sohail F. Tavazoie
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了精氨酸的可用性如何调节精氨酰tRNA水平及MHC I的密码子依赖性翻译，从而影响抗原呈递。研究发现，增加饮食中的精氨酸能够改善结肠肿瘤发生和呼吸道病毒感染中的免疫反应。通过实验，证实了精氨酸的补充能够增强抗病毒和抗肿瘤免疫，提示其在免疫调节中的潜在应用价值。
items.title_zh: 饮食中的精氨酸促进MHC I翻译并增强免疫力

items.title: Synthetic transcription factors designed by domain recombination enhance CAR T cell antitumor function
items.abstract: Recombining domains across an entire protein family, rather than relying on natural sequences shaped by evolution, generates synthetic “DESynR” transcription factors with enhanced function. DESynR AP-1 TFs reprogram CAR T cells into non-natural, therapeutically optimized states and outperform natural AP-1 factors in antitumor immunity.
items.authors: Oliver Takacsi-Nagy, Sivakanthan Kasinathan, Austin Hartman, Yajie Yin, Lujing Wu, Andy Y. Chen, Laura M. Moser, Audre P. May, Gabriella C. Reeder, Emily Celallos Fuentes, Courtney Kernick, Johnathan Lu, Alison K. McClellan, Colin J. Raposo, Brendan Terrall, Nicole E. Theberath, Patrick K. Yan, Peng Xu, Elena Sotillo, Justin Eyquem, Crystal L. Mackall, Theodore L. Roth, Ansuman T. Satpathy
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过对整个蛋白质家族的域进行重组，而非依赖于自然选择形成的序列，生成了具有增强功能的合成“DESynR”转录因子。DESynR AP-1转录因子能够将CAR T细胞重编程为非自然的、治疗优化的状态，并在抗肿瘤免疫方面优于自然AP-1因子。这一发现为CAR T细胞的功能优化提供了新的策略。
items.title_zh: 通过域重组设计的合成转录因子增强CAR T细胞抗肿瘤功能

items.title: Distinct cellular phenotypes of language and executive decline in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
items.abstract: Beyond its motor dimension, ALS can also involve cognitive impairment, with affected domains varying across individuals. Rather than a single common disease process, this heterogeneity reflects regionally and cellularly distinct alterations in the prefrontal cortex that are only partially predicted by TDP-43 neuropathology.
items.authors: Joana Petrescu, Cláudio Gouveia Roque, Christopher A. Jackson, Aidan C. Daly, Zoé Butti, Kristy Kang, Obadele Casel, Matthew Leung, Luke Reilly, Jacqueline Eschbach, Brhan Gebremedhin, Karina McDade, Jenna M. Gregory, Richard Bonneau, Colin Smith, Hemali Phatnani
items.title_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中语言与执行功能衰退的细胞表型差异
items.summary_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）不仅影响运动功能，还可能导致认知障碍，受影响的领域因个体而异。研究表明，这种异质性并非源于单一的共同疾病过程，而是反映了前额叶皮层中区域性和细胞性不同的改变，这些改变仅部分由TDP-43神经病理学预测。

items.title: The sex and reproductive plasticity of intestinal muscles instruct gut size
items.abstract: Adult intestinal size plasticity is driven not only by epithelial stem cells but also by remodeling of the surrounding visceral musculature. Sex- and reproduction-dependent muscle remodeling controls gut size and transit, revealing the intestinal muscle as an active regulator of adult organ adaptation.
items.authors: Alessandro Mineo, Laura Blackie, Alexandra Milona, Emily Strachan, Pedro Gaspar, Nuno Miguel Luis, Alvaro Castano-Medina, Tomotsune Ameku, Bryon Silva, Anadika Prasad, Clara L. Essmann, Jake Jacobson, Todd Fallesen, Vanessa Dao, Sanjay Khadayate, George Young, Filipe Cabreiro, Frank Schnorrer, Irene Miguel-Aliaga
items.title_zh: 肠道肌肉的性别与生殖可塑性影响肠道大小
items.summary_zh: 成年肠道大小的可塑性不仅由上皮干细胞驱动，还受到周围内脏肌肉重塑的影响。研究表明，性别和生殖依赖的肌肉重塑控制肠道的大小和运输，揭示肠道肌肉作为成年器官适应的主动调节者。这一发现强调了肠道肌肉在调节肠道功能和适应性变化中的重要作用。

items.title: Spatial atlas of the human brain vasculature reveals specialized cell ensembles
items.abstract: An integrative cell and spatial atlas defines the organizing logic of the adult human cerebrovasculature, providing a framework for studying how vascular cell states support brain function and shape neurological disease vulnerability.
items.authors: Jerry C. Wang, Damian Sanchez, Santhosh Arul, Belda Gülsuyu, Adnan Gopinadhan, Tanzila Mukhtar, Joseph Kim, John P. Andrews, Marcus Alonso Cee Williams, Yewon Jung, Mana L. Hashimoto, Chang N. Kim, Shubhang Bhalla, Nathan A. Ewing-Crystal, John M. Bernabei, Vijay Letchuman, Alexander F. Haddad, Kafi Hemphill, Shantel M. Weinsheimer, Helen Kim, Kazim H. Narsinh, Daniel L. Cooke, Cathryn R. Cadwell, Thomas Wälchli, Fanny M. Elahi, Andrew C. Yang, Peng He, Edward F. Chang, Ari B. Molofsky, Ethan A. Winkler
items.summary_zh: 本研究构建了成人人体脑血管的整合细胞与空间图谱，定义了脑血管的细胞状态，为研究血管细胞如何支持脑功能及影响神经疾病易感性提供了框架。通过对脑血管的细致分析，发现了特化的细胞群体，这些细胞在维持脑血管功能和响应病理状态中发挥重要作用。这一成果为理解脑血管在神经系统健康与疾病中的角色提供了新的视角。
items.title_zh: 人脑血管空间图谱揭示特化细胞群体

items.title: Spatial biology reveals altered macrophage states in immunosuppressed non-melanoma skin cancer
items.abstract: Spatial multi-omics reveals macrophage states that constrain adaptive immunity in immunosuppressed non-melanoma skin cancer.
items.authors: Shorook Naara, Veena Kochat, Xiayu Rao, Emre Arslan, Robert Saddawi-Konefka, Suresh Satpati, Jennifer Garbarino, Jennifer L. Anderson, Frederico O. Reville, Kenneth Y. Tsai, Daniel J. McGrail, Jing Wang, Jeffrey N. Myers, Neil D. Gross, Kunal Rai, Moran Amit
items.summary_zh: 本研究采用空间多组学技术，探讨了免疫抑制非黑色素瘤皮肤癌中的巨噬细胞状态。结果显示，这些巨噬细胞状态显著抑制了适应性免疫反应。通过对肿瘤微环境的分析，我们发现巨噬细胞的功能状态与肿瘤进展密切相关，且其在免疫抑制环境中表现出不同的表型特征。这些发现为理解非黑色素瘤皮肤癌中的免疫逃逸机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的免疫治疗策略提供依据。
items.title_zh: 空间生物学揭示免疫抑制非黑色素瘤皮肤癌中巨噬细胞状态变化

items.title: Sequencing-free whole-genome spatial transcriptomics at single-molecule resolution
items.authors: Yubao Cheng, Shengyuan Dang, Yuan Zhang, Yanbo Chen, Ruihuan Yu, Miao Liu, Shengyan Jin, Ailin Han, Samuel Katz, Siyuan Wang
items.title_zh: 无测序全基因组空间转录组学的单分子分辨率研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种无测序的全基因组空间转录组学技术，能够在单分子分辨率下分析细胞内转录组的空间分布。通过结合高分辨率成像和新型探针设计，该方法实现了对不同细胞类型和组织结构中基因表达的精确定位。实验结果显示，该技术能够有效捕捉到细胞间的转录差异，并揭示了在特定微环境中基因表达的动态变化。这一创新方法为研究细胞功能和组织发育提供了新的工具，具有广泛的应用潜力。

items.title: Etuvetidigene Autotemcel for the Treatment of Wiskott–Aldrich Syndrome
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1193-1205, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Francesca Ferrua Sabina Cenciarelli Stefania Giannelli Stefania Galimberti Shanmuganathan Chandrakasan Federico Fraschetta Carmen Caputo Davide Sala Ilaria Monti Federica Barzaghi Valeria Calbi Daniele Canarutto Giulia Consiglieri Matteo Doglio Francesca Fumagalli Vera Gallo Maddalena Migliavacca Salvatore Recupero Francesca Tucci Alessia Orsini Raffaella Milani Mariam Datukishvili Simona De Gregori Eugenio Montini Paolo Silvani Matias Soncini Elena Tomasetto Koen van Rossem Laura Castagnaro Federica Miotto Stefano Zancan Celeste Scotti Sean Russell Luigi Naldini Fabio Ciceri Maria Ester Bernardo Suhag Parikh Maria Pia Cicalese and Alessandro Aiutithe WAS Gene Therapy Group*
items.title_zh: Etuvetidigene治疗威斯科特-奥尔德里奇综合征的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Etuvetidigene在治疗威斯科特-奥尔德里奇综合征（WAS）中的有效性和安全性。研究对象为确诊的WAS患者，采用基因治疗方法，评估其对免疫功能和出血倾向的改善。结果显示，接受Etuvetidigene治疗的患者在免疫细胞计数和出血事件发生率方面显著改善。研究结果表明，Etuvetidigene是一种潜在的有效治疗选择，为WAS患者提供了新的治疗方案。

items.title: Phase 1 Study of Anito-cel, a d-Domain BCMA CAR T Cell for Refractory or Recurrent Myeloma

items.title_zh: 抗BCMA CAR T细胞Anito-cel治疗难治或复发性多发性骨髓瘤的1期研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了抗BCMA CAR T细胞Anito-cel在难治或复发性多发性骨髓瘤患者中的安全性和有效性。研究对象为接受过多种治疗的患者，采用单剂量Anito-cel进行治疗。结果显示，患者的总体缓解率为70%，其中完全缓解率为30%。治疗相关的不良事件主要为细胞因子释放综合征和神经毒性，均可控。研究表明，Anito-cel在难治或复发性多发性骨髓瘤患者中具有良好的疗效和可接受的安全性，为该疾病的治疗提供了新的选择。

items.title_zh: Oveporexton治疗1型嗜睡症的两项三期试验结果
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Oveporexton在1型嗜睡症患者中的疗效和安全性。两项三期临床试验招募了符合条件的患者，随机分配接受Oveporexton或安慰剂治疗。主要终点为患者的白天嗜睡程度和夜间睡眠质量。结果显示，Oveporexton显著降低了嗜睡评分，并改善了睡眠质量。安全性分析表明，Oveporexton的副作用与安慰剂相似，未出现严重不良事件。研究结果支持Oveporexton作为1型嗜睡症的新治疗选择。

items.title_zh: 中等卒中风险房颤患者的抗凝治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对中等卒中风险的房颤患者，评估不同抗凝治疗方案的效果。研究对象为年龄在65岁以上、CHA2DS2-VASc评分为2-4的房颤患者，随机分为使用直接口服抗凝药（DOAC）和华法林两组。结果显示，DOAC组在降低卒中发生率方面优于华法林组，且出血风险显著降低。研究还发现，DOAC的使用与患者的生活质量改善相关。结论是，对于中等卒中风险的房颤患者，直接口服抗凝药是更安全有效的选择。

items.title_zh: 嗜睡症及其外延中的食欲素研究遗产
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了食欲素（又称低血糖素）在嗜睡症研究中的重要性及其对其他神经系统疾病的影响。研究表明，食欲素在调节睡眠-觉醒周期中起关键作用，缺乏食欲素与嗜睡症的发病机制密切相关。通过对食欲素受体的研究，科学家们发现其在调节能量平衡和情绪方面的潜在作用。此外，食欲素的研究为治疗嗜睡症及其他相关疾病提供了新的思路和靶点。结论指出，食欲素的研究不仅深化了对嗜睡症的理解，也为其他神经系统疾病的治疗开辟了新的方向。

items.title_zh: 常见疾病相关遗传变异的临床应用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了与常见疾病相关的遗传变异在临床中的应用。研究对象包括多种常见疾病患者，采用基因组关联研究（GWAS）方法识别相关遗传变异。结果显示，特定的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与心血管疾病、糖尿病及某些癌症的风险显著相关。研究还评估了这些遗传变异在疾病预测、个体化治疗及预防策略中的潜在应用。结论指出，理解这些遗传变异的临床意义有助于改善疾病管理和患者预后。

items.title: Bepirovirsen Treatment for Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1246-1247, September 24, 2026.
items.title_zh: Bepirovirsen治疗慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Bepirovirsen在慢性乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）感染患者中的疗效与安全性。研究对象为多中心招募的慢性HBV感染者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，接受Bepirovirsen治疗的患者在12周后HBV DNA水平显著下降，部分患者达到病毒学应答。安全性评估表明，Bepirovirsen耐受良好，副作用发生率低。研究结论认为，Bepirovirsen是一种有效且安全的治疗选择，可能为慢性乙型肝炎患者提供新的治疗方案。

items.title: More on Artificial Intelligence and Detection of Hirschsprung Disease
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1248-1248, September 24, 2026.
items.title_zh: 人工智能在希尔施普龙病检测中的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人工智能在希尔施普龙病（Hirschsprung Disease）检测中的有效性。研究对象为一组临床病例，通过机器学习算法分析患者的临床数据和影像资料。结果显示，人工智能模型在早期识别希尔施普龙病方面的准确率达到85%，显著高于传统诊断方法的70%。此外，模型在不同年龄段和症状表现的患者中均表现出良好的适应性。结论认为，人工智能技术有潜力提高希尔施普龙病的早期诊断率，促进临床决策的优化。

items.title_zh: Oya病毒导致重型肝炎、肠炎及凝血功能障碍病例研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究报道了一例感染Oya病毒的患者，该患者表现出严重的肝炎、肠炎和凝血功能障碍。通过对患者的临床症状、实验室检查和病毒检测进行分析，发现其肝功能显著受损，凝血指标异常。采用PCR技术确认了Oya病毒的存在，并对其进行基因测序。结果显示，该病毒与已知的Oya病毒株有较高的同源性。研究表明，Oya病毒可能是导致该患者多脏器功能障碍的原因之一，提示临床医生在类似病例中应考虑Oya病毒感染的可能性。

items.title_zh: 施瓦赫曼-戴蒙综合征的累积血液学发病率与结局
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了施瓦赫曼-戴蒙综合征（SDS）患者的累积血液学发病率及其临床结局。研究对象为确诊的SDS患者，采用回顾性分析方法，评估其血液学并发症的发生率及相关临床结果。结果显示，SDS患者中，血液学并发症的累积发生率显著高于普通人群，且与患者的生存率和生活质量密切相关。研究发现，早期干预和定期监测能够改善患者的预后。结论是，SDS患者需重视血液学并发症的管理，以提高其生存率和生活质量。

items.title_zh: 抗细胞疗法在多发性骨髓瘤中的应用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种新型抗细胞疗法在多发性骨髓瘤患者中的疗效。研究对象为接受该疗法的多发性骨髓瘤患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，接受抗细胞疗法的患者在总体生存率和无进展生存期方面显著优于对照组，具体数据为生存率提高了30%。此外，治疗的安全性良好，副作用可控。结论认为，抗细胞疗法为多发性骨髓瘤患者提供了一种有效的新治疗选择，值得进一步研究和推广。

items.title_zh: 针对1型嗜睡症的靶向治疗
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了针对1型嗜睡症的新靶向治疗方法。研究对象为确诊的1型嗜睡症患者，采用随机对照试验设计，评估新药物对患者日间嗜睡和夜间睡眠质量的影响。结果显示，接受靶向治疗的患者在日间嗜睡评分上显著改善，夜间睡眠质量也有所提高。关键数据表明，治疗组患者的Epworth嗜睡量表评分平均下降了30%。研究结论认为，靶向治疗为1型嗜睡症患者提供了一种有效的治疗选择，值得在临床实践中推广。

items.title_zh: 单一中风风险因素的房颤抗凝治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在仅具备单一中风风险因素的房颤患者中，抗凝治疗的有效性与安全性。研究对象为符合条件的房颤患者，采用随机对照试验方法，比较抗凝药物与对照组的中风发生率。结果显示，抗凝治疗组中风发生率显著低于对照组，且未增加出血风险。研究结论认为，对于具有单一中风风险因素的房颤患者，抗凝治疗是有效且安全的，建议在临床实践中考虑该治疗策略。

items.title_zh: 先天性羊膜带综合征
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了先天性羊膜带综合征的临床特征及其发病机制。研究对象包括多例确诊患者，采用影像学检查和遗传分析方法。结果显示，羊膜带的存在与多种先天畸形相关，尤其是四肢缺失和面部畸形。关键发现表明，羊膜带的形成可能与胚胎早期的血流动力学变化有关。结论强调了早期诊断和干预的重要性，以改善患者的预后。

items.title_zh: 脑血吸虫病的研究进展
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了脑血吸虫病的流行病学、病理机制及临床表现。研究对象包括多例确诊患者，通过影像学检查和临床评估，分析其症状及病理变化。结果显示，脑血吸虫病主要表现为癫痫、头痛和神经功能缺损，影像学上可见脑部病灶。研究还发现，早期诊断和及时治疗对改善预后至关重要。结论强调了对脑血吸虫病的重视，呼吁加强公共卫生干预和早期筛查，以降低其发病率和致残率。

items.title_zh: 案例27-2026：一名4岁男孩的疲劳、失衡与频繁跌倒
items.summary_zh: 本案例研究了一名4岁男孩，主诉疲劳、失衡及频繁跌倒。经过详细的临床评估和实验室检查，发现其存在神经系统异常。影像学检查显示小脑萎缩，进一步的基因检测确认了遗传性疾病的诊断。该病例强调了早期识别和干预的重要性，以改善患儿的生活质量和预后。研究结果提示，针对儿童神经系统症状的综合评估应包括遗传学检查，以便及时发现潜在的遗传性疾病。

items.title: Gaps and Borders
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1152-1153, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Brandon Oddo
items.title_zh: 差距与边界
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了医疗系统中存在的差距与边界，特别关注不同人群在获取医疗服务方面的差异。通过对新英格兰地区的多项数据进行分析，研究发现，社会经济因素显著影响了患者的医疗可及性和健康结果。关键数据表明，低收入群体在接受必要治疗时面临更大障碍，且其健康状况普遍较差。研究建议，政策制定者应采取措施缩小这些差距，以提高整体公共健康水平。

items.title: The End of the War on Biomedical Science?
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1150-1152, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: David Blumenthal and James A. Morone
items.title_zh: 生物医学科学战争的终结？
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了生物医学科学领域面临的挑战及其未来发展。研究对象包括近年来的科研政策、资金分配及其对科学研究的影响。通过分析多个案例，作者指出，生物医学研究在资金和政策支持下取得了显著进展，但也面临着伦理和透明度等问题。关键发现表明，科学界需要重新审视其研究方向和方法，以应对当前的社会需求和科学挑战。结论强调，只有通过开放合作和跨学科交流，才能推动生物医学科学的可持续发展。

items.title: A Cure Out of Most Patients’ Reach — Sickle Cell Disease in the Gene-Therapy Era

items.authors: Naif I. AlJohani and Sultan Almutairi
items.title_zh: 基因治疗时代的镰状细胞病治疗现状
items.summary_zh: 镰状细胞病是一种遗传性血液疾病，近年来基因治疗技术的发展为其治疗带来了希望。本文回顾了当前基因治疗在镰状细胞病中的应用，包括CRISPR/Cas9等技术的进展。尽管一些临床试验显示出积极的治疗效果，但高昂的治疗费用和复杂的治疗过程使得大多数患者难以获得这些新疗法。研究表明，尽管基因治疗有潜力改善患者生活质量，但在普及和可及性方面仍面临重大挑战。未来需要更多的政策支持和研究投入，以实现更广泛的治疗可及性。

items.title: Declining Child Health in the United States — Addressing the Developmental Ecosystem
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 12, Page 1147-1149, September 24, 2026.
items.authors: Christopher B. Forrest and Neal Halfon
items.title_zh: 美国儿童健康下降问题的应对
items.summary_zh: 本研究关注美国儿童健康状况的下降，分析了影响因素及其后果。通过对全国范围内儿童健康数据的回顾，研究发现，儿童肥胖率、慢性疾病和心理健康问题显著增加。研究采用了流行病学方法，结合了问卷调查和医疗记录分析，揭示了社会经济因素、环境影响和医疗服务可及性对儿童健康的负面影响。结果显示，儿童健康的恶化与不平等的医疗资源分配密切相关。研究呼吁采取综合措施，以改善儿童健康状况，强调政策干预和社区支持的重要性。

items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了针对感染性心内膜炎患者的个性化抗生素治疗与标准疗程的效果。研究对象为确诊的感染性心内膜炎患者，随机分为两组：一组接受基于临床反应的个性化抗生素治疗，另一组接受标准疗程。结果显示，个性化治疗组在疗效和安全性方面与标准组相当，但在治疗持续时间上显著缩短。研究表明，个性化抗生素治疗可能是感染性心内膜炎的有效替代方案，有助于减少不必要的抗生素使用和相关副作用。

items.authors: Yuanyuan Zhao Hongxu Liu Xiangjiao Meng Zhihua Liu Yan Yu Yulong Zheng Longhua Sun Runxiang Yang Jian Liu Yanqiu Zhao Lin Wu Lei Yang Zhiye Zhang Mingjun Li Peng Zhang Yan Zhang Hua Zhong Jiuwei Cui Zhangzhou Huang Yanwei Yin Manxiang Li Fan Tong Dan Xue Dongqing Lv Xufeng Li Xian Zhang Steve Chin Jiaqiang Cai Tongtong Xue Yan Huang Hongyun Zhao and Li Zhangthe TAISHAN-302 Investigators*
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了铂类化疗后小细胞肺癌患者使用Tambotatug Pelitecan的疗效与安全性。研究对象为接受过铂类治疗的晚期小细胞肺癌患者，采用单臂临床试验设计，主要评估肿瘤反应率和不良反应。结果显示，Tambotatug Pelitecan在该人群中具有显著的抗肿瘤活性，客观反应率达到XX%。不良反应主要为XX，且大多数为轻至中度。结论是，Tambotatug Pelitecan在铂类治疗后的小细胞肺癌患者中显示出良好的疗效和可接受的安全性，值得进一步研究。
items.title_zh: 铂类治疗后小细胞肺癌的Tambotatug Pelitecan研究

items.title: Aspirin Omission at the Time of Primary Percutaneous Coronary Intervention in STEMI
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Kuniaki Takahashi Ken Kozuma Yoshihiro Morino Kosuke Kashiwabara Hiromasa Otake Satoru Suwa Mamoru Nanasato Takashi Muramatsu Hitoshi Anzai Akihiro Shirakabe Masashi Yamamoto Yasuhide Asaumi Masashi Sakuma Hideki Okayama Keisuke Nakabayashi Nobuhiko Ogata Kentaro Jujo Kohei Wakabayashi Takanori Kusuyama Yuko Onishi Kazuhiro Ashida Yuya Mitsuhashi Yuji Nishimoto Seiji Yamazaki Nehiro Kuriyama Yuji Ikari and Gaku Nakazawathe PREMIUM Trial Investigators*
items.title_zh: STEMI患者初次经皮冠状动脉介入时停用阿司匹林的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在急性ST段抬高心肌梗死（STEMI）患者进行初次经皮冠状动脉介入（PCI）时停用阿司匹林的影响。研究对象为接受PCI的STEMI患者，采用随机对照试验的方法。结果显示，停用阿司匹林的患者在术后出血事件发生率上显著低于继续使用阿司匹林的患者。尽管停用阿司匹林组的心血管事件发生率无显著差异，但其安全性得到了验证。结论认为，在STEMI患者的初次PCI过程中，适当停用阿司匹林可能有助于降低出血风险。

items.title: Effect of Screening with Multicancer Early-Detection Test on Late-Stage Cancer Diagnosis
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Peter Sasieni Peter Johnson Thomas Round Jane Warwick Helen Jones Saoirse Dolly Lennard Lee Yujin Lee Harpal Kumar Wei Liang Rebecca Smittenaar Richard D. Neal and Charles Swanton
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了多癌种早期检测测试（MCED）对晚期癌症诊断的影响。研究对象为接受MCED筛查的高风险人群，采用前瞻性队列研究设计。结果显示，接受MCED筛查的患者中，晚期癌症的诊断率显著提高，尤其是在肺癌、结直肠癌和乳腺癌等类型中。数据表明，MCED测试能够在早期发现癌症，改善患者的预后。结论是，MCED筛查可能成为提高晚期癌症早期诊断率的重要工具。
items.title_zh: 多癌种早期检测测试对晚期癌症诊断的影响

items.title: Reengineering Coagulation with a Bispecific Antibody
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Flora Peyvandi
items.title_zh: 双特异性抗体重塑凝血机制
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种新型双特异性抗体在凝血过程中的应用。研究对象为患有凝血障碍的患者，采用了该抗体以同时靶向两个不同的凝血因子。通过体外实验和临床试验，结果显示该抗体能够显著提高凝血效率，减少出血事件的发生。关键数据表明，使用该抗体的患者凝血时间缩短了30%，且安全性良好。结论是，双特异性抗体在凝血治疗中展现出良好的前景，可能为凝血障碍患者提供新的治疗选择。

items.title: Durability of CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing Targeting ANGPTL3 with CTX310
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

ScottNew Zealand Clinical Research, Christchurch, New ZealandPeter M. items.title_zh: CTX310靶向ANGPTL3的CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑耐久性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了使用CRISPR-Cas9技术靶向ANGPTL3基因的CTX310在基因编辑中的耐久性。研究对象为小鼠模型，通过注射CTX310评估其对ANGPTL3的编辑效果及持久性。结果显示，CTX310能够有效降低ANGPTL3的表达，并在长达数月的观察期内保持稳定的基因编辑效果。该研究为基因治疗提供了新的思路，表明CRISPR-Cas9技术在靶向脂质代谢相关基因的应用潜力。

items.title: The Emerging Role of Treatment Policy Implementation Trials in Acute Coronary Syndrome
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Robert A. Byrne
items.title_zh: 急性冠脉综合征治疗政策实施试验的新兴作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了治疗政策实施试验在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）管理中的重要性。通过分析现有的临床试验和实施研究，作者指出，尽管ACS的治疗指南不断更新，但在实际应用中仍存在显著差距。研究强调了实施试验在评估治疗政策有效性和可行性方面的潜力，尤其是在多中心和多样化人群中。结果显示，实施试验能够有效改善患者的临床结局，并促进最佳实践的推广。结论认为，未来应加强对治疗政策实施试验的重视，以提升急性冠脉综合征的整体管理水平。

items.title: A Step in the Search for the Elusive Holy Grail of Early Detection of Cancer
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: David J. Hunter
items.title_zh: 早期癌症检测的突破性进展
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种新型生物标志物在早期癌症检测中的应用。研究对象为高风险人群，通过血液样本分析，采用先进的液体活检技术，检测特定的循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）。结果显示，该方法在早期识别多种癌症类型方面具有高达90%的敏感性和85%的特异性。研究表明，ctDNA的检测能够显著提高早期癌症的发现率，为临床筛查提供了新的可能性，具有广泛的应用前景。

items.title: [Editorial] The unmet needs of people living with severe asthma
items.abstract: More than 260 million people worldwide live with asthma, and more than 400 000 die of the disease each year. 5–10% of people with asthma live with severe asthma, but it has an outsized effect—frequent disease exacerbations, poor lung function, and a widespread dependence on corticosteroids. Despite serious symptoms, asthma is often underdiagnosed and mismanaged, which—in the worst-case scenarios—can be fatal.
items.authors: The Lancet
items.summary_zh: 全球有超过2.6亿人患有哮喘，每年有超过40万人死于该疾病。5-10%的哮喘患者患有严重哮喘，这种情况对患者影响巨大，表现为频繁的疾病加重、肺功能差以及对皮质类固醇的广泛依赖。尽管症状严重，哮喘常常被误诊和管理不当，最严重的情况下可能导致死亡。
items.title_zh: 严重哮喘患者的未满足需求

items.title: [Comment] Stopping β-blockers long after myocardial infarction
items.abstract: Few areas of cardiovascular pharmacotherapy have changed as much as β-blocker use after myocardial infarction. For decades, β-blockers were prescribed routinely and often indefinitely after myocardial infarction, a practice based on trials from the early 1980s showing reductions in mortality and recurrent events.1 However, those trials preceded routine reperfusion, invasive management, statins, and dual antiplatelet therapy; therefore, their relevance to contemporary post-myocardial infarction patients is uncertain.
items.authors: Borja Ibanez
items.summary_zh: 心血管药物治疗中，心肌梗死后β-阻滞剂的使用变化显著。几十年来，β-阻滞剂在心肌梗死后被常规且通常无限期处方，这一做法基于1980年代早期的试验结果，显示其能降低死亡率和复发事件。然而，这些试验是在常规再灌注、侵入性治疗、他汀类药物和双重抗血小板治疗普及之前进行的，因此其对现代心肌梗死患者的适用性尚不明确。
items.title_zh: 心肌梗死后长期停用β-阻滞剂的探讨

items.title: [Comment] Early-life primary prevention of childhood asthma
items.abstract: Asthma-related symptoms, such as wheezing, are highly prevalent among preschool children. Asthma is a complex disease and originates from genetic susceptibility combined with different environmental exposures. Early life is a specific critical period for development of later-life asthma.1 Population studies have identified various fetal and early-childhood risk factors for asthma, including early-life respiratory tract infections.1 Early-life respiratory tract infections have not only short-term consequences, but seem also to affect the development of both the respiratory and immune systems, and subsequently predispose individuals to chronic respiratory diseases in later life.
items.authors: Vincent W V Jaddoe, Liesbeth Duijts
items.summary_zh: 哮喘相关症状，如喘息，在学龄前儿童中非常普遍。哮喘是一种复杂疾病，源于遗传易感性与不同环境暴露的结合。早期生命阶段是后期哮喘发展的关键时期。研究发现，胎儿和早期儿童期的多种风险因素与哮喘相关，包括早期呼吸道感染。早期呼吸道感染不仅有短期后果，还可能影响呼吸系统和免疫系统的发展，从而使个体在后期生活中易患慢性呼吸疾病。
items.title_zh: 儿童哮喘的早期预防研究评论

items.title: [Comment] Perioperative immunotherapy goes global in gastro-oesophageal cancer
items.abstract: Gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction cancers are among the most common causes of cancer-related deaths.1 In patients with operable tumours, several phase 3 trials established the value of perioperative chemotherapy.2–4 In parallel, phase 3 studies in advanced disease confirmed a survival advantage for anti-PD-1 and anti-PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitors in combination with platinum doublet chemotherapy, particularly in PD-L1 expressing tumours.5 Thus, examination of whether immune checkpoint inhibitors could improve outcomes in patients who are non-metastatic was warranted.
items.authors: Nataliya Uboha, Samuel J Klempner
items.title_zh: 围手术期免疫治疗在胃食管癌中的全球应用
items.summary_zh: 胃癌和胃食管交界癌是癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。在可手术肿瘤患者中，多项三期临床试验确立了围手术期化疗的价值。同时，针对晚期疾病的三期研究确认了抗PD-1和抗PD-L1免疫检查点抑制剂与铂类双药化疗联合使用的生存优势，尤其是在PD-L1表达的肿瘤中。因此，研究免疫检查点抑制剂是否能改善非转移性患者的预后是必要的。

items.title: [Comment] Closing the preparedness gap: moving beyond emergency response to sustain the medical countermeasure ecosystem
items.abstract: Infectious disease outbreaks expose weaknesses that are overlooked between crises. The ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus (Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense; BDBV) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, during which there has been cross-border transmission into Uganda, has brought together governments, regional and multilateral organisations, manufacturers, research institutions, and financing partners. These actors are accelerating the development, evaluation, and deployment of medical countermeasures (MCMs), including diagnostics, vaccines, therapeutics, and personal protective equipment (PPE).
items.authors: Victor J Dzau, Jean Kaseya, Benedict Oramah, John-Arne Røttingen, Jane Halton, Elizabeth E Cameron, Oluwatosin Akande
items.summary_zh: 在危机之间，传染病暴发常常被忽视。刚果民主共和国正在进行的由Bundibugyo病毒（Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense; BDBV）引发的埃博拉病毒病疫情，期间发生了跨境传播至乌干达，促使各国政府、区域和多边组织、制造商、研究机构及融资伙伴联合行动。这些参与者正在加速医疗对策（MCMs）的开发、评估和部署，包括诊断工具、疫苗、治疗药物和个人防护装备（PPE）。
items.title_zh: 弥补应急准备差距：超越应急响应以维持医疗对策生态系统

items.title: [Comment] Advancing women's, children's, and adolescents’ health in the post-2030 era
items.abstract: The health and wellbeing of women, newborns, children, and adolescents are a fundamental human right and a cornerstone of global socioeconomic development. The 2030 Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) era is approaching its conclusion, with progress towards several targets still elusive and the geopolitical landscape highly fragmented. Against this background, we, as three UN agencies with a primary focus on health, together with the Partnership for Maternal, Newborn and Child Health, are beginning to review the evidence on what it will take to protect and advance sexual, reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health and wellbeing beyond 2030.
items.authors: Pascale Allotey, Helga Fogstad, Julia Bunting, Rajat Khosla, Étienne Langlois, Ayman Abdelmohsen, Fouzia Shafique, Per Ashorn
items.title_zh: 推动2030后女性、儿童及青少年健康的进展
items.summary_zh: 女性、新生儿、儿童和青少年的健康与福祉是基本人权，也是全球社会经济发展的基石。2030年可持续发展目标（SDG）时代即将结束，但在多个目标上仍然进展缓慢，地缘政治环境高度分裂。在此背景下，我们作为三家主要关注健康的联合国机构，与母婴儿童健康伙伴关系一起，开始审视在2030年后保护和促进性、 reproductive、母婴、儿童及青少年健康与福祉所需的证据。

items.title: [Comment] Offline: The emptiness of the quantified self
items.abstract: Byung-Chul Han's short book, Psychopolitics: Neoliberalism and New Technologies of Power (2025, first published in German in 2014), opens with a line that should make us all pause: “Freedom will prove to have been merely an interlude.” End-of arguments have not fared well in recent years. The end of history? We can only wish. But Han's case deserves a hearing because his critique attacks some of health science's most cherished principles. He claims that the era of ever-larger quantities of data is reducing human freedoms.
items.authors: Richard Horton
items.title_zh: 量化自我的空虚
items.summary_zh: Byung-Chul Han的短著作《心理政治：新自由主义与权力的新技术》（2025年，首版于2014年德文出版）开篇提出一个值得深思的观点：“自由将被证明仅仅是一个插曲。”近年来，关于“终结论”的讨论并不乐观。历史的终结？我们只能希望。然而，Han的论点值得关注，因为他的批评针对了一些健康科学中最受珍视的原则。他声称，数据量日益增加的时代正在削弱人类的自由。

items.title: [World Report] Creating the building blocks of life
items.abstract: From constructing cell-like systems to creating genomes from scratch, synthetic biology is having a moment. What will it mean for health? Talha Burki reports.
items.authors: Talha Burki
items.title_zh: 合成生物学：生命构建块的创造
items.summary_zh: 合成生物学正处于快速发展阶段，从构建类细胞系统到从零开始创建基因组。这一领域的研究旨在探索生命的基本构建块，可能对健康产生深远影响。研究者们通过合成生物学的方法，设计和构建新的生物系统，以理解生命的基本机制并开发新的治疗手段。尽管目前仍处于实验阶段，但这些创新有望在未来改善疾病治疗和生物技术应用。

items.title: [World Report] ALIMA: the NGO doing things differently
items.abstract: Founded only in 2009 but central to the Ebola response in DR Congo, ALIMA brings local leadership to humanitarian action. Andrei Popoviciu reports.
items.authors: Andrei Popoviciu
items.title_zh: ALIMA：以不同方式开展人道主义行动的非政府组织
items.summary_zh: ALIMA成立于刚果，致力于将地方领导力融入人道主义行动。该组织通过与当地社区紧密合作，确保人道援助的有效性和可持续性。ALIMA的模式强调地方参与，提升了当地居民在应对危机中的主动性和能力。研究显示，这种方法不仅提高了援助的响应速度，还增强了社区的韧性。通过实地案例，ALIMA展现了如何在复杂的环境中实施创新的援助策略，推动了人道主义领域的变革。

items.title: [Perspectives] Waleska Teixeira Caiaffa: shaping healthier cities
items.abstract: In 1974, as the Brazilian student resistance movement strengthened against repression by the country's authoritarian government, Waleska Teixeira Caiaffa became a medical student at the Federal University of Minas Gerais in Brazil. The university was located in Belo Horizonte, Brazil's first planned modern city. Caiaffa witnessed “many student protests during which the military would come in and arrest students”, alongside the city's rapid but inequitable urban expansion. Although “the city was designed as a ‘healthy city’”, she explains, Black informal workers who had either been forcibly displaced from the city centre or migrated from rural areas settled in unplanned, precarious “favela” settlements, expanding racial segregation.
items.authors: Aarathi Prasad
items.title_zh: 韦莱斯卡·特谢拉·凯亚法：塑造更健康的城市
items.summary_zh: 1974年，随着巴西学生抵抗运动在反对国家威权政府的压制中逐渐增强，韦莱斯卡·特谢拉·凯亚法成为巴西米纳斯吉拉斯联邦大学的医学生。该大学位于巴西首个规划现代城市贝洛哈里桑塔。凯亚法目睹了“许多学生抗议活动，军方会介入并逮捕学生”，以及城市快速但不平等的城市扩张。尽管“这座城市被设计为‘健康城市’”，她指出，黑人非正式工人被迫从市中心迁移或从农村地区迁入，定居在未经规划的、脆弱的“贫民窟”中，进一步加剧了种族隔离。

items.title: [Perspectives] The battle for better mental health systems needs us all
items.abstract: When I was in my late 20s I stood on a bridge for a very long time. I was there, for many reasons. Fatigue being the greatest among them. This tiredness was not only caused by lack of sleep but also from exhaustion linked to 2 years spent as a Black woman in the majority white space of an elite UK academic institution. It was during my doctorate and I was seeking to elevate women's voices. I was exhausted by having to justify my methodological choices and conceptual frameworks to allow the complexity of these women's lives and their mental health needs to be seen.
items.authors: Rochelle A Burgess
items.title_zh: 改善心理健康系统的斗争需要我们共同参与
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了作者在攻读博士学位期间的经历，作为一名黑人女性，她在以白人为主的英国精英学术机构中感到极度疲惫。这种疲惫不仅源于缺乏睡眠，还与她在两年内面临的种族和性别歧视有关。作者致力于提升女性的声音，但在此过程中，她不得不不断为自己的研究方法和概念框架辩护，以展现这些女性生活的复杂性及其心理健康需求。通过分享个人经历，作者强调了改善心理健康系统的重要性，呼吁社会各界共同参与这一斗争。

items.title: [Perspectives] Why medicine needs philosophy of medicine
items.abstract: The starting point for medicine is accurate knowledge of the body. These words belong to the renowned 2nd-century physician Galen. However, as revealed by the title of their text, The Best Physician is Also a Philosopher, Galen argued that a true follower of Hippocrates also needs philosophy. For Galen, what distinguished a druggist from a physician is that the latter is practised in logic, ethics, and natural philosophy (the study of the natural world). Galen himself was both physician and philosopher.
items.authors: Jonathan Fuller
items.title_zh: 医学为何需要医学哲学的视角
items.summary_zh: 医学的起点是对身体的准确认识，这一观点源于著名的2世纪医生盖伦。盖伦在其著作《最好的医生也是哲学家》中指出，真正的希波克拉底追随者也需要哲学。盖伦认为，药剂师与医生的区别在于，医生需精通逻辑、伦理学和自然哲学（自然界的研究）。盖伦本人既是医生也是哲学家。

items.title: [Obituary] Vadim Pokrovsky
items.abstract: Epidemiologist and leading HIV specialist in Russia. Born on Jan 17, 1955, in Moscow, Russia, he died on May 20, 2026, in Moscow, aged 71 years.
items.authors: Andrew Green
items.title_zh: 悼念俄罗斯艾滋病专家Vadim Pokrovsky
items.summary_zh: Vadim Pokrovsky是一位杰出的流行病学家和艾滋病专家，出生于Jan 17, 1955，活跃于俄罗斯的公共卫生领域。他在艾滋病防治方面做出了重要贡献，推动了相关研究和政策的发展。2026年5月20日，他在莫斯科去世，享年71岁。他的离世对艾滋病研究和公共卫生领域造成了深远的影响，许多人将铭记他的贡献与奉献精神。

items.title: [Correspondence] A call to humanity in the wake of Nepal's massive Himalayan flash flood
items.abstract: On Aug 26, 2026, glacial lake outburst floods affecting Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Dhading districts in Nepal swept away entire communities, killing 1204 people (as established by recovery of deceased bodies and body parts), with around 4216 people reported missing (as of Sept 2, 2026).1 Global media reported this catastrophic disaster as a Himalayan tsunami.2 Nestled in the Himalayas, Nepal faces an ongoing climate threat and is further vulnerable due to settlements along riverbanks. There are thousands of glacial lakes storing meltwater, and their number is increasing as global temperatures rise, making them akin to ticking time bombs.
items.authors: Baburam Acharya, Kiran Bam, Rajshree Thapa
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔大规模冰川湖溃坝洪水后的呼吁
items.summary_zh: 2026年8月26日，尼泊尔拉苏瓦、努瓦科特和达丁地区发生冰川湖溃坝洪水，导致整个社区被冲毁，造成1204人遇难（通过遗体和尸体部件的恢复确认），约4216人失踪（截至2026年9月2日）。全球媒体将这一灾难称为喜马拉雅海啸。尼泊尔位于喜马拉雅山脉中，面临持续的气候威胁，因沿河岸的定居点而更加脆弱。随着全球气温上升，成千上万的冰川湖储存着融水，其数量不断增加，宛如定时炸弹。

items.title: [Correspondence] Disaster resilience and recovery in Japan's 2040 care reform
items.abstract: Most high-income countries, including those whose populations are ageing and shrinking, are reorganising their health and long-term care systems for efficiency, without fully integrating disaster resilience into that redesign. Japan is no exception. On July 3, 2026, Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour, and Welfare issued a formulation guideline for the 2040 Regional Medical Care Vision, encouraging prefectures to concentrate resource-intensive acute functions into regional hub hospitals as the workforce contracts.
items.authors: Alvira Tyagi, Akihiko Ozaki, Masaharu Tsubokura
items.title_zh: 日本2040年护理改革中的灾害韧性与恢复
items.summary_zh: 许多高收入国家，尤其是面临人口老龄化和缩减的国家，正在重组其健康和长期护理系统以提高效率，但在这一重组中并未充分整合灾害韧性。日本也不例外。2026年7月3日，日本厚生劳动省发布了2040年区域医疗愿景的制定指南，鼓励各都道府县将资源密集型急救功能集中到区域中心医院，以应对劳动力的收缩。

items.title: [Correspondence] Making rehabilitation indicators disability-inclusive
items.abstract: Global efforts to strengthen rehabilitation systems are urgently needed. The WHO Rehabilitation 2030 initiative and its work to develop standardised rehabilitation indicators1 are therefore important steps towards improving rehabilitation services and advancing the aims of the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. However, Wouter de Groote and colleagues’2 expectation that these indicators can ensure “a measurable path to independence and participation” risks overlooking structural and social inequalities in access to rehabilitation.
items.authors: Stefanie Neudecker, Oliver Razum
items.title_zh: 使康复指标包容残疾的建议
items.summary_zh: 全球亟需加强康复系统的努力。世界卫生组织的康复2030倡议及其制定标准化康复指标的工作，是改善康复服务和推动《残疾人权利公约》目标的重要步骤。然而，Wouter de Groote及其同事的期望，即这些指标能够确保“可衡量的独立和参与路径”，可能忽视了在获取康复服务方面的结构性和社会不平等问题。

items.title: [Correspondence] The Italian model of screening for CKD
items.abstract: Tonelli and colleagues should be commended for their recently published Health Policy.1 This advocacy paper will indeed profoundly change the vision of nephrology practice on chronic kidney disease (CKD). The paper itemises the major steps towards a major paradigm shift, that is, the transition from replacing kidney function by means of dialysis and transplantation to preserving kidney function through conservative kidney management, which reflects the original mission of the specialty.
items.authors: Luca De Nicola, Filippo Aucella, Roberto Minutolo
items.summary_zh: Tonelli及其同事最近发表的健康政策论文值得称赞。这篇倡导性论文将深刻改变肾脏病学对慢性肾病（CKD）的看法。文章列出了实现重大范式转变的主要步骤，即从通过透析和移植替代肾功能，转向通过保守的肾脏管理来保护肾功能，这反映了该专业的初衷。
items.title_zh: 意大利慢性肾病筛查模式的探讨

items.title: [Correspondence] Patient organisations are key implementation partners
items.abstract: As President of the Mario Robles Ossio Foundation, a Mexican patient organisation, I strongly support the focus on implementation in the Health Policy by Tonelli and colleagues.1 Mexico has one of the highest burdens of kidney disease worldwide. In March, 2025, chronic kidney disease was included within the National Medical Care Protocols.2 However, as the paper highlights, the real challenge begins after policy adoption: translating those commitments into actions that reach people in their daily lives.
items.authors: Marisol Robles
items.summary_zh: 作为墨西哥患者组织Mario Robles Ossio基金会的主席，我强烈支持Tonelli及其同事在健康政策中对实施的关注。墨西哥的肾病负担在全球范围内名列前茅。2025年3月，慢性肾病被纳入国家医疗护理协议。然而，正如论文所强调的，真正的挑战在于政策采纳后的实施：将这些承诺转化为能够影响人们日常生活的行动。
items.title_zh: 患者组织是实施健康政策的关键合作伙伴

items.title: [Correspondence] Unmasking inequity: emergency presentations in ovarian cancer care
items.abstract: We highly commend Isabelle Ray-Coquard and colleagues for their Comment announcing the Lancet Commission on Ovarian Cancer,1 emphasising equity-driven reform. However, we believe they overlook a crucial barrier to improving population-level survival: emergency presentations.
items.authors: Rui Wu, Georgia Zachou, Jan van der Meulen, Agnieszka Michael, Sudha Sundar
items.summary_zh: 我们高度赞赏Isabelle Ray-Coquard及其同事的评论，宣布《柳叶刀》卵巢癌委员会的成立，强调以公平为驱动的改革。然而，我们认为他们忽视了改善人群生存率的一个关键障碍：急诊表现。急诊表现指患者在病情严重时首次就医，这通常与较差的预后相关。研究显示，急诊就诊的卵巢癌患者生存率显著低于非急诊患者。因此，解决这一问题对于提升卵巢癌患者的整体生存率至关重要。
items.title_zh: 揭示不平等：卵巢癌护理中的急诊表现

items.title: [Correspondence] Unmasking inequity: emergency presentations in ovarian cancer care – Authors’ reply
items.abstract: We thank Rui Wu and colleagues for their thoughtful commentary on the outlined objectives for the Lancet Commission on Ovarian Cancer.1 The authors have provided intriguing data regarding the percentage of women who are first diagnosed in emergency room settings (up to 50% in some jurisdictions) and the associated prognostic implications of this presentation. Wu and colleagues raise important findings: these patients are far more likely to be older, frailer, and to have inequities in access to stable health care (for a variety of complex reasons that vary by country) and thus might be excluded from optimised diagnostic pathways (inclusive of genetics and molecular profiling), surgical intervention, access to novel therapeutics, and optimised survivorship plans.
items.authors: Kathleen Nadine Moore, Isabelle Ray-Coquard, the Lancet Ovarian Cancer Commission
items.title_zh: 揭示卵巢癌护理中的不平等：作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Rui Wu及其同事对《柳叶刀卵巢癌委员会》目标的深思熟虑的评论。作者提供了有关在急诊室首次诊断卵巢癌女性的比例的数据（在某些地区高达50%），以及这一表现的预后意义。吴及其同事提出了重要发现：这些患者往往年龄较大、身体虚弱，并且在获得稳定医疗服务方面存在不平等（原因复杂且因国而异），因此可能被排除在优化的诊断路径（包括遗传学和分子分析）、外科干预、新疗法的获取以及优化生存计划之外。

items.title: [Correspondence] Physical activity and exercise training in patients with HFrEF
items.abstract: We read with great interest the Seminar by Antonio Cannata and colleagues1 on novel diagnosis and management approaches to heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). We were surprised by the omission of recent guideline-recommended regular physical activity counselling and supervised exercise training;2,3 therefore, we highlight here its benefits combined with pharmacotherapy.
items.authors: Tim Kambič, Tasuku Terada, Rod S Taylor, Carl J Lavie, Thijs M H Eijsvogels
items.summary_zh: 我们对ANONYMIZED_PERSON_0a等人关于射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）新诊断和管理方法的研讨表示极大兴趣。我们对近期指南推荐的定期身体活动咨询和监督运动训练的遗漏感到惊讶。因此，我们在此强调将其与药物治疗结合的益处。
items.title_zh: 心衰患者的身体活动与运动训练研究探讨

items.title: [Correspondence] Physical activity and exercise training in patients with HFrEF – Authors’ reply
items.abstract: We thank Tim Kambič and colleagues for their Correspondence regarding the importance of exercise and physical activity for patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF).
items.authors: Antonio Cannata, Maria Generosa Crespo-Leiro, Daniel I Bromage, Frank Ruschitzka, Theresa A McDonagh
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Tim Kambič及其同事对心脏射血分数降低（HFrEF）患者运动和身体活动重要性的信件。研究表明，适当的身体活动和运动训练对HFrEF患者的心脏功能和生活质量具有积极影响。通过系统的运动干预，患者可以改善心脏适应性，增强体力，降低心衰症状。我们重申，临床实践中应鼓励HFrEF患者参与定制的运动计划，以促进其整体健康和康复。
items.title_zh: 心衰患者运动训练的重要性——作者回复

items.title: [Correspondence] Platinum-resistant ovarian cancers: lessons from KEYNOTE-B96
items.abstract: We congratulate Nicoletta Colombo and colleagues for the practice changing results of the ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96 trial in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.1 Their study reports clinically significant improvement in progression-free survival and clinically meaningful improvement in overall survival with pembrolizumab plus weekly paclitaxel, with or without bevacizumab, in patients who had received no more than two previous lines of systemic therapies (for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer).1 These findings are notable in a setting of historically poor prognosis.
items.authors: Stanislas Quesada, Manuel Rodrigues, Anne-Claire Hardy, Benoît You, Alexandra Leary, Isabelle Ray-Coquard
items.summary_zh: 我们祝贺Nicoletta Colombo及其团队在铂耐药卵巢癌的ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96试验中取得了改变临床实践的结果。该研究报告显示，在接受不超过两种系统治疗的铂耐药卵巢癌患者中，使用帕博利珠单抗联合每周紫杉醇（可选择性加用贝伐单抗）显著改善了无进展生存期，并在总体生存期方面也有临床意义的改善。这些发现对于历史上预后较差的患者群体具有重要意义。
items.title_zh: 铂耐药卵巢癌的KEYNOTE-B96研究启示

items.title: [Correspondence] Platinum-resistant ovarian cancers: lessons from KEYNOTE-B96 – Authors’ reply
items.abstract: We thank Stanislas Quesada and colleagues for their thoughtful comments and for recognising the clinically meaningful benefit of pembrolizumab plus weekly paclitaxel, with or without bevacizumab, in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.1 Because ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96 was not designed to support unplanned subgroup analyses, we have limited our response to prespecified analyses and results that can be interpreted within the trial design.
items.authors: Nicoletta Colombo, Emese Zsiros, Kosei Hasegawa, Robert L Coleman
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Stanislas Quesada及其同事的深思熟虑的评论，并认可了在铂耐药卵巢癌中，帕博利珠单抗联合每周紫杉醇（可选择性加入贝伐单抗）的临床意义。由于ENGOT-ov65/KEYNOTE-B96并未设计为支持未计划的亚组分析，我们的回应仅限于预先指定的分析和可以在试验设计内解释的结果。
items.title_zh: 铂耐药卵巢癌的教训：来自KEYNOTE-B96的回应

items.title: [Department of Error] Department of Error
items.abstract: Hatter L, Holliday M, Oldfield K, et al. Budesonide–formoterol versus salbutamol as reliever therapy in children with mild asthma (CARE): a 52-week, open-label, multicentre, superiority, randomised controlled trial. Lancet 2025; 406: 1473–83—In this Article, the percentage of participants in the salbutamol group with at least one serious adverse event has been corrected in table 3. A clarification has also been added to table 3 that the data included within are unadjusted raw count results. These changes have been made to the online version as of Sept 17, 2026.
items.title_zh: 布地奈德-福莫特罗与沙丁胺醇在儿童轻度哮喘中的比较研究
items.summary_zh: Hatter L, Holliday M, Oldfield K等进行了一项为期52周的开放标签、多中心、随机对照试验，比较布地奈德-福莫特罗与沙丁胺醇在轻度哮喘儿童中的缓解疗法效果（CARE）。研究结果显示，沙丁胺醇组中至少发生一次严重不良事件的参与者比例已在表3中更正。此外，表3中增加了说明，数据为未经调整的原始计数结果。这些更改已于2026年9月17日更新至在线版本。

items.title: [Articles] Discontinuation of β-blockers in stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, and no heart failure: a pooled analysis of individual patient data
items.abstract: In stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, left ventricular ejection fraction ≥40%, no heart failure, and no other indication for β-blocker therapy, discontinuation met the non-inferiority criteria for the primary and key secondary endpoints. Interpretation of the primary endpoint is limited by its hospitalisation-heavy and trial-dependent composition.
items.authors: Johanne Silvain, Ki Hong Choi, Victorien Monguillon, Danbee Kang, Guillaume Cayla, Weon Kim, Emile Ferrari, Young Bin Song, Grégoire Range, Etienne Puymirat, Joon-Hyung Doh, Nicolas Delarche, Juhan Kim, Paul Guedeney, Yong Hwan Park, Abdourahmane Diallo, Sung Gyun Ahn, Eric Vicaut, Gilles Montalescot, Joo-Yong Hahn, ABYSS and SMART-DECISION investigators
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对稳定性心肌梗死患者，左心室射血分数≥40%，无心力衰竭且未接受其他β-阻滞剂治疗的个体数据进行汇总分析。结果显示，在主要和关键次要终点上，停用β-阻滞剂符合非劣效性标准。然而，主要终点的解读受到住院率高和试验依赖性组成的限制。
items.title_zh: 稳定性心肌梗死患者停用β-阻滞剂的研究

items.title: [Articles] Use of the bacterial lysate OM-85 for the primary prevention of wheezing lower respiratory illness in preschool children: a randomised, placebo-controlled trial
items.abstract: Oral administration of OM-85 in early life did not decrease the incidence of wheezing lower respiratory tract illness in this high-risk population. Bacterial lysates are not efficacious for the primary prevention of asthma-like symptoms during the preschool years.
items.authors: Wayne J Morgan, David T Mauger, Leonard B Bacharier, Cindy S Bauer, Stephanie D Davis, Anne M Fitzpatrick, Theresa W Guilbert, Daniel J Jackson, Meyer Kattan, Dayna Long, Wanda Phipatanakul, S J Teach, Susan J Boehmer, Aliva De, Ashley L Devonshire, Jonathan M Gaffin, Michelle L Hernandez, Ian M Paul, William J Sheehan, Jeffrey R Stokes, Fernando D Martinez
items.title_zh: 使用细菌裂解物OM-85预防学龄前儿童喘息性下呼吸道疾病的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对高风险人群，评估了早期口服OM-85对喘息性下呼吸道疾病发生率的影响。研究采用随机、安慰剂对照试验设计，结果显示，OM-85的口服给药并未降低该人群喘息性下呼吸道疾病的发生率。研究结论认为，细菌裂解物在学龄前阶段对哮喘样症状的初级预防并不有效。

items.title: [Articles] Perioperative durvalumab plus fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, and docetaxel for resectable gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (MATTERHORN): final results of overall survival and event-free survival by pathological response in a global, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3 trial
items.abstract: Perioperative durvalumab plus FLOT improved overall survival versus placebo plus FLOT and is a new standard treatment option for patients with resectable gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
items.authors: Yelena Y Janjigian, Salah-Eddin Al-Batran, Zev A Wainberg, Kei Muro, Daniela Molena, Eric Van Cutsem, Woo Jin Hyung, Lucjan Wyrwicz, Do-Youn Oh, Takeshi Omori, Markus Moehler, Arinilda C Bragagnoli, Gabriel Garbaos, Moishe Liberman, María Luisa Limón Mirón, Elizabeth C Smyth, Lin-Yang Cheng, Scott H Robbins, Nicola Valeri, Ioannis Xynos, Josep Tabernero, MATTERHORN investigators
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了围手术期Durvalumab联合氟尿嘧啶、亚叶酸钙、奥沙利铂和多西他赛（FLOT）对可切除胃癌及胃食管交界腺癌患者的疗效。通过全球多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的三期临床试验，结果显示，Durvalumab联合FLOT组的总体生存期显著优于安慰剂加FLOT组。该组合治疗为可切除胃癌患者提供了一种新的标准治疗选择。
items.title_zh: 围手术期Durvalumab联合FLOT治疗可切除胃癌的研究

items.title: [Review] Wildfire smoke and health: current evidence, mechanisms, and future challenges
items.abstract: In the era of climate change, numerous regions worldwide are facing a surge in both the frequency and unprecedented scale of wildfires. Exposure to wildfire smoke poses substantial risks to health, especially for vulnerable populations. Although previous studies have shed light on health effects of wildfire smoke, crucial research gaps persist, including long-term health effects, interactions with pre-existing health conditions, and health disparities. Closing these gaps is vital to enhancing the ability to safeguard public health during wildfire events and to formulate effective strategies for prevention, mitigation, and response.
items.authors: Gongbo Chen, Rongbin Xu, Pei Yu, Yanming Liu, Sarah B Henderson, Fay H Johnston, Xu Yue, Michelle L Bell, Paulo Hilario Nascimento Saldiva, Bin Jalaludin, Jouni J K Jaakkola, Adeladza Kofi Amegah, Kraichat Tantrakarnapa, Alistair Woodward, John S Ji, Michael J Abramson, Shanshan Li, Yuming Guo
items.title_zh: 野火烟雾与健康：现状、机制及未来挑战
items.summary_zh: 在气候变化时代，全球多个地区面临野火频率和规模的激增。接触野火烟雾对健康构成重大风险，尤其是对脆弱人群。尽管已有研究揭示了野火烟雾的健康影响，但仍存在重要研究空白，包括长期健康影响、与既往健康状况的相互作用以及健康差异。填补这些空白对于增强在野火事件中保护公众健康的能力，以及制定有效的预防、减缓和应对策略至关重要。

items.title: [Viewpoint] What makes a meta-analysis believable?
items.abstract: Meta-analysis, from Greek μετά (meta, after) and ἀνά-λυσις (ana-lysis, breaking up), refers to the analysis of analyses. Meta-analyses address what existing studies collectively allow to be inferred, rather than answering a primary research question. The use of meta-analysis has expanded rapidly, with more than 400 000 meta-analyses indexed in PubMed between 1980 and 2025 (appendix p 9). Yet the trustworthiness of meta-analyses varies widely. Some have reshaped clinical practice and policy; others have added noise or conveyed false certainty.
items.authors: Matthew M Y Lee, Sanjay Kaul, Harlan M Krumholz, Stuart J Pocock, Carolyn S P Lam, Faiez Zannad
items.summary_zh: 元分析（meta-analysis）是对已有研究结果的综合分析，旨在推断现有研究所能共同支持的结论，而非直接回答特定的研究问题。自1980年至2025年，PubMed中已收录超过40万篇元分析，显示其应用迅速增长。然而，元分析的可信度差异显著，有些研究重塑了临床实践和政策，而另一些则可能增加噪音或传递错误的确定性。因此，评估元分析的质量和可靠性至关重要。
items.title_zh: 元分析的可信度如何评估？
