In an interacting bilayer model, combined reflection--time-reversal symmetry or a nonsymmorphic particle--hole symmetry forces the QGD matrix to be traceless at every momentum while allowing it to remain nonzero. A two-band exciton subspace with zero net internal dipole then decomposes into a symmetry-related pair of exciton Wannier functions with opposite center-of-mass positions and internal dipoles. Adding the interlayer dipole as a Clifford component further separates intralayer and interlayer exciton Wannier functions in a six-band subspace.
items.authors: Haylen Gerhard, Wladimir A. Benalcazar

items.title: Light-Driven Ultrafast Control of Time-Reversal Symmetry in SrTiO3
items.abstract: Light-driven control of material symmetry enables the engineering of phenomena forbidden in equilibrium. Although electromagnetic fields have been used to break time-reversal symmetry, its dynamic control on ultrafast timescales in nonmagnetic insulating oxides remains virtually unexplored. Here, we demonstrate simultaneous magnetic symmetry lowering and timereversal-symmetry breaking in cubic SrTiO3 driven by an off-resonant, elliptically polarized THz pulse. Second harmonic generation (SHG) polarimetry reveals emergent SHG circular dichroism inconsistent with third-order nonlinear processes under cubic m3m symmetry. The SHG polar patterns exhibit mirror-symmetry breaking, indicating a transient reduction to tetragonal 4/mm'm' magnetic symmetry. Furthermore, the SHG response scales linearly with the angular momentum of THz pulse, providing direct evidence for THz-field-induced timereversal-symmetry breaking. These results establish a direct pathway for ultrafast symmetry control in non-magnetic oxides, enabling dynamic manipulation of emergent phases on ultrafast timescales.
items.authors: In Hyeok Choi, Sergei Urazhdin, Shivasheesh Varshney, Seung Gyo Jeong, Bharat Jalan, Keith A. Nelson

items.title: Assessing foundational atomistic models for iron alloys under Earth's core conditions
items.abstract: We assess the capability of recently developed foundational atomistic models (FAMs) to simulate iron alloys under the extreme pressures and temperatures of Earth's core. Static equations of state for hexagonal close-packed (hcp) and body-centered cubic (bcc) iron, computed using 17 FAMs, are benchmarked against ab initio calculations. Two representative models, MatterSim and MACE, are further evaluated for their ability to reproduce phonon spectra, liquid structure, and melting relations of iron at core conditions. While both models capture several key properties, MACE substantially overestimates the stability of bcc iron and fails to correctly describe the stability of hcp iron. Their performance is also examined for binary liquids, superionic phases, and a seven-component Fe-Ni-Si-S-O-H-C liquid. Although these FAMs were not explicitly trained on data from core conditions, they can reproduce several structural and dynamical properties across a wide range of compositions. However, none of the tested models consistently reproduces all first-principles benchmarks. By analyzing the origins of these discrepancies, we identify several limitations of current FAMs, particularly the lack of an explicit treatment of thermal electronic excitations, which significantly affect phase stability and thermodynamic properties under core conditions. We further discuss directions for improving FAMs to enable predictive simulations of core-forming materials under extreme conditions.
items.authors: Tianqi Wan, Liangrui Wei, Zepeng Wu, Renata M. Wentzcovitch, Yang Sun

items.title: Concurrent enforcement of polyconvexity and true-stress-true-strain monotonicity in incompressible isotropic hyperelasticity: application to neural network constitutive models
items.abstract: The design of physics-augmented neural networks (PANNs) for the purposes of constitutive modeling has received considerable attention as of late for a variety of material behaviors. Here, we revisit the classical framework of isotropic incompressible hyperelasticity in light of recent advances in the study of constitutive inequalities. We show that polyconvexity implies true-stress-true-strain monotonicity for a large class of incompressible strain-energy functions. The resulting elastic law obeys the physically reasonable Legendre-Hadamard (or ellipticity) condition as well as the notion of increasing stress with increasing strain. These results then inform the architecture of four distinct PANNs which are subsequently calibrated to three different sets of experimental data each. We show that different PANN parametrizations - satisfying the same constitutive constraints a priori - have varying approximation power for the description of material behavior. Moreover, even when distinct parametrizations perform comparatively well within the calibration regime, they show pronounced differences in extrapolation. This observation motivates a critical discussion about the predictive power of PANNs which also has implications for the modeling of more complex material behavior by virtue of neural networks.
items.authors: Maximilian P. Wollner, Dominik K. Klein, Herbert Baaser, Gerhard A. Holzapfel, Patrizio Neff

items.title: The Localized 12-hour Wave Over Alaska: Leveraging Meridional Wind Measurements From the Sodium Lidar
items.abstract: The 12-h wave in meridional winds in the mesosphere and lower thermosphere (MLT) during the solar minimum 2018-2019 Arctic winter is investigated using sodium lidar observations at Poker Flat Research Range (PFRR), Chatanika, Alaska (64N,147W). Nightly 12-h wave amplitudes increased significantly during December-January, with amplitudes exceeding 130 m/s above 97 km on several days. This was more than double the 12-h wave amplitudes observed outside this time period. Meteor radar winds over Chatanika also showed significant increase in meridional wind 12-h wave amplitudes at altitudes between 82 and 97 km during this time period with lower amplitudes than lidar measurements. The strong variation in 12-h wave amplitudes was not correlated with SME index, though the largest amplitudes coincided with the sudden stratospheric warming (SSW) in early January. Measurements were compared to a seasonal WACCM-X model run and four days of HIAMCM. For the four dates of available HIAMCM data, 12-h wave amplitudes over Chatanika were found to be similar between both HIAMCM and WACCM-X and the lidar below 97 km, with amplitudes measured by lidar exceeding the models at altitudes between 97-105 km. All measurements followed a similar seasonal trend with increasing amplitudes at the end of December/early January. Fits of SW2 from WACCM-X show the SW2 tidal amplitude following similar seasonal trends to 12-h wave measurements. These high-resolution lidar measurements indicate that localized 12-h wave amplitudes are larger than previously reported by studies using meteor radar measurements.
items.authors: Sophie R. Phillips (Arizona State University), Katrina Bossert (Arizona State University), Komal Kumari (University of Illinois - Urbana-Champaign), Erich Becker (NorthWest Research Associates), Richard L. Collins (University of Alaska, Fairbanks), Nicholas Pedatella (National Center for Atmospheric Research)

items.title: Surrogate inference for threshold-derived environmental indices depends on null placement and seasonal event concentration
items.abstract: Threshold-derived environmental indices convert native-resolution variables into event indicators and aggregated counts, but surrogate tests may impose their null constraints either before or after this transformation. We show that these choices define different inferential targets. A threshold--copula representation separates temporal dependence from the seasonal event-probability vector and makes seasonal concentration an explicit experimental coordinate. In a prespecified benchmark of 13,500 short-memory monthly trajectories, an index-resolution marginal-and-spectrum surrogate and a constrained native-resolution surrogate produced strongly asymmetric paired conclusions: 1084 trajectories rejected only at index resolution, compared with 16 only at native resolution. Holding the expected annual event count fixed while concentrating event probability within the seasonal cycle increased index-only discordance from 4.4\% to 16.2\%. In an independent experiment, equalizing monthly event probability reduced the corresponding rate from 15.9\% to 3.9\%; the mitigation persisted when monthly percentiles were estimated from an independent 30-year reference period. Native-resolution inference was calibrated under the benchmark null but had strongly mechanism-dependent sensitivity: the strongest prespecified history-feedback alternative had a 30.7\% detection rate under the fixed synthetic gate, with substantially lower sensitivity to a persistent-regime alternative. A Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 6 Amazon dry-month case study was non-discriminating, illustrating why null placement and design-specific detectability should be reported together. The results provide a practical framework for surrogate inference on threshold-derived hydroclimatic and environmental indices.
items.authors: Mauricio Herrera-Mar\'in

items.title: GPROF-IR: An Improved Single-Channel Infrared Precipitation Retrieval for Merged Satellite Precipitation Products
items.abstract: The Integrated Multi-Satellite Retrievals for the Global Precipitation Measurement (IMERG) product combines precipitation estimates from passive microwave (PMW) and infrared (IR) sensors to provide quasi-global precipitation estimates at half-hourly resolution. Because IR observations are primarily sensitive to cloud-top properties, however, IR-based precipitation estimates are generally less accurate than PMW estimates and can introduce artifacts into the merged precipitation fields. We introduce GPROF-IR, a neural-network-based precipitation retrieval designed to provide precipitation estimates from single-channel geostationary IR observations for the upcoming IMERG V08. GPROF-IR uses a convolutional neural network to exploit spatiotemporal information from sequences of half-hourly IR observations. We validate GPROF-IR against independent surface-based precipitation measurements over land and ocean. GPROF-IR substantially improves upon existing single-channel IR retrievals, including the IR retrieval used in IMERG V07 and more recent neural-network-based approaches. During overpasses of flagship PMW sensors, GPROF-IR is more accurate than the corresponding IMERG PMW estimates over CONUS and Austria, but not Korea. Over CONUS, GPROF-IR outperforms the merged IMERG V07 product for hourly and daily precipitation accumulations. Against shipborne disdrometer observations, GPROF-IR is more accurate than IMERG V07 in the tropics but slightly less accurate in the extratropics. Since geostationary IR observations are continuously available across much of the globe since 1983, GPROF-IR provides a promising basis for improving merged precipitation products and developing long-term, temporally consistent precipitation records.
items.authors: Simon Pfreundschuh, Christian D. Kummerow, Jackson Tan, George J. Huffman

items.title: 3-D thermomechanical geodynamic modelling of heating and volcanism in the Massif Central (France) and Eifel Volcanic Region (Germany)
items.abstract: The French Massif Central and the Eifel Volcanic Field represent two of the enigmatic features in France and Germany, respectively. Both areas have been affected by Cenozoic volcanism whose origin is still debated. Using 3-D numerical geodynamic modelling of recently developed solid-mechanical constitutive laws including viscoelastic-viscoplastic behaviour, we explored a new hypothesis to highlight the contribution of localised deformational (inelastic) heating towards the evolution of localised volcanism as being due to far-field-induced compressive stresses from the Africa-Eurasia convergence. Our simulations show that variations in crustal thicknesses can help localise inelastic strain near the Moho of relatively thicker crust, which leads to enhanced heating. Localised viscoplastic deformation above the brittle-ductile transition in the crust also formed conjugate deformation bands, resulting in localised changes in the topography which can be compared to present-day topography. The first-order picture that emerges from our simulations shows an association of elevated topography and tectonic structures that localise deformation, with a geothermal anomaly sufficient to explain the elevated heat flow and cause a potential localised zone for partial melting in hydrated or CO\textsubscript{2}-bearing mantle below the Moho.
items.authors: E. Momoh, S. Tait, H S. Bhat

items.title: Time-Resolved Surface-Fault Displacement During the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake From Near-Fault Video
items.abstract: Video recordings can reveal how rapidly fault displacement develops at the Earth's surface, but camera motion and recording artifacts can obscure the ground signal. We analyze a secondary copy of security-camera footage that captured surface displacement during the 28 July 2026 Kumamoto earthquake; the native recording was unavailable and could not be recovered. Two independent image-tracking methods were used. Optical flow follows identifiable image features, whereas normalized cross-correlation (NCC) template matching follows fixed image patches by their similarity. Both measured target-region motion relative to spatially separated reference regions while correcting motion shared by the recording. Image displacement was calibrated to the magnitude of the field-measured offset vector: 1.05 m right-lateral and 0.90 m east-side-up, or 1.383 m in total. We characterize the principal rise by the time required for displacement to progress from 20% to 80% of the selected final level. Across prespecified endpoint choices, optical flow gives 0.866-0.901 s and NCC gives 0.910-0.928 s. These durations correspond to average rates of 0.920-0.958 and 0.895-0.912 m/s, respectively. Checks using independently published tracking windows reproduce the displacement scale, although exact timing is more sensitive in spatially restricted tests. The record also shows an early apparent peak and decline followed by renewed apparent horizontal displacement. Because that later motion may represent either continued ground displacement or the geometry of the secondary recording, neither the permanent endpoint nor physical overshoot can be determined. The most robust conclusion is that the central part of the surface displacement developed in approximately 0.9 s at an average rate near 0.9 m/s.
items.authors: Bogdan Enescu, Shinji Toda, Yuji Yagi, Kazuo Oike, Yu Xuan Teh, Shohei Nobuhara

items.title: Operational insights from the front lines of OpenADMET: lessons from our blind challenges
items.abstract: The gap between reported machine learning (ML) model performance in drug discovery and the experience of using these models in live discovery projects remains a major hurdle for the field, because the retrospective nature of most benchmarks makes it difficult to objectively assess progress. To address this gap, OpenADMET has hosted a series of blind challenges to benchmark and advance predictive modeling in absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET). In this Perspective, we distill the operational, strategic, and community-level lessons from our first four blind challenges, providing a practical blueprint for designing and running collaborative machine learning competitions in the life sciences. In addition, we open-source our blind challenge infrastructure and data-validation tools to lower the barrier to entry for hosting rigorous, community-driven competitions and to foster a sustainable framework for collective learning in computer-aided drug discovery.
items.authors: Hugo MacDermott-Opeskin, Maria Castellanos, Jonathan A. Swain, Jenke Scheen, Sean Colby, Georgia Channing

items.title: Optimization of Bimetallic Catalysts for the Hydrogenation of Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carriers using Contaminated Hydrogen Gas
items.abstract: Liquid organic hydrogen carriers enable safe storage of H2 at high densities, but scalable application is impeded by the tolerance towards impurities common in industrial H2 streams, notably CO that poisons noble metals. In this work, we investigated synergistic effects in Pd-, Ru-, and Ni-based catalysts on Al2O3 for benzyltoluene hydrogenation under pure H2 and COcontaminated feeds representative of realistic operation. By enforcing identical metal loadings, dispersion, and mesoporosity across a series of mono- and bimetallic samples, intrinsic metalmetal effects were isolated. XPS reveals a more electron-rich Ni surface phase in the bimetallics, with Ru exerting a stronger influence on the electronic state of Ni than Pd. Catalytic activity of the samples in the presence of CO follows Pd–Ni Ni ≳ Ru–Ni Pd ≈ Ru. Ni is essential to retain activity under CO, while monometallic Pd and Ru are strongly poisoned. This is due to Nidriven CO methanation which initiates near 525 K on bimetallics. In case of the best-performing Pd–Ni/Al2O3 catalyst, operando DRIFTS identifies isolated Pd sites embedded in Ni that reversibly segregate/redisperse under CO/H2, forming transient Pd2/Pd3 ensembles. Overall, this work shows that selective incorporation of low noble metal contents into Ni is a viable strategy to produce robust, CO-tolerant, and economically attractive catalyst for benzyltoluene hydrogenation under impure hydrogen.
items.authors: Kevin Alconada, Yaoci Sheng, Lukas Popp, Adrian Seitz, Felix Lott, Felix Herold
items.title_zh: 使用污染氢气优化双金属催化剂氢化液态有机氢载体
items.summary_zh: 液态有机氢载体能够安全高密度存储氢气，但在工业氢气流中常见的杂质（尤其是会毒化贵金属的CO）限制了其规模化应用。本研究探讨了基于Pd、Ru和Ni的催化剂在Al2O3上对苄基甲苯氢化的协同效应，采用纯氢和CO污染的进料，模拟实际操作。通过在一系列单金属和双金属样品中强制相同的金属负载、分散度和介孔性，隔离了内在的金属间效应。XPS结果显示，双金属催化剂中Ni表面相更富电子，Ru对Ni的电子状态影响强于Pd。在CO存在下，催化活性顺序为Pd–Ni Ni ≳ Ru–Ni Pd ≈ Ru。Ni对保持CO下的活性至关重要，而单金属Pd和Ru则受到强烈毒化。这是由于在双金属催化剂上，CO甲烷化在525 K附近启动。对于表现最佳的Pd–Ni/Al2O3催化剂，原位DRIFTS识别出嵌入Ni中的孤立Pd位点，在CO/H2下可逆分离/再分散，形成瞬态Pd2/Pd3集合体。总体而言，本研究表明将低含量贵金属选择性引入Ni是一种有效策略，以生产稳健、耐CO且经济吸引的苄基甲苯催化剂。

items.title: Quantum Subspace Expansion for Molecular Excited States: Representability, Stability, and Practical Considerations
items.abstract: Accurate treatment of excited states remains challenging for classical electronic-structure methods, motivating quantum algorithms that may provide more favorable resource scaling. We systematically assess the practical performance of Quantum Subspace Expansion (QSE) for low-lying electronic states across 28 organic molecules from the Thiel benchmark set. Statevector simulations reveal that QSE representability depends strongly on the target state, active space, and molecular electronic structure, with multiconfigurational character emerging as an important factor. In several cases, the one-body QSE subspace cannot adequately represent the target states, while explicit double-excitation operators improve representability at the cost of a larger operator space. Analysis of the QSE overlap matrix shows that although eigenmodes with small eigenvalues drive numerical instability, they cannot be discarded indiscriminately without compromising spectral accuracy. Under finite-shot sampling, energy errors exhibit an empirical scaling of approximately n2 orb/ √ Nshots, which, combined with the growth in measurement groups, yields a total measurement cost of approximately O(n11 orb) for constant accuracy under our direct-estimation protocol. These results expose a central tension between representability, numerical stability, and measurement cost. Encouragingly, we find that the projected matrices exhibit recurring structural patterns, while the finite-shot perturbations in the Hamiltonian and overlap matrices show nontrivial covariance, suggesting opportunities for more efficient structure-aware measurement and reconstruction strategies. Overall, our results provide an assessment of QSE across chemically-relevant organic molecules, identifying present limitations while highlighting potential routes toward more practical future implementations.
items.authors: Naythan Z. X. Yeo, Shi Jun Ang

items.title: The Transition Seam Ansatz of Kinetic Theory
items.abstract: The Eyring formulation of transition-state theory fixes a single activated-complex population by equilibrium with the reactant state, so that a population in equilibrium with one state has no net flux from that state. This paper keeps the three assumptions of that theory and takes the barrier as the seam at which the electronic-structure manifolds of reactant and product have equal energetic chemical potential. One transition state then has two populations, one on each manifold, with separate amounts and configurational chemical potentials and with a shared energetic chemical potential and configurational excess. The flux on each manifold is a shared attempt frequency times its seam population, and De Donder referencing of the two fluxes is the isothermal rate law. Each seam population is in equilibrium with its own state, so transitivity of equilibrium places no condition on the two states. Recrossing, tunnelling, and non-adiabatic passage are contained in the attempt frequency rather than distributed across the rate expression. The transition-state population is an explicit quantity of the law. An ideal catalyst binds its intermediates neither so weakly that there is nothing to form a transition state from, nor so strongly that there is nowhere to form it. Mass action, Langmuir, and Butler–Volmer are decisions on the two excesses, the classical two-rate-constant law collects the energetic pieces into forward and reverse rate constants that share the attempt frequency, and a directional law is the limit in which the running amount of one intermediate is negligible against its equilibrium amount. The reversibility of a step is the ratio of the two seam populations, which occupy the same nuclear configuration and differ in electronic structure.
items.authors: Benedikt Axel Brandes

items.title: Hybrid Grain-Core/Grain Boundary Proton Conductivity in Nanocrystalline La2Ce2O7 Thin Films at 298 - 453K
items.abstract: La3+ doping of ceria promotes hydration at the site of oxygen vacancy defects and, consequently, also protonic conductivity, thereby positioning fluorite-structured La2Ce2O7 (LCO50) as a promising low temperature (LT, i.e., 473 K) solid state proton-conducting electrolyte . With mean grain size for polycrystalline LCO50 thin films of ~5 nm by sputter-deposition at 293 K, room temperature total conductivity is measured by impedance spectroscopy to be ~7.5×10-9 S/cm. This is approximately two orders of magnitude higher than that previously measured for highly textured, LCO50 thin films, sputter-deposited at 733 K. Here, experimental evidence is provided that the dominant LT conduction mechanism in nanocrystalline LCO50 thin films is protonic, given the measured total activation energy of 0.396±0.007eV between 373K and 453 K. At these temperatures, the conductivity of the nanocrystalline LCO50 films is approximately independent of the atmospheric relative humidity while change is minimal even under high vacuum. We interpret these properties in terms of a hybrid grain-core/grain-boundary protonic conduction mechanism, in which the grain core acts as a proton reservoir and the grain boundary, as a rapid conduction path. Such a micro-fabrication compatible, solid state protonic conductor offers versatile applications including fuel cells, sensors and battery-run devices.
items.authors: Hadar Dessau, Daniel Freidzon, Ellen Wachtel, Anna Kossoy, Olga Brontvein, Katya Rechav

items.title: Machine-learning force-field scoring rivals free-energy perturbation for congeneric ligand ranking across public benchmarks
items.abstract: Relative binding free-energy (RBFE) methods such as free-energy perturbation (FEP) set the accuracy standard for ranking congeneric ligands in structure-based drug design, but their computational cost limits throughput. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) now approach quantum-chemical accuracy at a small fraction of that cost, raising the question of whether they can recover much of RBFE’s ranking accuracy while remaining computationally efficient. We introduce a static-score methodology called taqo and benchmark 10 MLFF variants spanning 6 model families (UMA, MACE, Orb, eSEN, AIMNet2, AllScAIP), together with a classical molecular-mechanics force field, on a uniform static-pocket protocol, correlated against experiment across 22 benchmark systems. We find that the ten MLFFs cannot be resolved from one another at this sample size, while every one of them significantly outranks the classical force field reference, at a few seconds per ligand on a single GPU. Against published OpenFE and FEP+ results on the same systems and the same ligand sets, taqo is statistically indistinguishable from OpenFE and significantly below FEP+, at roughly three orders of magnitude lower cost. On the congeneric JACS subset taqo and FEP+ are statistically indistinguishable. On the same benchmark poses taqo outperforms classical docking scores and is statistically indistinguishable from deep-learning affinity models, without any affinity-specific training. Together these establish MLFF interaction-energy scoring as a practical high-throughput approach for lead optimization.
items.authors: Kevin Ryczko, Sarah Maier, Amogh Sood, Patrick Rowe, Harish Ramadas, Lorenzo Boninsegna

items.title: Phase-field modeling of porosity formation and evolution during hydrogen-based iron oxide reduction
items.abstract: Hydrogen-based direct reduction of iron oxides (HyDRI) offers a low-emission route to solid-state ironmaking by replacing carbon-based reductants with hydrogen. The mass loss associated with oxygen removal generates porosity. The evolving pore network influences reduction kinetics through changes in transport pathways and internal reaction surfaces. Here, we develop a phase-field framework that couples solid-state oxygen transport, the wüstite–ferrite transformation, and pore evolution during the rate-controlling step of HyDRI. Pore generation follows the local transformation rate at the advancing reaction front, whereas surface diffusion redistributes existing porosity. The newly formed solid–pore interfaces provide additional oxygen-removal sites, coupling pore evolution back to front propagation. The simulations show that increasing reduction-generated porosity drives a transition from isolated pores to connected channels, raising the fraction of pore space connected to the external surface from approximately 7% to 97%. Additional internal reaction surfaces shorten the time to 90% reduction by approximately 15%, demonstrating how pore formation accelerates further reduction. Faster front propagation preserves fine, tortuous pores, whereas faster surface diffusion promotes smoothing and coarsening. The resulting structures differ by more than a factor of two in the solid–pore interfacial length available for oxygen removal, even at the same reduction-generated porosity. Pore connectivity and the internal surface available for reaction therefore depend on reduction history and cannot be inferred from porosity alone. These findings provide a physical basis for linking local pore evolution to gas access and overall reduction kinetics at larger scales.
items.authors: Kartik Sunil Umate, Yang Bai, Bob Svendsen, Dierk Raabe

items.title: Electronic Structure of Cobalamins Defined by High Energy Resolution Fluorescence Detected X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy: Insights into Photochemical Axial Bond Cleavage in the CarH Photoreceptor
items.abstract: Nature utilizes cobalamin photochemistry within photoreceptor proteins to regulate vital biological functions. Rationalization of structure-function relationships that selectively activate/deactivate cobalamin photochemistry is essential for understanding how organisms leverage this photosensitivity. In this work, we systematically investigated the electronic structure and photochemistry of four cobalamin variants—both free in solution and bound to the CarH photoreceptor protein—using Cobalt Kα1 high-energy-resolution fluorescence-detected X-ray absorption near-edge structure (HERFD-XANES) spectroscopy and (time-dependent) density functional theory ((TD-)DFT) calculations. Stark differences in HERFD-XANES spectra between alkyl- and non-alkyl cobalamins are observed, with the former exhibiting more intense pre-edge features. TD-DFT simulations reproduce the observed pre-edge intensity trends and show that increased intensity correlates with enhanced cobalt 3dz 2/4pz mixing arising from greater axialligand σ-donor covalency. The higher resolution afforded by HERFD also enables identification of 1s → corrin π* pre-edge satellites that are obscured in lower-resolution measurements. Analysis of these features indicates that their intensity provides evidence for the presence of cobalt 4pz/3dz 2 orbital character in molecular corrin π* orbitals. This finding supports a mechanism for alkylcobalamin photochemistry and Co–C bond cleavage in which photoexcitation into a corrin π* orbital is followed by donation into the cobalt 3dz 2 orbital. Interestingly, HERFD-XANES profiles between free and CarH-bound cobalamins are similar, demonstrating that the cofactor’s groundstate electronic structure is largely preserved when protein-bound. This indicates that CarH tunes AdoCbl photochemistry in the photoexcited state. Finally, we demonstrate that a truncated CarH variant that permits higher Co concentrations yields high-quality HERFD-XANES with strong sensitivity to geometric and electronic structure, suggesting that applying this technique in future time-resolved pump-probe investigations could lead to breakthroughs in elucidating the transient intermediates that drive CarH photoactivity.
items.authors: Emma Wall, Zhibo Qi, Shusaku Hayama, Michael L. Baker, Sam Hay

items.title: Charge Loss of Proteins in vacuo: Implications for Native Mass Spectrometry and Ion Mobility
items.abstract: Native ion mobility–mass spectrometry (IM-MS) is a powerful biophysical technique for characterizing protein structure. Because individual charge states often exhibit distinct structural dynamics, accurate IM-MS measurements require charge states to be examined independently. Although anecdotal reports among mass spectrometrists suggest that protein ions can lose charges during native IM-MS experiments, a thorough investigation of this phenomenon has been lacking. Here, we demonstrate that protein ions undergo charge loss inside the mass spectrometer as a direct consequence of gas-phase collisions, potentially leading to altered charge state distributions and ion mobility data. This effect was consistently observed across two instrument platforms (Synapt G2-S and Q Exactive UHMR), both ion polarities (positive and negative mode) and for three proteins (bovine serum albumin, myoglobin, and immunoglobulin G). Systematic investigations of instrumental parameters revealed that collision gas pressure has the strongest impact on the magnitude of charge loss, and that higher charge states are more affected than lower charge states. We further show that this process is largely driven by the dissociation of salt adducts and can hence be minimized through desalting in solution or inside the mass spectrometer, prior to the first m/z -analyzer (usually a quadrupole). For collision-induced unfolding experiments, significant differences were found between fingerprints acquired with and without quadrupole selection, although it remains unclear whether this phenomenon is directly related to charge loss. Taken together, our study provides fundamental insights into collision-induced charge loss as a source of error in native IM-MS measurements and discusses the relevance of quadrupole m/z -selection for improving confidence in IM studies.
items.authors: Mathew Bejoy, Nicklas Österlund, Jacob S. Jordan, Kevin Pagel, Niklas Geue

items.title: From sequences and structures to fitness, folding and function: challenges in the age of AI
items.abstract: Deep-learning models have transformed our ability to predict the phenotypic effects of sequence perturbations. Protein language models (pLMs) score the evolutionary propensity of any amino-acid substitution, emerging as fast and accurate predictors of fitness changes. Inverse-folding (IF) models add structural information and are powerful alternatives for estimating folding-stability changes. But these likelihoods are imperfect and sometimes biased predictors of the biological quantities they are used to measure. Scaling pLMs has shown that bigger models do not always outperform smaller ones. IF models sometimes read sequence conservation as a stability constraint, which leads to biases when this signal is used to isolate functional contributions beyond folding. We review here the strategies emerging to mitigate, and where possible overcome, these limitations. Highlights:- Scaling protein language models does not close the likelihood–fitness gap - Inverse-folding models can read functional conservation as lost stability - Disentangling function from stability inherits both biases - Emerging strategies are attempting to address these issues
items.authors: Ezequiel A. Galpern, Charles W. J. Pugh, Mafalda Dias, Jonathan Frazer

items.title: A unique technology for creating thin gold layers inside medieval glass tesserae.
items.abstract: A unique technology, based on a chemical process that creates a thin layer of gold inside medieval glass tesserae, has been identified analysing physicochemical test results, within a project conducted by the Anna Langer Memorial Foundation. The samples studied are part of a collection of glass tesserae, discovered in the remains of the palatium of Duke Mieszko I in Poznań, by archaeologists from Adam Mickiewicz University, working under the direction of Prof. Hanna M. Kóčka
items.authors: Zofia Luklinska, Alina Pabisiak, Jerzy J. Langer

items.title: Direct generation of a prototypical n-pentyl peroxy radical reveals how mixedfate chemical regimes shape product distributions
items.abstract: Organic peroxy radicals (RO2) are key branch points in atmospheric oxidation with competing fates in the troposphere: reaction with NO, reaction with HO2, self-/cross-reaction with another RO2, and isomerization. RO2 often react in mixed-fate regimes, yielding product distributions with a complex dependence on reactivity conditions. In traditional environmental chamber experiments, not all RO2 fates are equally accessible, and chemical regimes favoring RO2 self-/cross-reactions and isomerizations are poorly characterized. Here, we access these conditions in an environmental chamber via 1-iodopentane photolysis, monitoring product distributions with NH4 + chemical ionization mass spectrometry. We tune the relative importance of these reaction pathways by varying the initial conditions, spanning bimolecular lifetimes from ~100-2000 s. Across conditions, the major observed C5 product, C5H10O3 (~40-60% yield), requires at least one RO2 isomerization to form, demonstrating the importance of downstream RO2 unimolecular reactions even if they are not the major fate of upstream RO2. Model mechanisms partially reproduce observed product distributions but cannot quantitatively capture variations with changing RO2 fate. Discrepancies suggest poorly-understood RO2 cross-reactions substantially influence product distributions. Conditions favoring RO2 isomerization unintuitively enhance both fragmentation and accretion via downstream functionalized alkoxy and peroxy radical chemistry. Results illuminate important gaps in existing atmospheric reaction mechanisms when predicting product distributions in mixed-fate chemical regimes.
items.authors: Cooper K. Crabtree, Sara E. Murphy, Victoria P. Barber
items.title_zh: 直接生成典型的正戊基过氧自由基揭示混合命运化学机制对产物分布的影响
items.summary_zh: 有机过氧自由基（RO2）是大气氧化中的关键分支点，在对流层中具有竞争性命运：与NO反应、与HO2反应、自交/交叉反应及异构化。RO2通常在混合命运机制下反应，导致产物分布对反应条件的复杂依赖。在传统的环境气室实验中，并非所有RO2命运均可获得，且有利于RO2自交/交叉反应和异构化的化学机制尚未得到充分表征。本文通过1-碘戊烷光解在环境气室中研究这些条件，利用NH4+化学电离质谱监测产物分布。我们通过改变初始条件调节这些反应途径的重要性，双分子寿命范围为约100-2000秒。在不同条件下，观察到的主要C5产物C5H10O3（产率约40-60%）至少需要一次RO2异构化才能形成，表明下游RO2单分子反应的重要性。模型机制部分再现了观察到的产物分布，但无法定量捕捉RO2命运变化的影响。差异表明，RO2交叉反应对产物分布有显著影响。

items.title: eZacros: Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations for Electrochemical Catalysis
items.abstract: Free energy diagrams rank electrocatalysts thermodynamically but do not resolve which elementary step limits the rate under operating conditions, or how the surface coverage that governs that competition is established. Lattice kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) recovers both by treating elementary steps as stochastic events on an explicit lattice, but electrochemical kMC workflows remain far less standardized than the free-energy approaches common in computational electrocatalysis. Here we present eZacros, a framework that implements potential-dependent reaction energetics within the computational hydrogen electrode formalism, electrochemical Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi relations for activation barriers, and effective rate prefactors for charge-transfer steps. It is built on Zacros, a widely used kMC engine, and takes a compact Python input that specifies the lattice, the mechanism, and the energetics. We validate the implementation against an established microkinetic model of the oxygen reduction reaction on Pt(111), recovering its polarization curve and steady-state coverages. For hydrogen evolution, we sweep a single model definition over electrode potential and hydrogen adsorption free energy to generate activity, Tafel slope, and coverage maps. These resolve into a kinetic phase diagram in which no single rate-determining step characterizes the reaction across the full space: the boundaries between Volmer-, Heyrovsky-, and Tafel-controlled regimes are set by the steady-state coverage, which departs from equilibrium adsorption expectations under reaction conditions. eZacros makes potential-resolved kinetics accessible to anyone who can supply adsorption free energies and reference barriers, complementing free-energy screening in catalyst modeling and discovery.
items.authors: Esteban D. Gadea, Valeria Molinero
items.title_zh: eZacros：用于电化学催化的动力学蒙特卡罗模拟
items.summary_zh: 自由能图可以热力学地对电催化剂进行排序，但无法确定在操作条件下限制反应速率的基本步骤，以及决定竞争的表面覆盖如何建立。晶格动力学蒙特卡罗（kMC）通过将基本步骤视为显式晶格上的随机事件来恢复这两者，但电化学kMC工作流程仍远不如计算电催化中常见的自由能方法标准化。本文提出了eZacros框架，该框架在计算氢电极形式主义中实现了潜在依赖的反应能量学、电化学Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi关系用于活化能障，以及电荷转移步骤的有效速率前因子。我们验证了该实现与已建立的Pt(111)氧还原反应微动力学模型的一致性，恢复了其极化曲线和稳态覆盖。对于氢气演化，我们在电极电位和氢吸附自由能上扫动单一模型定义，以生成活性、Tafel斜率和覆盖图。这些结果形成了一个动力学相图，其中没有单一的速率决定步骤能够表征整个反应空间。

items.title: Data-Efficient Machine Learning Potentials for Organic Reactions through Active-Learning-Guided Fine-Tuning
items.abstract: Transition states (TSs) are central to reaction barriers and mechanisms, yet their accurate localization remains computationally demanding. Reactive machine learning potentials can accelerate TS optimization by rapidly predicting potential energy surfaces, but achieving chemical transferability requires extensive sampling and quantum chemical (QC) labeling of reactive conformations. Here, we introduce an active-learning-guided fine-tuning strategy that couples pretrained chemical knowledge for broad generalization with adaptive labeling of informative reactive conformations for data efficiency. The resulting MACEPre-DeePEST-OS enables efficient TS optimization and barrier predictions across diverse organic reactions while requiring QC labeling for only ~2% of approximately 19 million candidate conformations. Across three in-distribution benchmarks, MACEPre-DeePEST-OS achieves an average root mean square deviation of 0.080 Å for TS geometries and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.938 kcal/mol for barriers. In cross-dataset evaluation on an external OrgReact subset, fine-tuning reduces the barrier MAE by 58% relative to the pretrained model. Out-of-distribution testing on a Ugi reaction network containing structures with more than 70 atoms yields a barrier MAE of 1.09 kcal/mol, indicating transfer to molecular sizes and reaction complexity beyond the fine-tuning data. These results establish a data-efficient route toward transferable reactive potentials for quantitative analysis of reaction mechanisms and competing pathways.
items.authors: Kaipai Ren, Yujing Zhao, Kun Tang, Juntao Wang, Guangran Zhang, Qilei Liu
items.title_zh: 基于主动学习的高效有机反应机器学习势能模型
items.summary_zh: 过渡态（TS）在反应障碍和机制中至关重要，但其准确定位仍然计算上要求高。反应性机器学习势能可以通过快速预测势能面来加速TS优化，但实现化学可转移性需要广泛的采样和量子化学（QC）标记反应构象。本文提出了一种主动学习引导的微调策略，将预训练的化学知识与信息性反应构象的自适应标记相结合，以提高数据效率。所提出的MACEPre-DeePEST-OS在多种有机反应中实现了高效的TS优化和障碍预测，仅需对约1900万个候选构象中的约2%进行QC标记。在三个分布内基准测试中，MACEPre-DeePEST-OS对TS几何结构的平均均方根偏差为0.080 Å，障碍的平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.938 kcal/mol。在外部OrgReact子集的跨数据集评估中，微调使障碍MAE相较于预训练模型降低了58%。在包含超过70个原子的Ugi反应网络的分布外测试中，障碍MAE为1.09 kcal/mol，表明该方法能够转移到超出微调数据的分子大小和反应复杂性。

items.title: How Fast Does a Glass Forget? LandscapeConnectivity, Not Barrier Height, Sets the Rateof Memory Erasure under Repeated ThermalCycling
items.authors: Hicham Jabraoui, Said Ouaskit

items.title: Molecular Dynamics Studies of Model Ionizable Lipids in an mRNA Vaccine
items.abstract: Effective COVID-19 mRNA vaccines encapsulate nucleoside-modified messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA), which encodes the prefusion-stabilized SARS-CoV-2 spike protein, inside lipid nanoparticles. Endosomal acidification motivates the study of ionizable-lipid protonation. Here, we isolate how protonation changes hydration, solvent preference, and structural organization of ALC-0315 in simplified model environments. Through molecular dynamics simulations, we identify clear protonationdependent differences in lipid orientation, hydration, and collective organization across three model systems. At a water/hexane interface, the protonated amine headgroup shows a stronger preference for the aqueous phase, reflecting enhanced interactions with water molecules. In 20-lipid assemblies, the protonated assembly remains more hydrated and aqueous-associated over the simulated trajectory, whereas the neutral assembly migrates toward and spreads along the water/hexane interface. In pure ALC-0315 bilayer simulations, protonation strengthens amine hydration and alters bilayerscale structural organization, with the observed morphology depending on the pressurecoupling protocol. Collectively, these findings demonstrate how protonation of ionizable amine headgroups can remodel ALC-0315 assemblies through strengthened lipid–water interactions. These simplified systems provide molecular-level insight into protonationdependent ALC-0315 behavior, while not directly modeling the full multicomponent LNP, the endosomal membrane, or mRNA release.
items.authors: Mohsen Farshad, Jayendran C. Rasaiah
items.title_zh: mRNA疫苗中可离子化脂质的分子动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 有效的COVID-19 mRNA疫苗将修饰的信使核糖核酸（mRNA）封装在脂质纳米颗粒中，编码稳定的SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白。内源性酸化促使我们研究可离子化脂质的质子化。本文研究了质子化如何改变ALC-0315在简化模型环境中的水合、溶剂偏好和结构组织。通过分子动力学模拟，我们发现脂质取向、水合和集体组织在三种模型系统中存在明显的质子化依赖差异。在水/己烷界面，质子化的胺头基对水相表现出更强的偏好，反映出与水分子的增强相互作用。在20脂质组装体中，质子化组装在模拟过程中保持更高的水合度，而中性组装则向水/己烷界面迁移并扩展。在纯ALC-0315双层模拟中，质子化增强了胺的水合并改变了双层的结构组织，观察到的形态依赖于压力耦合协议。这些发现表明，胺头基的质子化可以通过增强脂质-水相互作用重塑ALC-0315组装。

items.title: A Molecular View of Framework-Associated Zeolite Lewis Acid Sites: Linking Structure to Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley Reactivity
items.abstract: The Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley (MPV) reaction has been used to probe the Lewis acidity and local environment of aluminum Lewis acid sites (LAS) in zeolites and how these properties evolve upon post-synthetic treatments such as calcination and steaming. However, directly linking catalytic activity to proposed framework-associated aluminum LAS remains challenging because the identity of the catalytically relevant species is often inferred indirectly from correlations between spectroscopic signatures and reactivity. Molecular mimics of heterogeneous active sites can test hypotheses related to structure and reactivity, yet there exists few scaffolds capable of faithfully recapitulating the primary coordination environments in zeolites under demanding catalytically relevant conditions. In this work, we report a molecular model of a framework-associated (SiO)3Al LAS supported by a rigid, tridentate tris(siloxide) ligand derived from truxenone. The model complex is a competent and robust catalyst for MPV transfer hydrogenation of benzaldehyde with iPrOH, and density functional theory calculations support a pathway initiated by protonation of a supporting siloxide ligand by iPrOH. In contrast, a structurally related anionic Al−OH complex was found to be inactive under the same conditions. These observations suggest that framework-associated (SiO)3Al LAS can mediate MPV reactivity and provide a molecular basis for metal–framework cooperativity occurring at Lewis acidic aluminum sites in zeolites.
items.authors: Martin-Louis Y. Riu, Piper Szeliga, Tyler A. Kerr, Matthew Nava
items.title_zh: 框架相关沸石路易斯酸位点的分子视角：结构与MPV反应性的关联
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了沸石中铝路易斯酸位点（LAS）的路易斯酸性及其局部环境，利用Meerwein–Ponndorf–Verley（MPV）反应评估其在后合成处理（如煅烧和蒸汽处理）后的演变。通过分子模型，我们构建了一个框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS，采用来自truxenone的刚性三齿tris(siloxide)配体。该模型复合物在以iPrOH为氢源的苯甲醛MPV转移氢化反应中表现出良好的催化活性，密度泛函理论计算支持该反应由iPrOH对配体的质子化启动。相比之下，结构相关的阴离子Al−OH复合物在相同条件下未表现出催化活性。这些结果表明，框架相关的(SiO)3Al LAS能够介导MPV反应性。

items.title: Controlling polyethylene fibrillation in PFAS-free dry electrodes for processability and electrochemical performance
items.abstract: Ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) is a more sustainable binder alternative to polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) for producing PFAS-free Li-ion battery electrodes using a solvent-free PE fibrillation process. We show that PE fibrillation is thermo-activated and can be controlled to produce an extensive network of nano-fibrils with a median size of 20-40 nm. PE-containing graphite electrode ultimate tensile strength (UTS), critical for roll-to-roll processing, improved more than 20-fold when the electrode calendering temperature increased from 100 to 160-200 °C, providing mechanical stability superior to equivalent PTFE-containing electrodes. PE-containing electrodes calendered at lower temperatures (120-140 °C) showed comparable charging rate performance but superior capacity retention of ∼90% after 100 cycles when compared with PTFE-containing electrodes. Removing PTFE by calcination to mimic direct recycling required temperatures 600 °C and led to PFAS emissions. In contrast, PE removal was PFAS-free and achieved at 300-400 °C, aided by the catalytic effect of graphite on PE decomposition making PE-containing electrodes more suitable with direct recycling. Overall, integrating across fabrication, mechanical, electrochemical and end-of-life considerations, PE-containing electrodes offer significant potential for more sustainable solvent-free Li-ion batteries.
items.authors: Guillaume Matthews, Benjamin Meyer, Noël Hallemans, Wenjia Du, Paul Shearing, Patrick S. Grant
items.title_zh: 控制无PFAS干电极中聚乙烯纤维化以提升加工性和电化学性能
items.summary_zh: 超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE）是一种更可持续的粘合剂替代聚四氟乙烯（PTFE），用于无PFAS溶剂法制备锂离子电池电极。研究表明，聚乙烯纤维化是热激活的，可以控制以产生中位尺寸为20-40纳米的纳米纤维网络。当电极轧制温度从100°C提高到160-200°C时，含聚乙烯的石墨电极的极限抗拉强度（UTS）提高了20倍以上，提供了优于相应PTFE电极的机械稳定性。与PTFE电极相比，120-140°C轧制的聚乙烯电极在充电速率性能上相当，但在100个循环后容量保持率达到约90%。通过600°C焙烧去除PTFE以模拟直接回收会导致PFAS排放，而聚乙烯的去除在300-400°C下进行，无PFAS排放，且石墨对聚乙烯分解的催化作用使其更适合直接回收。总体而言，聚乙烯电极在无溶剂锂离子电池的制造、机械、电化学及生命周期考虑中展现出显著的可持续潜力。

items.title: Determining Which Phonons Affect Dynamic Disorder and Charge Mobility in Molecular Crystals
items.abstract: Organic semiconductors (OSCs), and especially molecular crystals, exhibit unique structural complexity and strong coupling between electronic and vibrational degrees of freedom. The strong electron-phonon coupling (EPC) localizes the charge carriers and limits the charge transport rate as a consequence of the dynamic disorder (σij). In principal, it should be possible to engineer new molecular crystals with reduced dynamic disorder, but determining which phonons contribute the most to dynamic disorder and what are the corresponding effects on charge transport has been elusive. Here, we propose the use of singular value decomposition (SVD) to study phonon modes within molecular crystals by transforming the original phonon modes (OMs) into a reduced set of ranked projected modes (PMs) that affect the EPC. The SVD phonon analysis reduces the number of modes to consider for phonon engineering while retaining the essential physical information which is validated with inelastic neutron scattering. This analysis shows that even the most significant PM for the selected molecules contribute at most 12-45% of the total dynamic disorder. That is, for none of the selected molecules is a single OM responsible for a large proportion of the dynamic disorder. Our results also identify the collective detrimental motions for charge transport by producing atomic displacement visualizations that reveal which atomic and molecular motions contribute to dynamic disorder. Finally, side-chain effects are probed by SVD phonon analysis; these are not usually considered in detail because the electronic coupling is carried exclusively by the conjugated backbone. Our results show that side-chain location and branching can alter the distribution of backbone vibrational states, harden high-energy backbone-involved motions, and couple side-chain motions to backbone dynamics, thereby indirectly affecting the extent of dynamic disorder. All of this supports the conclusion that SVD phonon analysis could be used as a robust phonon engineering tool to eliminate or generate specific features in a phonon spectrum, generating personalized design rules for next-generation OSCs.
items.authors: Chen-Wei Chiang, Toulik Maitra, Jeremy K. Mason, Adam J. Moulé
items.title_zh: 确定影响分子晶体动态无序与电荷迁移的声子
items.summary_zh: 有机半导体（OSCs），尤其是分子晶体，展现出独特的结构复杂性以及电子与振动自由度之间的强耦合。强电子-声子耦合（EPC）使电荷载流子局域化，并因动态无序（σij）限制电荷传输速率。理论上，可以设计出具有降低动态无序的新型分子晶体，但确定哪些声子对动态无序贡献最大及其对电荷传输的影响一直难以捉摸。本文提出使用奇异值分解（SVD）研究分子晶体中的声子模式，通过将原始声子模式（OMs）转化为影响EPC的排名投影模式（PMs）来实现。SVD声子分析减少了声子工程中需考虑的模式数量，同时保留了重要的物理信息，且通过非弹性中子散射进行了验证。分析结果表明，所选分子的最显著PM对总动态无序的贡献最多为12-45%。即，对于所选的分子，没有单一OM对动态无序的较大比例负责。我们的结果还通过原子位移可视化识别了对电荷传输有害的集体运动。

items.title: Fractal Colonization of Prebiotic Niches: Mechanical Budding of Nano-vesicles and Kinetic Resource Depletion as an Oncological Atavism
items.abstract: Periodic mechanical forcing of the early Earth, from lunar tides (period of about 10 h) and radiogenic geysers (about 15 min) to von Kármán vortex shedding (about 1 s), may have loaded fatty-acid protocell membranes on time scales comparable to their relaxation times. We present a minimal model in which the tension of a parent vesicle, relaxing with time constant τ under rectified periodic forcing, releases one nano-vesicle at each upward crossing of a budding threshold. The shed nano-vesicles deplete the free fatty-acid pool of the surrounding niche through a non-linear sink bounded by the critical micelle concentration (CMC). The depletion equation has an exact solution between shedding events, and numerical integration with illustrative parameters shows that the discrete, tension-gated release produces a staircase of quasi-steady monomer levels that the pool follows towards the CMC. We discuss a matching window fτ = O(1) as a possible paleophysical selection criterion and, as a hypothesis not tested here, an analogy with vesicle-mediated nutrient competition in tumour niches.
items.authors: Peter Mikuláš
items.title_zh: 前生物生态位的分形殖民：纳米囊泡的机械芽生与资源耗竭
items.summary_zh: 早期地球的周期性机械作用，如月球潮汐（约10小时周期）、放射性间歇泉（约15分钟）和冯卡门涡旋脱落（约1秒），可能在与其松弛时间相当的时间尺度上加载脂肪酸前细胞膜。我们提出了一个最小模型，其中父囊泡在周期性强迫下以时间常数τ松弛，在每次超过芽生阈值时释放一个纳米囊泡。释放的纳米囊泡通过一个非线性汇聚，耗竭周围生态位的自由脂肪酸池，受限于临界胶束浓度（CMC）。耗竭方程在释放事件之间有精确解，数值积分显示，离散的、张力门控的释放产生了一个准稳态单体水平的阶梯，池子向CMC发展。我们讨论了匹配窗口fτ = O(1)作为可能的古物理选择标准，并提出了一个假设，即与肿瘤生态位中囊泡介导的营养竞争的类比。

items.title: Ferrier Rearrangement Intermediates Featuring Aliphatic Acyl Protecting Groups
items.abstract: The Ferrier rearrangement of 1,2-unsaturated monosaccharides (glycals) to 2,3-unsatured glycosides, is important for the synthesis of pharmaceuticals and natural products. Mechanistically, the nucleophilic substitution proceeds via a cationic intermediate, the “Ferrier cation”, whose structure is difficult to capture with conventional analytical techniques. Here, we characterize the Ferrier cations of glucal and galactal building blocks involving aliphatic acyl protecting groups (pivaloyl-, levulinoyl- and chloroacetyl esters) using cryogenic gas-phase infrared spectroscopy. Comparing experimental and computed spectra of candidate structures, we established that all intermediates are stabilized by interactions of the C4 acyl protecting group with the C3 carbon of the pyranose ring (neighboring participation), potentially steering the stereochemical outcome of the Ferrier rearrangement. The resulting C4-C3-dioxolenium ion structure appears to be general to aliphatic acyl protecting groups, contributing to our fundamental understanding of Ferrier rearrangement reactions.
items.authors: Niklas Geue, Kim Greis, Sabrina Omoregbee-Leichnitz, Carla Kirschbaum, Julinton Sianturi, Shenchuang Wang
items.title_zh: 含脂肪酰保护基的Ferrier重排中间体研究
items.summary_zh: 1,2-不饱和单糖（糖醇）的Ferrier重排至2,3-不饱和糖苷在药物和天然产物合成中具有重要意义。该反应机制中，亲核取代通过阳离子中间体“Ferrier阳离子”进行，其结构难以通过传统分析技术捕获。本文利用低温气相红外光谱表征了涉及脂肪酰保护基（如pivaloyl、levulinoyl和chloroacetyl酯）的glucal和galactal构建块的Ferrier阳离子。通过比较实验和计算的候选结构光谱，我们发现所有中间体均通过C4酰保护基与吡喃环C3碳的相互作用（邻近参与）得到稳定，这可能影响Ferrier重排的立体化学结果。最终得到的C4-C3-二噁烯离子结构似乎对脂肪酰保护基具有普遍性，增进了我们对Ferrier重排反应的基础理解。

items.title: Understanding Differential Chemical Activities of Eutectic Gallium Indium (eGaIn) Thin Films with Fluorinated Analytes using Raman Spectroscopy
items.abstract: Gallium oxide (Ga2O3) forms on the surface of eutectic gallium indium (eGaIn) alloy in air; In the presence of water, it transforms to gallium oxide monohydroxide, GaO(OH). During such transformation, it is challenging to differentiate the activities of the oxides while adsorbing solutes from the solvent. Herein, we address this challenge by investigating the temporal evolution of eGaIn thin films during adsorption of dilute organofluorines in water. We identify five hours as the stability threshold to obtain a water-modified thin film. Leveraging both fresh and five-hour-modified films in parallel, we distinguish water-specific changes and differentiate the signals uniquely caused by fluorinated analytes. The modified GaO(OH) interface demonstrates increased hydrophilicity for microdroplet studies and structural stability under high-energy (20 kV) electron beam irradiation. We leverage Frontier Molecular Orbital (FMO) theory to predict that the GaO(OH) surface is also a reactive catalytic interface. In the presence of the GaO(OH) surface and UVA irradiation, short-chain (HFBA) and long-chain (PFOA) fluorinated compounds exhibited altered interfacial activity. We leveraged Raman spectroscopy throughout our study to differentiate the in situ activities of Ga2O3 and GaO(OH). Our investigations will be useful for differentiating fresh and modified oxide dynamics during in situ interfacial studies or wet chemical measurements.
items.authors: Dechassa Terefe, Muhammad Shamim Al Mamun, Momena Monwar, Md. Tasmirul Jalil, Ryan C. Tung, M. Rashed Khan
items.title_zh: 利用拉曼光谱研究共晶镓铟薄膜的化学活性
items.summary_zh: 在空气中，共晶镓铟（eGaIn）合金表面形成氧化镓（Ga2O3）；在水存在下，转变为氢氧化镓（GaO(OH)）。在此转变过程中，区分氧化物在吸附溶质时的活性具有挑战性。本文通过研究稀释有机氟化物在水中吸附过程中eGaIn薄膜的时间演变，确定五小时为获得水改性薄膜的稳定阈值。通过并行利用新鲜和五小时改性薄膜，我们区分了水特异性变化及氟化分析物引起的独特信号。改性GaO(OH)界面在微滴研究中表现出更高的亲水性，并在高能（20 kV）电子束辐照下保持结构稳定。利用前沿分子轨道（FMO）理论，我们预测GaO(OH)表面也是一个反应性催化界面。在GaO(OH)表面和UVA辐照下，短链（HFBA）和长链（PFOA）氟化化合物表现出改变的界面活性。我们在研究中利用拉曼光谱区分了Ga2O3和GaO(OH)的原位活性。

items.title: Exploration of Structure–Activity Relationships and Gut Restriction in Anti-Cryptosporidium Triazolopyridazine Series
items.abstract: Cryptosporidiosis is a major cause of diarrheal disease worldwide, particularly in young children and immunocompromised individuals, yet effective therapeutic options remain limited. Previously, the triazolopyridazine derivative SLU-10482 was identified as a potent anti-Cryptosporidium lead, but it suffers from modest affinity for the hERG ion channel. In the present study, structure–activity relationships (SAR) were investigated through systematic modification of the 3-position of the aryl ring and by designing gutrestricted analogues intended to reduce systemic exposure while maintaining antiparasitic activity. A diverse library of analogues was synthesized using amide coupling, Sonogashira, Suzuki, and Buchwald–Hartwig cross-coupling reactions, followed by hydrogenation and late-stage functional group transformations to access alkynyl, alkyl, tertiary amine, quaternary ammonium, and substituted aryl derivatives. Compounds were evaluated for anti-Cryptosporidium parvum activity in infected HCT-8 cells. SAR studies revealed that smaller, less polar substituents at the 3-position were generally associated with improved potency, whereas increasing substituent size and polarity resulted in diminished activity, although several larger polar analogues retained measurable potency. To develop gut-restricted agents, molecular weight, polarity, and conformational flexibility were intentionally increased to reduce intestinal permeability and systemic exposure. While these modifications were expected to preserve local intestinal activity, the resulting analogues exhibited substantially reduced antiparasitic potency. Because the molecular target of this chemotype remains unknown, the observed loss of activity may arise from reduced target engagement, impaired penetration across the parasite membrane barriers, or a combination of both.
items.authors: Antonio Giardina, Caitlin E. Hamill, Gregory M. Giovine, José Teixeira, Edmund Oboh, Soumitra Guin
items.title_zh: 抗隐孢子虫三唑吡啶并噁唑系列的结构-活性关系研究
items.summary_zh: 隐孢子虫病是全球主要的腹泻病因，尤其在幼儿和免疫功能低下者中更为严重，目前有效治疗选择有限。研究中，三唑吡啶并噁唑衍生物SLU-10482被发现具有良好的抗隐孢子虫活性，但对hERG离子通道的亲和力较低。通过系统性修改芳环3位的取代基，研究了结构-活性关系(SAR)，并设计了肠道限制性类似物以降低全身暴露，同时保持抗寄生虫活性。合成了多样的类似物，并评估其在感染HCT-8细胞中的抗隐孢子虫活性。结果表明，3位较小、极性较低的取代基通常与活性增强相关，而增大取代基的大小和极性则导致活性降低，尽管一些较大极性类似物仍保留可测量的活性。

items.title: Chiral Patterning Drives Peptide Coacervate Formation in Coarse-Grained SIRAH Simulations
items.abstract: Peptide-based polyelectrolyte complexes (PECs) are a promising class of stimuli-responsive materials with applications in drug delivery. Yet, the molecular mechanism by which stereochemical patterning governs their phase behavior remains unresolved. Racemic chiral patterning is known to favor liquid coacervate formation over solid precipitation by disrupting the ordered β-sheet structure, but experimentally elucidating the molecular-level origin of the solution-phase selection remains challenging. Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics simulations offer a practical route to accessing the time and length scales relevant to coacervate phase behavior but require force fields that capture sequence-dependent structural propensities. One of them is chirality, a capability that has not previously been validated for peptide-based PEC systems. Here, we expand the SIRAH CG force field for modeling chirally and hydrophobically patterned peptide-based PEC systems. By introducing D-chiral dihedral parameters, achieved by inverting the phase angles of the SIRAH backbone torsion potential, we simulate both racemic and homochiral variants of six model PEC systems and compare the results to microsecond atomistic C36m simulations and published FTIR secondary structure data. The racemic SIRAH model reproduces atomistic trends in peptide compaction, aggregate density, and interfacial structure, as assessed by radius of gyration distributions, radial density profiles, and hyperbolic-tangent fits to the droplet interface. Racemic systems exhibit higher backbone contact counts and greater peptide compaction than their homochiral counterparts, consistent with the formation of dense, disordered aggregates characteristic of the liquid coacervate phase, where chains maintain close contact without adopting long-range β-sheet order. These results provide molecular-level support for the macroscopic observation that racemic patterning favors coacervate over precipitate formation, and reveal that alternating chirality promotes compact, entangled chain conformations that satisfy backbone hydrogen bonding outside of canonical β-sheet structures rather than simply eliminating it, a mechanism beyond β-sheet disruption alone. Hydrophobicity-dependent trends in secondary structure and solvent exposure are well reproduced regardless of chiral patterning, establishing SIRAH as a viable framework for peptide-based coacervate simulations and identifying stereochemical patterning as an independent sequence-specific route for tuning coacervate density. Because the SIRAH protein and nucleic acid parameters were derived within a single, structurally consistent framework, the same approach extends naturally to peptide–nucleic acid complex coacervates, an assembly class of growing interest for delivery applications and one that few coarse-grained force fields can treat at backbone-level resolution.
items.authors: Tania Rajpersaud, Tahoora Ateeq, Lorraine Leon, Sergio Pantano, Sharon Loverde
items.title_zh: 手性图案驱动肽共沉淀形成的粗粒度SIRAH模拟
items.summary_zh: 肽基聚电解质复合物（PECs）是一类有前景的刺激响应材料，广泛应用于药物递送。然而，手性图案如何影响其相行为的分子机制尚未解决。已知外消旋手性图案通过破坏有序的β-折叠结构，促进液态共沉淀的形成。粗粒度分子动力学模拟为研究共沉淀相行为提供了实用途径，但需要捕捉序列依赖性结构倾向的力场。本文扩展了SIRAH粗粒度力场，以建模手性和疏水性图案的肽基PEC系统。通过引入D-手性二面角参数，模拟了六个模型PEC系统的外消旋和同手性变体，并将结果与微秒级原子模拟和已发布的FTIR二级结构数据进行了比较。外消旋SIRAH模型再现了肽的紧凑性、聚集密度和界面结构的原子趋势。

items.title: StateFlux: Physically Validated Quantum Metabolic State Networks Reveal Limited Incremental Value for Toxicity Prediction
items.abstract: Mechanistic molecular representations are increasingly proposed as a route to improve toxicity prediction by supplementing parent structure with protonation, metabolism, and quantum-chemical reactivity. Whether those physically richer representations provide predictive information that is genuinely orthogonal to molecular structure remains uncertain. Here, StateFlux represents each drug as a network of chemical and predicted metabolic states with node-level GFN2-xTB properties and edge-resolved changes in ionization potential, electron affinity, electrophilicity, solvation, and local reactivity. On a locked DILIrank 2.0 development set (n = 376; 156 DILI-positive and 220 DILI-negative compounds), 10 × 5 scaffold validation gave AUROC/AUPRC values of 0.8249/0.7727 for ECFP, 0.8049/0.7430 for ECFP + FluxCore, and 0.8010/0.7261 for ECFP + StateFluxCore. The FluxCore AUROC decrement relative to ECFP was -0.0199 (95% paired-bootstrap CI, -0.0341 to -0.0072). Strict temporal and scaffold-novel tests likewise showed no consistent advantage, and an independent 5,367-compound genotoxicity benchmark reproduced the result (AUROC 0.7765 for ECFP versus 0.7732 for StateFluxCore). To distinguish limited predictive utility from inaccurate low-cost quantum chemistry, 24 parent-to-metabolite transformations were re-evaluated with 144 ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD single-point calculations. GFN2-xTB closely tracked DFT changes in electrophilicity (Pearson r = 0.963; MAE = 0.408 eV; 79.2% sign agreement). Thus, transformation-induced quantum reactivity can be physically meaningful without providing reliable incremental information for broad toxicity classification. These results argue that mechanistic fidelity and predictive utility should be validated separately when increasingly elaborate molecular representations are introduced into chemical machine learning.
items.authors: Aris Tsai
items.title_zh: StateFlux：物理验证的量子代谢状态网络对毒性预测的增值有限
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了通过补充质子化、代谢和量子化学反应性来改善毒性预测的机制分子表征。StateFlux将每种药物表示为一个化学和预测代谢状态的网络，具有节点级GFN2-xTB属性和边缘解析的电离势、电子亲和力、亲电性、溶剂化和局部反应性变化。在锁定的DILIrank 2.0开发集中（n = 376；156个DILI阳性和220个DILI阴性化合物），10 × 5的支架验证显示，ECFP的AUROC/AUPRC值为0.8249/0.7727，ECFP + FluxCore为0.8049/0.7430，ECFP + StateFluxCore为0.8010/0.7261。FluxCore相对于ECFP的AUROC下降为-0.0199。严格的时间和支架新颖性测试同样未显示出一致的优势，独立的5,367个化合物基因毒性基准重现了这一结果。为区分有限的预测效用与不准确的低成本量子化学，重新评估了24个母体到代谢物的转化。

items.title: A Convenient Crystalline Acyl Silane for the Colorimetric Titration of Diisobutylaluminum Hydride (DIBAL)
items.abstract: Due to the intense color associated with acyl silanes and their fast reaction with DIBAL to generate colorless alcohols, these properties were utilized to develop a colorimetric titration of DIBAL. A convenient crystalline acyl silane was identified that can be prepared on gram scale without the need for chromatographic purification by direct crystallization of the reaction products. Use of this material for the colorimetric titration of DIBAL and n-BuLi was possible. A variety of other 2 hydride and organometallic reagents were also tested and showed unsatisfactory endpoints. This work was performed by an American Chemical Society Project SEED student during their summer fellowship under the direction of a senior graduate student. The work disclosed could be suitable for application to an advanced undergraduate level laboratory related to the titration of reactive hydride reagents including the significance of atom effects on the physical and chemical properties or organic compounds.
items.authors: Stephen Collins, Colby Basnett, Joshua D. Sieber
items.title_zh: 一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷用于二异丁基铝氢化物的比色滴定
items.summary_zh: 由于酰基硅烷的强烈颜色及其与二异丁基铝氢化物（DIBAL）快速反应生成无色醇的特性，本文开发了一种DIBAL的比色滴定方法。研究中鉴定出一种方便的结晶酰基硅烷，可在克级规模上制备，无需通过色谱纯化，直接结晶反应产物。该材料可用于DIBAL和n-BuLi的比色滴定。还测试了多种其他氢化物和有机金属试剂，但其终点不理想。该研究由美国化学学会Project SEED的学生在一名高级研究生的指导下进行，适合应用于与反应性氢化物试剂滴定相关的高级本科实验室。

items.title: Closing the Loop Between Synthetic and Living Cells
items.abstract: Synthetic cells are moving beyond compartmentalised microreactors to become integrated components of biological networks that physically and chemically merge with their hosts. Existing reviews classify this field by mode of emission, by chemistry, or by architecture, and so describe the construct rather than its effect. This review takes the receiver's side, treating the functional adaptation of the living host as the readout of bio-hybrid function: how living cells probe their synthetic partners mechanically and adapt to them metabolically. We consider the bio-hybrid interface by how far the feedback loop (sensing-actuation) is closed and set out the evidence that would place a study in each of four tiers: open-loop, half-loop, partial feedback, and closed-loop. Read against these criteria, fifteen of the eighteen studies surveyed here are half-loop, three reach partial feedback, and none is closed-loop. All three partial-feedback systems work the same way, by metabolic interception, which the existing taxonomies have no category for. The one construct that comes closest to closed-loop operation contains no living cell at all. We then trace how single-cell coupling is scaling into hybrid prototissues that act as discovery platforms for pathological microenvironments, and we outline the translational barriers these constructs must survive to reach the clinic.
items.authors: Ion Ioannou
items.title_zh: 合成细胞与活细胞之间的闭环研究
items.summary_zh: 合成细胞正逐步超越分隔的微反应器，成为与宿主生物网络物理和化学融合的集成组件。现有综述通常按发射模式、化学性质或结构分类，侧重于构造而非其效应。本文从接收者的角度出发，探讨活细胞如何机械探测其合成伙伴并在代谢上适应。我们通过反馈回路的闭合程度（感知-执行）来考虑生物-合成界面，并提出将研究归入四个层次的证据：开环、半闭环、部分反馈和闭环。在所调查的十八项研究中，十五项为半闭环，三项达到部分反馈，且没有研究实现闭环。所有三种部分反馈系统通过代谢拦截工作，现有分类中没有相应类别。最接近闭环操作的构造中并不包含活细胞。我们还追踪单细胞耦合如何扩展为混合原型组织，作为病理微环境的发现平台，并概述这些构造在进入临床前必须克服的转化障碍。

items.title: A Physically Grounded Discrete Causal Recording Formalism Based on Spatiotemporal Isolation for Surface Propagation Pattern Reconstruction
items.authors: Junhyung Lee

items.title: Computer Vision for Predicting Electrochemical Reaction Performance from Electroanalytical Data
items.abstract: Electrosynthesis has surfaced as a key approach in modern synthesis, enabling more sustainable chemical transformations with reduced chemical waste. The accurate prediction of electrosynthesis performance is crucial for accelerating the discovery and design of reactions. Despite indisputable advances, the descriptor-based predictions fall short in representing the full reaction regime due to the high‑dimensional parameter space of electrosynthesis. Cyclic voltammograms, which are typically employed for mechanistic analysis, inherently contain rich information about electrochemical processes. Herein, we applied computer vision techniques to collect a cyclic voltammogram image database and trained a neural network directly on these image data. The resulting models achieved reliable performance in predicting electrosynthesis outcomes, demonstrating the potential of image-based deep learning for electrochemical reaction evaluation and data-driven electrosynthesis studies.
items.authors: Xinran Chen, Sven Erik Peters, Lutz Ackermann
items.title_zh: 基于计算机视觉预测电化学反应性能的研究
items.summary_zh: 电合成作为现代合成中的关键方法，促进了更可持续的化学转化并减少了化学废物。准确预测电合成性能对于加速反应的发现和设计至关重要。尽管已有显著进展，但基于描述符的预测在表征电合成的高维参数空间时仍显不足。循环伏安图通常用于机制分析，内含丰富的电化学过程信息。本文应用计算机视觉技术建立了循环伏安图像数据库，并直接在这些图像数据上训练了神经网络。所得到的模型在预测电合成结果方面表现可靠，展示了基于图像的深度学习在电化学反应评估和数据驱动电合成研究中的潜力。

items.title: Quantification of Levoglucosan in Biomass Burning Particulate Matter Using a Glucometer Test Strip
items.abstract: Levoglucosan (LG) is highly abundant in biomass pyrolysate and is widely used as a tracer for biomass burning in environmental sciences. Current analytical standards rely on gas or liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry (GC/LC-MS). Because these methods are expensive, there is a critical need for low-cost alternatives. This work explores using commercial glucometer strips to detect and quantify LG by first converting it into d-glucose with heat and acid. The hydrolysis condition was optimized to be at 150 °C, with 0.1 M H2SO4, for 60 min, while the sample was buffered at pH 7.3 for optimal detection. Following the optimization of the hydrolysis protocol, the glucometer strip signal exhibited a linear response, which was statistically indistinguishable from the response to d-glucose. However, when applied to authentic biomass burning filter samples, the glucometer method yielded concentrations approximately twice as high as GC–MS measurements. This discrepancy is likely due to interfering compounds in the sample matrix that also release d-glucose upon hydrolysis. Overall, this study establishes the proof-of-concept for using off-the-shelf glucometer testing strips for LG detection, while highlighting the distinct challenges of applying this method to complex environmental samples.
items.authors: Amanda Hanashiro Moraes, Antonio Mirante, Dylan Long, Faisal Hossain, Michael Serpe, Ran Zhao
items.title_zh: 利用血糖仪试纸定量生物质燃烧颗粒物中的脱乙酰葡萄糖
items.summary_zh: 脱乙酰葡萄糖（Levoglucosan, LG）在生物质热解产物中含量丰富，广泛用于环境科学中的生物质燃烧追踪。目前的分析标准依赖于气相或液相色谱联用质谱（GC/LC-MS），但这些方法成本高昂，因此亟需低成本替代方案。本研究探讨了使用商业血糖仪试纸通过加热和酸催化将LG转化为d-葡萄糖进行检测和定量。优化的水解条件为150°C，0.1 M H2SO4，持续60分钟，样品缓冲在pH 7.3以实现最佳检测。优化后，血糖仪试纸信号表现出线性响应，与d-葡萄糖的响应在统计上无显著差异。然而，在真实的生物质燃烧滤膜样品中，血糖仪法测得的浓度约为GC-MS测量值的两倍。这一差异可能是由于样品基质中干扰化合物的存在，它们在水解时也释放d-葡萄糖。总体而言，本研究为使用现成的血糖仪试纸检测LG提供了概念验证，同时突显了将该方法应用于复杂环境样品的独特挑战。

items.title: Framework Connectivity Tunes the Nuclear Spin Bath and Extends Coherence in Cu(II) Metal–Organic Framework Qubit Lattices
items.abstract: Designing solid-state spin-qubit arrays that retain long coherence at high spin density remains a central challenge in quantum information materials. In molecular qubits, this challenge arises because the same local coordination environment and lattice architecture that define the spin array also control the dominant decoherence channels, most notably nuclear-spin spectral diffusion and coupling to low-frequency phonons. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are therefore especially attractive because they combine dense, crystalline spin arrays with chemically programmable control over the coordination environment, framework connectivity, and supramolecular packing, yet a fundamental understanding of how specific structural changes translate into predictable relaxation behavior remains underdeveloped. Here we compare two closely related oxygen-coordinated Cu(II) frameworks, Cu-TPTC and Cu-TPTriC, that preserve the same first-sphere donor set while changing connectivity and supramolecular packing. Cu-TPTC comprises one-dimensional Cu–O chains assembled into hydrogen-bonded rods, whereas Cu-TPTriC forms coordination-connected Cu–O–Cu two-dimensional sheets that stack through interlayer aromatic contacts in the absence of hydrogen-bond stitching. Continuous-wave electron paramagnetic resonance (CW-EPR) spectroscopy shows that both lattices exhibit relatively narrow linewidths compared with a Cu–N porphyrinic benchmark, consistent with reduced ligand-derived superhyperfine broadening in an oxygenonly coordination sphere. Pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance measurements establish coherent spin control and reveal systematically longer spin–lattice relaxation times (T1) and phase-memory times (Tm) in Cu-TPTriC over 5–25 K, with Tm≈4.8 ± 0.011 μs at 5 K. This coherence gain persists despite substantially shorter Cu···Cu separations in Cu-TPTriC and is consistent with a reduced proton-bath density and modified lattice dynamics, as reflected in the weaker electron spin echo envelope modulation (ESEEM) observed for Cu-TPTriC. Together, these results suggest that within dense oxygen-coordinated Cu(II) framework lattices, the secondary-sphere nuclear-spin environment and lattice dynamics can play an important role in governing decoherence, potentially outweighing spin spacing alone.
items.authors: Kavish Saini, Sisheed Sivaraman, Prashanna Poudel, Bonaventure A. Odeke, Gajadhar Joshi, Manny de Jesus Lopez
items.title_zh: 框架连接性调节核自旋浴并延长Cu(II)金属有机框架量子比特的相干性
items.summary_zh: 设计能够在高自旋密度下保持长相干时间的固态自旋量子比特阵列是量子信息材料中的一个核心挑战。在分子量子比特中，这一挑战源于局部配位环境和晶格结构不仅定义了自旋阵列，还控制了主要的去相干通道，尤其是核自旋谱扩散和与低频声子的耦合。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其结合了密集的晶体自旋阵列与可化学编程的配位环境、框架连接性和超分子堆积而特别有吸引力，但对特定结构变化如何转化为可预测的弛豫行为的基本理解仍然不够成熟。本文比较了两个密切相关的氧配位Cu(II)框架Cu-TPTC和Cu-TPTriC，前者由一维Cu–O链组成，后者形成二维Cu–O–Cu片层。连续波电子顺磁共振（CW-EPR）光谱显示，两种晶格的线宽相对较窄。

items.title: Differentiable mass transfer modeling enables wet lab validated inverse analysis of liquid chromatography
items.abstract: Liquid chromatography (LC) is essential to organic synthesis and emerging selfdriving laboratories (SDLs), yet LC method development remains cost-intensive and dependent on expert intuition. Mechanistic chromatographic models offer a route to transferable and data-efficient method development, but their practical use is limited by the computational cost of inverse modeling and by the ill-posedness of parameter estimation from experimental chromatograms. Here we report a wet-lab-validated differentiable physics framework for LC inverse modeling. The framework integrates mechanistic column modeling with physics-informed machine learning (PIML) to enable efficient forward simulation and gradient-based inverse estimation of molecular transport and adsorption parameters from gradient-elution chromatograms. The primary PINN surrogate reproduces the mechanistic reference with a root-mean-square error of 10−3 in dimensionless concentration. To address the ill-posed nature of the inverse problem, we introduce an observability-guided experimental-design strategy that quantifies parameter identifiability and incorporates this information into the inverse objective to promote convergence toward the ground-truth parameters. Across 300 dry-lab simulation parameter combinations, the proposed strategy recovered the ground-truth parameters with relative errors ≤ 10% in 88.3% of cases using three gradient programs, compared with only 6.7% using a single gradient program. We further validate the framework against wet-lab LC 1 measurements, achieving an absolute retention-time error ≤ 10 s for 89.3% of samples and establishing a wet-lab database comprising 731 sets of transport and adsorption parameters extracted from 2,553 gradient-elution LC chromatograms. This work provides an observability-aware differentiable modeling foundation for autonomous LC method development and closed-loop analytical decision-making in AI-driven laboratories.
items.authors: Baochen Li, Zihan Zhou, Yanqing Yu, Sen Lin, Peng Wang, Tianshu Yu
items.title_zh: 可微分质量传输建模实现液相色谱逆向分析的实验验证
items.summary_zh: 液相色谱（LC）在有机合成和新兴自驱动实验室中至关重要，但其方法开发仍然成本高昂且依赖专家直觉。机制性色谱模型为可转移和数据高效的方法开发提供了途径，但逆向建模的计算成本和从实验色谱图中参数估计的病态性限制了其实际应用。本文报告了一种经过湿实验验证的可微分物理框架用于LC逆向建模。该框架将机制性柱模型与物理信息机器学习（PIML）相结合，实现了从梯度洗脱色谱图中高效的正向模拟和基于梯度的逆向估计。主要的PINN代理在无量纲浓度上重现机制性参考，均方根误差为10−3。为解决逆向问题的病态性，我们引入了一种可观测性引导的实验设计策略，量化参数可识别性，并将此信息纳入逆向目标，以促进向真实参数的收敛。在300个干实验室模拟参数组合中，该策略在88.3%的情况下以相对误差≤10%恢复了真实参数。

items.title: Gas-Phase Fragmentation in Mass Spectrometry Informs the Shape and Topology of Thiolated Metal Nanoclusters
items.abstract: Thiolated metal nanoclusters (NCs), comprising a metal core protected by outer-layer staple motifs, have attracted widespread interest due to their promising applications in catalysis, biosensing, and biomedicine. While mass spectrometry (MS) is widely used to determine the chemical composition of metal NCs via intact mass measurement, its potential for in-depth structural analysis via gas-phase fragmentation in tandem MS (MS/MS) has been relatively underexplored and mostly focused on the collision induced dissociation (CID) technique involving gas collisions. Herein, we systematically compared the fragmentation pathways between CID and an alternative method, surface induced dissociation (SID), using model Au NCs featuring distinct symmetries and structural motifs. We show that gas-phase fragments in CID and SID overall shared the common fragmentation behavior of breaking the outer staples of Au NCs, but with different preferences in the location of bond cleavages. In addition, SID showed characteristic Au losses in ellipsoidal Au NCs with trimeric staples; and fragmentation efficiency in CID and SID varied differentially according to the shape of the NCs. Building on these findings, we applied the method to study non-crystallizable Au-Ag NCs with heterogeneous stoichiometry. The SID fragmentation data helped locate the Au and Ag atoms, providing valuable insights into the synthetic pathway of the NCs, which was otherwise inaccessible experimentally. Together, these results support SID as a complementary MS/MS tool for metal NCs, with particular promise for heterogeneous systems like the mixed NCs that cannot be easily crystallized.
items.authors: Long Shi, Luoming Zhang, Zebo Li, Zijie Chen, Yuqing Yao, Ruikang Tang
items.title_zh: 气相碎裂质谱分析揭示硫醇化金属纳米簇的形状与拓扑
items.summary_zh: 硫醇化金属纳米簇（NCs）由金属核心和外层保护结构组成，因其在催化、生物传感和生物医学中的应用前景而受到广泛关注。尽管质谱（MS）常用于通过完整质量测量确定金属NCs的化学组成，但其在气相碎裂方面的深入结构分析潜力尚未得到充分探索，主要集中在气体碰撞诱导解离（CID）技术上。本文系统比较了CID与另一种方法——表面诱导解离（SID）之间的碎裂路径，使用了具有不同对称性和结构特征的模型金纳米簇。结果表明，CID和SID的气相碎片在整体上表现出相似的碎裂行为，但在键断裂位置上存在不同偏好。此外，SID在具有三聚体结构的椭球形金纳米簇中显示出特征性的金损失；CID和SID的碎裂效率则根据纳米簇的形状有所不同。基于这些发现，我们将该方法应用于研究具有异质化学计量的不可结晶化金银纳米簇，SID碎裂数据有助于定位金和银原子，为合成提供了宝贵的见解。

items.title: An analytical potential energy surface and variational transition-state theory kinetics of the NH3 + Br → NH2 + HBr hydrogen-abstraction reaction
items.abstract: We report the first full-dimensional analytical potential energy surface (PES) and a variational transitionstate theory (VTST) study of the endothermic gas-phase reaction NH3 + Br −−→ NH2 + HBr, completing the halogen series (NH3 + F, Cl, Br) of the group’s analytical surfaces. Stationary points and energetics were benchmarked at the CCSD(T)/CBS level with the bromine 3d shell frozen; a −3.51 kcal/mol spinorbit correction was added to the NH3 + Br asymptote for the Br(2P) splitting.
