In contrast, DMA and DSC glass-transition temperatures varied only modestly with aging temperature. The results show that mechanical measurements provide a more sensitive indicator of hygrothermal performance than Tg alone for this coating. The study provides material-level evidence relevant to the assessment of rubber-toughened epoxy barrier coatings under combined heat and moisture exposure.
items.authors: Parastou Kharazmi
items.title_zh: 环氧防护涂层的加速湿热老化研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了环氧防护涂层的湿热老化行为。涂层在20–80 °C下经历了长达14个月的水浸和干热暴露，监测了水分吸收、拉伸性能和热转变的变化，采用了重力测量、拉伸测试、动态力学分析（DMA）和差示扫描量热法（DSC）。结果显示，经过两个月的水和高温联合暴露，拉伸模量和强度的降低程度大于干燥老化，而干燥显著恢复了机械性能，表明湿气引起的塑化和膨胀是早期性能损失的主要原因。更长时间的暴露导致更严重的机械劣化，在60 °C下，材料在八个月内持续增重，随后出现减重，表明水分吸收由扩散控制向降解相关行为转变。与此相比，DMA和DSC的玻璃转变温度随老化温度变化不大。研究结果表明，机械测量比Tg更敏感地指示了该涂层的湿热性能。

items.title: Microchemical Strategies and AI-Enabled Biosensing for Non-Invasive Liquid Biopsy in Precision Oncology
items.abstract: Traditional blood-based liquid biopsy platforms have established crucial paradigms in precision oncology by enabling the longitudinal tracking of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) and circulating tumor cells (CTCs). However, blood sampling remains minimally invasive, requires dedicated clinical infrastructure, and is restricted by physiological boundaries such as the blood-brain barrier (BBB). Non-Invasive Liquid Biopsy (NILB) addresses these limitations by utilizing painlessly collected alternative biological matrices, including saliva, urine, breath, stool, sweat, sputum, tears, and cervical secretions. From a microchemical and analytical perspective, these biofluids present extreme analytical challenges: target biomarkers exist at attomolar-to-picomolar concentrations within dense, highly variable chemical matrices containing high background noise and interference. This review outlines the microchemical, physical, and bio-sensing strategies developed to overcome these pre-analytical and analytical barriers. We evaluate advanced microfluidic architectures, nanoscale deterministic lateral displacement, functionalized surface chemistry, isothermal signal amplification, and label-free optical spectroscopy. Furthermore, we evaluate how Artificial Intelligence (AI) and chemometric algorithms—such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and multivariate spectral extraction—decode low-abundance, fragmented multi-omic signatures from complex noise. Finally, we propose a standardized analytical framework to bridge point-of-care microchemical devices with routine clinical diagnostic pipelines.
items.authors: Samuel Long, Abigail Long
items.title_zh: 微化学策略与人工智能辅助生物传感在精准肿瘤学中的应用
items.summary_zh: 传统的基于血液的液体活检平台在精准肿瘤学中发挥了重要作用，能够长期追踪循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）和循环肿瘤细胞（CTCs）。然而，血液采样仍然是微创的，需专门的临床基础设施，并受到生理限制如血脑屏障的影响。非侵入性液体活检（NILB）通过利用无痛收集的替代生物基质（如唾液、尿液、呼气、粪便、汗液、痰液、泪液和宫颈分泌物）来解决这些限制。从微化学和分析的角度来看，这些生物液体在分析上面临极大挑战：目标生物标志物在密集且高度变异的化学基质中以阿托摩尔到皮摩尔浓度存在，背景噪声和干扰较高。本文综述了为克服这些前分析和分析障碍而开发的微化学、物理和生物传感策略，评估了先进的微流体架构、纳米尺度确定性侧向位移、功能化表面化学、等温信号放大和无标记光谱技术。此外，还评估了人工智能（AI）和化学计量算法（如支持向量机（SVM）、卷积神经网络（CNN）等）的应用。

items.title: CuBr-Catalyzed Enantioselective Synthesis of Decahydroquinoxaline-Based
items.abstract: A CuBr-catalyzed one-pot protocol provides access to decahydroquinoxaline-based bis(propargylamines) from readily available terminal alkynes, aromatic aldehydes, and a C2symmetric chiral diamine. The three-component coupling proceeds at 120 °C within 12 h, affording the products in 58–93% yields with diastereomeric ratios of up to 99:1. The synthetic utility of the protocol is illustrated by the ZnI2-mediated conversion of a representative bis(propargylamine) (7a) into the corresponding axially chiral allene (8a) with 90% ee. This approach enables the stereoselective construction of bis(propargylamines) and demonstrates their application as precursors to axially chiral allenes.
items.authors: Alakonda, Mariappan Periasamy
items.title_zh: CuBr催化的对映选择性合成十氢喹啉基化合物
items.summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种CuBr催化的一锅法合成十氢喹啉基双(丙炔胺)的方法，反应原料为易得的末端炔烃、芳香醛和C2对称手性二胺。三组分耦合反应在120°C下进行12小时，产物收率为58-93%，其非对映体比高达99:1。通过ZnI2介导的转化示例，展示了代表性双(丙炔胺)(7a)转化为相应的轴手性烯烃(8a)，其对映体过量为90%。该方法实现了双(丙炔胺)的立体选择性构建，并展示了其作为轴手性烯烃前体的应用潜力。

items.title: Localizing and quantifying the dynamic interfacial proton population in alkaline electrocatalysis
items.abstract: In alkaline electrocatalysis, electrostatic theory predicts, and experiments confirm, interfacial acidity that deviates from bulk pHb. The location and magnitude of the proton population within the electric double layer (EDL) and its evolution with catalytic turnover have remained unresolved, leaving a critical gap for mechanistic interpretation across proton-coupled electrocatalysis. Here, using showcase alkaline (pHb 13) hydrogen evolution on Au, electrochemical fluorescence microscopy combined with electrostatic modelling demonstrates an apparent interfacial pH inversion of more than eight units within 1 nm of 1 the electrode, below the outer Helmholtz plane. This EDL proton population is dynamic. At hydrogen-evolution onset, the reaction can draw from it. As electrocatalytic turnover increases, H+ consumption outpaces its electrostatic replenishment, favouring a water-based reaction pathway. Localizing and quantifying this dynamic proton population closes a key gap in the mechanistic interpretation of alkaline hydrogen evolution with a proton-availability framework likely relevant to alkaline electrocatalysis and electrosynthesis at large.
items.authors: Xinwei Zhu, Daniel Ohm, Qiqi Yang, Adrian Heinritz, Paramaconi Rodriguez, Xiaomin Liu
items.title_zh: 局部化与定量分析碱性电催化中的动态界面质子群体
items.summary_zh: 在碱性电催化中，静电理论预测并实验确认界面酸度偏离体相pHb。电双层（EDL）内质子群体的位置和大小及其随催化转化的演变尚未解决，成为质子耦合电催化机制解释的关键空白。本文通过在金（Au）上进行碱性（pHb 13）氢气演化的示范，结合电化学荧光显微镜与静电模型，展示了电极表面1 nm内的界面pH反转超过八个单位，位于外海尔姆霍兹平面以下。该EDL质子群体是动态的。在氢气演化开始时，反应可以从中提取质子。随着电催化转化的增加，H+的消耗速度超过其静电补充，促进了基于水的反应路径。局部化和定量分析这一动态质子群体填补了碱性氢气演化机制解释中的关键空白，质子可用性框架可能与广泛的碱性电催化和电合成相关。

items.title: Dynamic Ni–Fe Interfaces Regulate Stimulated Geological Hydrogen Production
items.abstract: Geological hydrogen (Geo-H2) generated by water-rock redox reactions could expand low-carbon hydrogen resources by tapping reducing equivalents stored in subsurface minerals. Stimulated Geo-H2 production remains difficult to engineer because the reaction sequence connecting rockhosted Fe2+ release to H2 evolution is incompletely constrained. Here, we support an interfacial sequence linking olivine Fe2+ release, an Fe(II)-bearing hydroxide intermediate state, Fe3O4bearing product growth, and Ni redistribution at evolving Fe-rich interfaces. Across olivine-rich rocks, basalt, and Fe(OH)2 model systems, trace dissolved Ni2+ enhanced H2 evolution over the examined temperatures, reaching rates more than two orders of magnitude above previously reported Geo-H2 systems at comparable temperatures, and dissolved Ni2+ outperformed solid Ni additives under matched additive-form comparisons. Fe-normalized controls show that dissolved Fe2+ alone produced far less H2 than Fe2+ converted to Fe(OH)2, supporting Fe(II)-hydroxide chemistry as a productive gateway to the magnetite-forming pathway. Electron microscopy, spectroscopy, and cross-sectional EDS connected olivine Fe redistribution with Fe-rich alteration products and Ni recruitment, whereas first-principles calculations indicated that adsorbed Ni-Fe sites stabilize dissociated H more strongly. The Ni response was finite, with excess loading suppressing H2 evolution through competing Ni2+ reduction and other high-Ni interfacial inhibitory pathways. These results connect Fe release, hydroxide-associated Fe(II) chemistry, magnetite-bearing product growth, and Ni loading and accessibility, providing an interfacial framework for promoting water reduction in stimulated Geo-H2 systems.
items.authors: Yifan Gao, Jakob Krogh Nielsen, Seok Hee Han, Ming Lei, Haihui Lan, Yuheng Wu
items.title_zh: 动态镍-铁界面调控刺激地质氢气生成
items.summary_zh: 地质氢（Geo-H2）通过水-岩氧还原反应生成，能够利用地下矿物中储存的还原当量，扩展低碳氢资源。刺激性Geo-H2生产的工程化仍然困难，因为连接岩石中Fe2+释放与H2生成的反应序列尚不完全明确。本研究支持一种界面序列，连接橄榄石Fe2+释放、Fe(II)含氢氧化物中间态、Fe3O4产物生长及镍在富铁界面上的重分布。在橄榄石富集岩石、玄武岩和Fe(OH)2模型系统中，微量溶解的Ni2+在所考察的温度下增强了H2的生成速率，达到之前报道的Geo-H2系统的两倍以上，且在相同添加剂条件下，溶解的Ni2+优于固体Ni添加剂。Fe归一化对照显示，单独的溶解Fe2+生成的H2远低于转化为Fe(OH)2的Fe2+，支持Fe(II)-氢氧化物化学作为形成磁铁矿途径的有效通道。电子显微镜、光谱学和横截面EDS连接了橄榄石Fe重分布与富铁改性产物及镍的招募，而第一性原理计算表明，吸附的Ni-Fe位点对解离氢的稳定性更强。镍的反应是有限的，过量负载。

items.title: Increasing high-temperature creep life via improved directional solidification: A novel Ni-based single crystal superalloy reinforced by in-situ MC carbide fibers
items.authors: H.Y. Guo, Z.H. Tan, Y.M. Li, J. Meng, J.J. Yu, X.G. Wang

items.title: Highly Luminescent Alkyl- and Alkoxy-Terminated Silicon Quantum Dots via Aging Following Single-Step Plasma Synthesis and Functionalization
items.abstract: Nonthermal plasma synthesis enables the continuous production and immediate surface functionalization of silicon quantum dots (Si QDs) in a single, flow-through reactor. While this process occurs on a millisecond timescale, the resulting nanocrystals are often limited by low photoluminescence quantum yields (PLQY) due to persistent surface defects. In this work, we demonstrate that a minimal post-treatment, aging the Si QDs in specific solvents, can enhance the PLQY to ~50%, approaching the performance of much more complex solution-phase methods. We find that the choice of the surface ligand and solvent is critical: hexanol-terminated Si QDs exhibit significantly higher initial and final PLQYs than decene-terminated particles, likely due to the faster reaction of alcohols with electrophilic surface sites in the gas phase. Among the solvents investigated, chloroform consistently yields the highest PLQY. Furthermore, we show that light irradiation at 400 nm and 633 nm drastically accelerates the Si QD aging process, reducing the aging time from hundreds of hours to under 20 hours. This practical “synthesize and forget” strategy offers an efficient pathway for optimizing high-PLQY Si QDs for applications in optoelectronics and bioimaging.
items.authors: Masoumeh Amirifard, Zhaohan Li, Uwe Kortshagen
items.title_zh: 通过老化提升硅量子点光致发光量子产率的研究
items.summary_zh: 非热等离子体合成技术能够在单一流动反应器中连续生产并即时表面功能化硅量子点（Si QDs）。然而，所得到的纳米晶体通常由于表面缺陷而导致光致发光量子产率（PLQY）较低。在本研究中，我们证明了通过在特定溶剂中老化Si QDs的简单后处理，可以将PLQY提升至约50%，接近更复杂溶液相方法的性能。表面配体和溶剂的选择至关重要：己醇终止的Si QDs表现出显著高于十烯终止颗粒的初始和最终PLQY，可能是由于醇类与气相中电亲和表面位点的反应更快。在所研究的溶剂中，氯仿始终提供最高的PLQY。此外，我们还发现400 nm和633 nm的光照射显著加速Si QD的老化过程，将老化时间从数百小时缩短至20小时以内。这一“合成后即忘”的策略为优化高PLQY Si QDs在光电和生物成像应用中的使用提供了高效途径。

items.title: Fragment-Based Representation Learning for Polymers and Heterogeneous Formulations
items.authors: Jianxin He, Subhamoy Mahajan, Nathaniel Straight, Ying Li

items.title: Cobalt(III)-Catalyzed Synthesis of Aminoisoquinolones and Amino-2-Pyridones via C–H Functionalization with Ynamides: A Combined Experimental and Computational Study
items.abstract: Carbon–hydrogen (C–H) functionalization methodologies typically rely on electron-poor π-systems, whereas the engagement of electron-rich counterparts remains underdeveloped. Herein, we report the first cobalt-catalyzed, site- and regioselective C–H functionalization of O-phenyl hydroxamic acids with electron-rich ynamides to afford aminoisoquinolones and 2-pyridones. Combined experimental and computational mechanistic studies reveal a pathway governed by Curtin–Hammett kinetics, featuring reversible concerted metalation deprotonation, irreversible selectivitydetermining migratory insertion, and turnover-limiting C–N reductive elimination. The transformation proceeds via divergent pathways, wherein the major 4-aminoisoquinolone is generated through a Co(III) cycle and the minor 3aminoisoquinolone transits a Co(III)/Co(I) redox manifold. Furthermore, high-valent Co(V) nitrenoids, which are frequently invoked in related reactions, are ruled out as catalytic intermediates.
items.authors: Yujie Cao, Justin D. DeBow, Elise Mach, Melody Wu, Veronica Carta, Kevin G. M. Kou
items.title_zh: 钴(III)催化的氨基异喹啉和氨基-2-吡啶酮合成研究
items.summary_zh: 碳-氢（C–H）功能化方法通常依赖于电子贫乏的π-体系，而电子丰富的体系应用仍不成熟。本研究首次报道了钴催化的O-苯基羟肟酸与电子丰富的炔胺进行位点和区域选择性的C–H功能化，合成氨基异喹啉和2-吡啶酮。结合实验和计算的机理研究揭示了一个由Curtin–Hammett动力学主导的反应路径，特点是可逆的金属化去质子化、不可逆的选择性决定性迁移插入和限制转化的C–N还原消除。该转化通过不同的路径进行，主要的4-氨基异喹啉通过Co(III)循环生成，而次要的3-氨基异喹啉则经历Co(III)/Co(I)氧化还原过程。此外，常被提及的高价Co(V)氮烯中间体被排除在催化中。

items.title: Resolving Active Sites in Cu/ZnO Methanol Synthesis via Coupled Modelling of Surface Reconstruction and Coverage-dependent Kinetics
items.abstract: Identifying active sites in heterogeneous catalysis is central to fundamental understanding and designing catalysts, yet it becomes challenging when surface structures, adsorbate coverages and reaction kinetics co-evolve under operating conditions. This challenge is exemplified by the enduring controversy over the active site for methanol synthesis over ZnO/Cu catalysts. Here we combine global structure exploration, grand-canonical sampling, a reactive CuZnCHO machine-learning potential and coverage-consistent microkinetics to establish a condition-dependent picture of the active surface. We show that Zn-Cu alloys, ZnO-like overlayers and partially reduced Zn species are not mutually exclusive active-site models, but distinct states within the same dynamic structural landscape. Activity is maximized within an intermediate thermodynamic window, where a Cu-Zn/Cu-Cu bifunctional ensemble forms near a step rim. These findings reconcile seemingly conflicting active-site assignments and establish a general framework for understanding activity in complicated systems. More broadly, our approach provides a paradigm for identifying activity-structure relationships in catalytic systems.
items.authors: Zhening Fang, Chenyu Wu, Changxi Yang, Wenbo Xie, Zhi Liu, Peijun Hu
items.title_zh: 通过耦合建模解析Cu/ZnO甲醇合成的活性位点
items.summary_zh: 在异相催化中，识别活性位点对理解和设计催化剂至关重要，但在操作条件下，表面结构、吸附物覆盖率和反应动力学的共同演化使这一过程变得复杂。以ZnO/Cu催化剂的甲醇合成活性位点争议为例，我们结合全球结构探索、广义正则采样、反应性CuZnCHO机器学习势能和覆盖率一致的微动力学，建立了条件依赖的活性表面图景。研究表明，Zn-Cu合金、ZnO类覆盖层和部分还原的Zn物种并非互斥的活性位点模型，而是在同一动态结构景观中的不同状态。在中间热力学窗口内，Cu-Zn/Cu-Cu双功能集合体在台阶边缘附近形成，从而最大化活性。这些发现调和了看似矛盾的活性位点分配，并为理解复杂系统中的活性建立了通用框架。我们的研究方法为识别催化系统中的活性-结构关系提供了范例。

items.title: Hydrophobic Interaction as the Result of Interfacial Frustration
items.abstract: The hydrophobic effect is one of the most consequential organizing principles in molecular biology, laying the foundation for explanation of concepts like protein folding, molecular recognition, membrane self-assembly and allosteric communication. Its conceptual description remains dependent primarily on a framework established in the mid-twentieth century, as per which, hydrophobic association is driven primarily by the entropic release of water molecules ordered around non-polar surfaces. The framework, while thermodynamically correct, is incomplete in some ways that have become increasingly consequential as structural, dynamic and calorimetric data have been accumulated over the years. In this paper, I propose a reframing of the hydrophobic effect in terms of interfacial frustration- a continuous, geometry sensitive incompatibility between the hydrogen bond requirements of liquid water and non-polar surfaces it is forced to accommodate. This paper argues that hydrophobic association represents the resolution of this frustration, rather than the mere expulsion of constrained solvent. This reframing provides a unified mechanistic account of phenomena that the classical picture cannot explain alone, or treats as separate problems: the geometry dependence of hydrophobic association strength, the qualitative distinction between small-solute and extended-surface hydrophobicity, the thermodynamic crossover with temperature and the propagation of allosteric signals through hydrophobic protein cores. This paper also proposes that hydrophobic cores in proteins are not passive burial sites, but active and dynamic modulators of a distributed frustration landscape. Allosteric communication through these cores operates through cooperative frustration redistribution, a mechanism distinct from classical strain propagation, but consistent with the growing body of evidence that allostery frequently proceeds through changes in protein dynamics rather than average structure. This framework generates specific, experimentally testable predictions that distinguish it from both the classical entropic model and existing density functional theories of hydrophobicity
items.authors: Prithwish Mukherjee
items.title_zh: 界面挫折导致的疏水相互作用
items.summary_zh: 疏水效应是分子生物学中最重要的组织原则之一，为蛋白质折叠、分子识别、膜自组装和别构通信等概念的解释奠定了基础。传统上，疏水结合被视为非极性表面周围水分子有序排列导致的熵释放驱动。然而，随着结构、动态和热量测定数据的积累，这一框架在某些方面显得不够完整。本文提出将疏水效应重新框定为界面挫折，即液态水的氢键需求与非极性表面之间的几何敏感不兼容。本文认为，疏水结合是对这种挫折的解决，而不仅仅是受限溶剂的排斥。这一重新框定为经典理论无法单独解释的现象提供了统一的机制性解释。

items.title: DNA-Encoded Chemical Diversification of mRNA Display Libraries
items.abstract: mRNA display can survey vast peptide populations, but the chemical diversity available to selection remains largely constrained by translation. DNA-encoded libraries possess the complementary advantage: synthetic diversity can be introduced through split-and-pool chemistry, although without the peptide scaffolds and evolutionary framework provided by translation. Here, we combine these approaches by performing DNA-encoded chemical diversification directly on mRNAdisplayed peptides. Successive DNA-barcoding steps were coupled to cysteine alkylation and lysine acylation, allowing each chemical operation to be recorded while preserving the linkage between peptide and encoding nucleic acid. Application of this workflow to a five-residue peptide library generated approximately 20 million nominal chemical structures. Selection against carbonic anhydrase IX preferentially enriched library members encoded for a carboxybenzene sulfonamide modification, including a lysine-containing peptide that was independently resynthesized and shown to bind CAIX with a Kd of 26 nM. These results establish a complete progression from encoded chemical diversification and selection to hit identification, resynthesis, and binding validation, providing a practical framework for the discovery of chemically modified peptide ligands.
items.authors: Emily Anacleto, Emilyn B. Aucoin, Kirsten Monroe, Ryan Hili
items.title_zh: DNA编码的mRNA展示库化学多样性研究
items.summary_zh: mRNA展示技术能够筛选大量肽库，但其化学多样性受限于翻译过程。DNA编码库通过分裂-池化化学引入合成多样性，但缺乏翻译提供的肽支架和进化框架。本研究将这两种方法结合，在mRNA展示的肽上直接进行DNA编码的化学多样化。通过连续的DNA条形码步骤与半胱氨酸烷基化和赖氨酸酰化相结合，记录每个化学操作，同时保持肽与编码核酸之间的连接。对五肽库的应用生成了约2000万个名义化学结构。针对碳酸酐酶IX的筛选优先富集了编码羧基苯磺酰胺修饰的库成员，包括一个含赖氨酸的肽，其独立合成后显示与CAIX的结合常数Kd为26 nM。这些结果建立了从编码化学多样化、筛选到命中识别、重合成和结合验证的完整进程，为发现化学修饰的肽配体提供了实用框架。

items.title: Pt(II)-Flavin Complexes As Anticancer And Antibacterial Agents
items.abstract: We report a new chelating pyridyl–imine ligand bearing a riboflavin-derived pendant group and its Pt(II) complexes 1 and 2, designed as cisplatin- and oxaliplatin-like derivatives. Both complexes reacted with DNA and a histone-derived peptide, with 1 showing markedly higher covalent reactivity. However, this trend was not reflected in biological activity. Complex 2 displayed micromolar antiproliferative effects and pronounced antibacterial activity, particularly against Bacillus subtilis, whereas 1 was inactive in the tested models. Cellular accumulation studies excluded enhanced Pt uptake as the origin of this difference. Fluorescence microscopy performed on Escherichia Coli and Bacillus subtilis indicated that 2 affects bacterial DNA and membrane potential, consistent with a dual antibacterial mechanism. Comparison with oxaliplatin and the free flavin ligands showed that both the Pt–oxalate fragment and the riboflavin-containing ligand are required for activity.
items.authors: Maria Jesus Moran Plata, Igor V. Esarev, Nitin Kumar, Laura Marretta, Leo Pontfort, Ana Cristina Carrasco
items.title_zh: Pt(II)-黄素复合物作为抗癌和抗菌剂的研究
items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一种新型的螯合吡啶-亚胺配体，该配体具有源自核黄素的侧链及其Pt(II)复合物1和2，旨在设计为顺铂和奥沙利铂类衍生物。两种复合物均与DNA和组蛋白衍生肽发生反应，其中复合物1显示出显著更高的共价反应性。然而，这一趋势在生物活性中并未体现。复合物2表现出微摩尔级的抗增殖效果和显著的抗菌活性，特别是对枯草芽孢杆菌，而复合物1在测试模型中无活性。细胞积累研究排除了增强的铂摄取作为差异的来源。对大肠杆菌和枯草芽孢杆菌进行的荧光显微镜观察表明，复合物2影响细菌DNA和膜电位，符合双重抗菌机制。与奥沙利铂和游离黄素配体的比较显示，Pt-草酸盐片段和含核黄素的配体均是活性所必需的。

items.title: Intramolecular N-Alkylation of O-Aryloximes Facilitates N–O Homolysis and Iminyl Radical Cyclization
items.abstract: An attempt to improve a microwave-promoted iminyl radical cyclization cascade targeting the Securinega alkaloid virosinine A revealed that the process could be initiated at lower temperatures (66 °C versus 100 °C) under Finkelstein conditions. Mechanistic experiments and DFT calculations indicate that Finkelstein bromination or iodination facilitates intramolecular N-alkylation. This lowers the N–O BDE of the substrate and permits homolysis at lower temperatures than previously observed.
items.authors: Osasere J. Osayawe, Joshua D. Morgan, Benjamin T. Melton, Ethan P. Downing, Jesus A. Botello, Alexander Ramos
items.title_zh: O-芳氧肟的分子内N-烷基化与亚氨基自由基环化研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在改善微波促进的亚氨基自由基环化级联反应，以靶向Securinega生物碱virosinine A。结果表明，在Finkelstein条件下，该过程可以在较低温度（66°C对比100°C）下启动。机制实验和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算表明，Finkelstein溴化或碘化反应促进了分子内N-烷基化。这降低了底物的N–O键断裂能（BDE），使得在比之前观察到的更低温度下发生均裂反应成为可能。

items.title: Fundamental Investigations into the Activity and Stability of Iron-Based Bimetallic Catalysts for the Oxygen Evolution Reaction
items.abstract: Engineering electrocatalyst resistance to degradation in alkaline media remains a major challenge for developing stable, earth-abundant oxygen evolution reaction (OER) anodes. Here, we combined acid–base titration and X-ray fluorescence to quantify Fe dissolution from a series of bimettalic FexMy (oxy)hydroxides deposited on Fe foils (My = Sn, Hf, Mn, Se) at 1.66–2.11 VRHE, showing that apparently stable current densities and cycle voltametery alone can mask significant electrode degradation. After initial restructuring (~2 h), end-of-life anodes showed steady-state dissolution rates of 0.15–0.67 mgFe cm⁻² h⁻¹ near OER onset (~1.75 VRHE). Across alloys, dissolution rates and OER overpotentials correlated with the Fe–My electronegativity difference. Dissolution rates were highest for those alloys where My was less electronegative than Fe, and XPS revealed a more reduced surface with higher concentrations of hydroxoligands. Spin-polarized DFT+U shows Sn reduces neighboring Fe atoms, shifting the potential-limiting OER step to Fe–O* formation, lowering its formation free energy (consistent with a reduced OER overpotential); but elongating Fe-O bonds (perhaps accelerating dissolution). Generalizing these results toward future work, we suggest that the dissolution resistance of FeOOH surfaces may be controlled by alloy-driven modulation of their protonation state (revealed by XPS) and Fe-O bond character (probed by DFT).
items.authors: Shayan Hoseini, Foroogh Khezeli, Ashley Head, Craig Plaisance, Theodore Walker
items.title_zh: 铁基双金属催化剂在氧气演化反应中的活性与稳定性研究
items.summary_zh: 在碱性介质中，增强电催化剂抵抗降解的能力是开发稳定、丰富的氧气演化反应（OER）阳极的主要挑战。本文结合酸碱滴定和X射线荧光技术，定量分析了在1.66–2.11 VRHE下沉积在铁箔上的一系列双金属FexMy（氧）氢氧化物（My = Sn, Hf, Mn, Se）的铁溶解情况，发现表面稳定的电流密度和循环伏安法可能掩盖显著的电极降解。在初始重构后（约2小时），阳极的稳态溶解速率为0.15–0.67 mgFe cm⁻² h⁻¹，接近OER起始点（约1.75 VRHE）。不同合金的溶解速率与Fe–My的电负性差异相关，电负性低于Fe的合金溶解速率最高，XPS分析显示表面更还原，羟基配体浓度较高。DFT+U计算表明，Sn能还原邻近的Fe原子，降低OER的形成自由能，但可能加速Fe-O键的延长和溶解。我们建议，FeOOH表面的溶解抗性可能通过合金驱动的质子化状态调节来控制。

items.title: Predicting the Thermodynamic Stability of Ce/Ti Nanoclusters under Synthetic Conditions
items.abstract: Predicting which molecular species will form under a given set of synthetic conditions requires determining their thermodynamic stability relative to precursors and competing products. For complex molecular systems in solution, this requires both accurate electronic-structure calculations and sufficient configurational sampling. Here, we investigate two hexanuclear Ce/Ti clusters that form under different synthetic conditions: a yellow Ce IV 4 Ti 2 cluster obtained under mild conditions and a red Ce III 2 Ti 4 cluster, presented here for the first time, that requires higher temperature, longer reaction times, and increased Ti precursor concentration. To determine whether the red cluster is thermodynamically less stable or instead kinetically hindered, we combine explicit-solvent configurational sampling using a fine-tuned foundation machine-learned interatomic potential with density functional theory calculations of the Gibbs free energies of formation. Simulated annealing identifies configurations approximately 1 eV lower in energy than those obtained by direct relaxation of the crystallographic structures. Despite requiring more forcing synthetic conditions, Ce III 2 Ti 4 is predicted to be 4.48 eV more stable than Ce IV 4 Ti 2 . Comparison with a hypothetical Ce IV 2 Ti 4 cluster separates this difference into a 2.86 eV stabilization associated with the Ce III oxidation state and a further 1.62 eV stabilization associated with the Ti-rich composition and corresponding cluster structure. The preference for CeIII is also found for the isolated solvated Ce ions, while the sampled Ce III 2 Ti 4 structures show reduced repulsion between capping ligands and a less distorted metal core. The calculations therefore identify Ce III 2 Ti 4 as the thermodynamic product, while its formation only under more forcing conditions is consistent with kinetic limitation. The results show that predicting the thermodynamic product in solution requires configurational sampling beyond direct optimization of experimentally determined structures.
items.authors: Liping Liu, Haley Wellman, Zi-Ming Ye, Andrea Darù, Ria Zaman, Kent O. Kirlikovali
items.title_zh: 预测合成条件下Ce/Ti纳米簇的热力学稳定性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在不同合成条件下形成的两种六核Ce/Ti簇：在温和条件下获得的黄色Ce IV 4 Ti 2簇和首次提出的红色Ce III 2 Ti 4簇，该簇需要更高的温度、更长的反应时间和增加的Ti前驱体浓度。为确定红色簇是热力学上不稳定还是动力学受阻，我们结合了显式溶剂的构型采样和基于密度泛函理论的吉布斯自由能计算。模拟退火法识别出能量比直接松弛晶体结构获得的构型低约1 eV的构型。尽管需要更强的合成条件，预测显示Ce III 2 Ti 4比Ce IV 4 Ti 2稳定4.48 eV。与假设的Ce IV 2 Ti 4簇的比较将这一差异分解为与Ce III氧化态相关的2.86 eV的稳定化。

items.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Eight Ru-based catalytic hydrogenolysis configurations for the upcycling of waste polyolefins
items.abstract: In recent years, plastics demand has exceeded 400 million tons annually worldwide. Due to their mechanical and chemical resistance and low cost, polyolefins, including polyethylene (PE), represent beyond 50% of global plastic production, contributing to the generation and accumulation of plastic waste. Traditional waste management technologies, including landfilling and incineration, result into greenhouse gases emissions and potential loss of valuable carbon sources, whereas mechanical recycling strategies generally imply materials degradation and loss of mechanical properties. Hence, chemical recycling technologies are emerging as low-impact strategies to valorize plastic waste. Assessing the potential impacts of chemical recycling alternatives is crucial to support developers in ensuring environmental competitiveness at higher scales. To this end, we propose a comparative Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) of eight potential alternatives for ruthenium-based catalytic hydrogenolysis of PE into valuable lubricants and fuels. Assessed configurations adopt different driving forces to power the reaction: thermal energy, mechanical energy and thermally assisted mechanochemical configurations. Results outline how the highest energy consuming configurations entail the highest burdens, whereas thermally-assisted mechanochemical processes result into the lowest impacts. Overall, the assessment shows that energy-efficient thermos-mechanochemical technologies entail the lowest environmental profile, providing valuable information for developers towards selecting and optimizing the most competitive configurations.
items.authors: Antonio Cosimo Pio Trimboli, Francesco Brenda, Francesco Arfelli, Riccardo Pellegrini, Elena Groppo, Lars Borchardt
items.title_zh: 八种基于钌的催化氢解配置的生命周期评估
items.summary_zh: 近年来，全球塑料需求超过每年4亿吨。聚烯烃（如聚乙烯）因其机械和化学抗性及低成本，占全球塑料生产的50%以上，导致塑料废物的产生和积累。传统废物管理技术（如填埋和焚烧）会产生温室气体排放并可能造成有价值碳源的损失，而机械回收策略通常导致材料降解和机械性能损失。因此，化学回收技术作为低影响策略逐渐兴起。评估化学回收替代方案的潜在影响对支持开发者确保环境竞争力至关重要。为此，我们提出了对八种基于钌的聚乙烯催化氢解为有价值润滑剂和燃料的潜在替代方案的比较生命周期评估（LCA）。评估的配置采用不同的驱动方式：热能、机械能和热辅助机械化学配置。结果表明，能耗最高的配置承担了最高的环境负担，而热辅助机械化学过程则产生最低的影响。

items.title: Acoustic Optimization and Standardized Fabrication of a Biomimetic Liver Phantom for Quantitative Multimodal Imaging
items.abstract: We previously developed a structurally biomimetic liver phantom composed of alginate units that reproduce the scale and organization of hepatic lobules. Here, we optimized the non-steatotic baseline formulation and fabrication workflow to more closely reproduce normal liver properties across ultrasound, CT, and MRI. The updated formulation was evaluated using clinical imaging systems, followed by quantitative water-tank characterization of speed of sound (SoS) and attenuation coefficient (AC). Increasing alginate concentration and incorporating glycerol into both the alginate phase and calcium chloride crosslinking bath reduced the SoS mismatch while preserving the biomimetic architecture. Fabrication was further standardized using 3D-printed molds to precisely control phantom volume and component ratios across clinical-imaging and water-tank configurations. On clinical systems, the updated formulation achieved a SoS of ~ 1540 m/s and AC of ~ 0.4 dB/cm/MHz, together with CT attenuation of ~ 44 HU, MRI-PDFF of ~ 2.5 % and T2* ~ 41 ms. Quantitative immersion-based characterization independently confirmed liver-relevant acoustic properties with a SoS of ~ 1557 m/s and AC of ~ 0.34 dB/cm/MHz at 3.5 MHz). Together, these values were within or approached reported ranges for non-steatotic liver. The resulting platform provides a reproducible, standardized multimodal baseline for the subsequent incorporation of controlled steatotic microstructure and development of quantitative imaging biomarkers.
items.authors: Vatan Sipahi, Tara Movaghar, Anbarin Khalid, Shariq Ali, Liqiang Ren, Yue Zhang
items.title_zh: 生物仿生肝脏模型的声学优化与标准化制造
items.summary_zh: 我们之前开发了一种由海藻酸盐单元组成的结构仿生肝脏模型，能够再现肝小叶的规模和组织。本研究优化了非脂肪性基线配方和制造流程，以更准确地再现超声、CT和MRI下的正常肝脏特性。更新的配方通过临床成像系统进行评估，并进行了定量水槽特性测试，测量声速（SoS）和衰减系数（AC）。增加海藻酸盐浓度并在海藻酸盐相和氯化钙交联浴中加入甘油，降低了SoS不匹配，同时保持了仿生结构。使用3D打印模具标准化制造，以精确控制模型体积和成分比例。更新后的配方在临床系统中实现了约1540 m/s的SoS和约0.4 dB/cm/MHz的AC，CT衰减约为44 HU，MRI-PDFF约为2.5%，T2*约为41 ms。定量浸没特性测试独立确认了与肝脏相关的声学特性，SoS约为1557 m/s，AC约为0.34 dB/cm/MHz（在3.5 MHz下）。这些值在非脂肪性肝脏的报告范围内。该平台提供了可重复的、标准化的多模态基线。

items.title: Polymer Informatics in the Era of Foundation Models: From Representation to Autonomous Design
items.abstract: Foundation models, pretrained on broad datasets and adapted to multiple tasks, offer a way to reuse chemical knowledge across polymer property prediction and inverse design. Realizing this opportunity requires connecting learned representations to materials whose properties also depend on molecular populations, formulation, processing, and measurement conditions. Here, we review advances in polymer foundation models and the data, representations, and experimental workflows that support their use in materials design. We organize these developments around the polymer material state, a description linking chemical identity to molecular distributions, architecture, morphology, and preparation history relevant to a target property. This organization connects data resources and pretraining strategies to questions about what models learn, how that knowledge transfers, and which experimental choices it can support. We compare learning objectives and adaptation methods, examine representations of polymer chemistry and state, and follow inverse design from candidate generation through synthesis and processing to validation. Pretrained models now support prediction across multiple properties and generation for specified targets, with selected polymer candidates reaching synthesis and thermal characterization. Broader polymer design campaigns show how precursor accessibility, polymerization outcomes, and specimen preparation influence whether a predicted advantage becomes a measured material response. Building on this evidence, we discuss opportunities to combine chemical pretraining with richer sample information and to assess transfer across polymer families, preparation conditions, and experimental campaigns. The resulting synthesis connects model development to a practical objective for polymer informatics: reducing the new experimentation needed to obtain materials with reproducible, targeted performance.
items.authors: Jianxin He, Ying Li
items.title_zh: 基础模型时代的聚合物信息学：从表征到自主设计
items.summary_zh: 基础模型通过在广泛数据集上预训练并适应多种任务，为聚合物性质预测和逆向设计提供了重用化学知识的途径。实现这一机会需要将学习到的表征与材料连接起来，这些材料的性质还依赖于分子群体、配方、加工和测量条件。本文回顾了聚合物基础模型的进展，以及支持其在材料设计中应用的数据、表征和实验工作流程。我们围绕聚合物材料状态进行组织，该描述将化学身份与分子分布、结构、形态和与目标性质相关的制备历史联系起来。我们比较了学习目标和适应方法，考察了聚合物化学和状态的表征，并跟踪从候选生成到合成、加工和验证的逆向设计。预训练模型现在支持跨多个性质的预测和针对特定目标的生成，部分聚合物候选材料已达到合成和热特性表征。

items.title: Design of High-Ionic-Conductivity Doped Li2ZrO3 Cathode Coating with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
items.abstract: Li2ZrO3 (LZO) is a promising cathode coating material for all-solid-state batteries, but its intrinsically low ionic conductivity limits rate performance. Here, we investigate the effects of Y3+, Al3+, Nb5+, and Ta5+ doping and amorphization on the Li+ conductivity of LZO using density functional theory (DFT) and machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Among the dopants studied, Y3+ substitution exhibits the most favorable defect formation energies. Molecular dynamics simulations using a fine-tuned moment tensor potential (MTP) reveal that 6%-Y-doped crystalline LZO (c-LYZO) achieves a maximum room-temperature ionic conductivity of ∼2mS cm−1, an order of magnitude improvement over undoped LZO. Amorphization was also found to enhance the conductivity of undoped LZO but the effect is attenuated in doped LZO. We show that amorphous LYZO exhibits more spatially fragmented, trapping-dominated Li transport than its crystalline counterpart. These results identify Y-doped LZO as a potential high-conductivity cathode coating and provide a design framework that balances dopant chemistry, defect type, doping concentration, and structural order.
items.authors: Ting Wang, Zihan Yu, Shyue Ping Ong

items.title: Simultaneous quantification and natural abundance δ15N analysis of protein-bound amino acids in human lung tissue by GC-C-IRMS
items.abstract: Compound specific isotope analysis in natural abundance provides a tracer free approach to investigate metabolism, but its application to amino acids in complex human tissues remains limited by derivatization requirements and the need for high precision isotope ratio measurements. Here, we developed and validated a Gas Chromatography–Combustion–Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometry (GC-C-IRMS) method using methyl ester–pentafluoropropionyl (Me-PFP) derivatization for simultaneous quantification and δ15N analysis of protein-bound amino acids in human lung tissues. The method provided 12 measurable chromatographic signals corresponding to 13 amino acids, with satisfactory isotopic precision from standards to biological matrices, and derivative stability for 22 days in standards and for approximately 28 days in lung cancer tissue sample at −20 °C. Application to 12 paired tumor and adjacent non-tumor samples showed negative median tumor–adjacent δ15N shifts for glycine and hydroxyproline. Exploratory histology stratified analysis further suggested opposite δ15N shifts for alanine and tyrosine between adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma. These results demonstrate the suitability of a Me-PFP GC-C-IRMS workflow for combined quantitative and natural abundance nitrogen isotopic profiling of amino acids in human lung tissues.
items.authors: Fatmeh Al Rahal, Anthony Anchisi, Youssef Bakkour, Illa Tea, Illa TEA

items.title: Green synthesis of SnO2 nanoparticles using Brassica oleracea leaf extract for dual-functional photocatalytic degradation of Malachite Green and adsorptive removal of Pb(II) and Cr(VI)
items.abstract: Green-synthesized SnO2 nanoparticles using Brassica oleracea leaf extract (BO-SnO2 NPs) were prepared and evaluated for photocatalytic dye degradation and heavy metal adsorption. The biosynthesized BO-SnO2 NPs were characterized by UV-Vis, FTIR (Sn-O-Sn at 583 cm-1), XRD, FESEM, and EDX analyses. XRD analysis revealed a tetragonal rutile crystalline structure with an average crystallite size of 5.32 nm. FESEM showed spherical particles with a mean size of ∼22.65 nm, indicating that the observed particles are agglomerates of several individual crystallites. In photocatalytic experiments, BO-SnO2 NPs achieved a maximum degradation of 95.00% for Malachite Green dye under UV irradiation within 120 min. Batch adsorption studies for Pb(II) and Cr(VI) showed maximum removal of 65.0% at pH 6.0 and 61.5% at pH 2.0 within 60 min, respectively. The equilibrium adsorption capacity increased from 2.60 to 15.60 mg/g for Pb(II) and from 2.46 to 14.70 mg/g for Cr(VI) as the initial concentration increased from 2 to 16 mg/L. The equilibrium data fitted well to both Langmuir and Freundlich isotherm models with R2 ≥ 0.99, with maximum adsorption capacities of 29.41 mg/g for Pb(II) and 28.65 mg/g for Cr(VI) (Langmuir). The RL values ranging from 0.317 to 0.804 and 1/n values of 0.723 and 0.740 confirmed favorable adsorption. The results suggest that BO-SnO2 NPs are a promising eco-friendly material for wastewater treatment.
items.authors: M. Bakhtiar Habib Nahin, M Kamrul Hossain, M Ashiqur R Khan, Faisal Islam Chowdhury

items.title: Analytic Energy Gradients for Unrestricted Mixed-Reference Spin-Flip Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory
items.abstract: Analytic nuclear gradients for individual low-lying singlet and triplet states within mixed-reference spin-flip time-dependent density functional theory (MRSF-TDDFT) based on an unrestricted Kohn–Sham (UKS) reference (UMRSF-TDDFT) were derived and implemented. The mixed-reference response restores the missing spin-complementary configurations and substantially attenuates the effects of the unequal UKS α/β orbitals. Relative to the restricted-open-shell (RO)-MRSF gradient, the major change is that the UKS reference supplies independently optimized α and β spatial-orbital sets. Corresponding orbitals in these generally unequal sets must first be paired by an orbital alignment. Differentiation of this additional alignment generates two contributions absent from RO-MRSF: spin-resolved alignmentinduced orbital-gradient terms ∆G f ,σ align in the orbital gradient and an explicit overlap contribution −Tr(W alignSξ ). The aligned response is also nonstationary to relevant occupied–occupied (α) and virtual–virtual (β ) rotations, requiring an independent-spin, full-block Z-vector. When the SOMOs are exactly degenerate, we select the minimum-norm solution of the response equation, which leaves the gradient unchanged. Compared with the RO-MRSF gradient, the formal scaling is unchanged, but the independent α/β response approximately doubles the principal coupled Z-vector dimension. Despite substantial differences between UKS and restricted-open-shell Kohn–Sham (ROKS) frontier orbitals, the UMRSF and RO-MRSF structures and potential-energy surfaces show close agreement.
items.authors: Vladimir Makhnev, Konstantin Komarov, Hiroya Nakata, Seunghoon Lee, Cheol Ho Choi

items.title: Modulating Phoretic Interactions through Molecular Recognition
items.abstract: Molecular recognition allows living systems to convert chemical information into physical behavior. Synthetic active matter lacks an analogous mechanism by which chemical information modulates phoretic interactions, which are determined instead by physicochemical properties. Here, we harness host-guest chemistry within coordination cages to enable the transduction of molecular recognition into non-equilibrium responses. We employ guest molecules as chemical signals which tune a tracer’s zeta potential upon binding within cages adsorbed to the particle interface. Phoretic mobility of these tracers is controlled via ionic diffusiophoresis. Experiments across multiple guests reveal a direct relationship between binding affinity, surface potential, and interaction sign, i.e. convergence toward or divergence away from the center of a gradient. We also present a predictive theoretical framework that quantitatively maps guest properties onto the sign and magnitude of phoretic interactions. These results establish molecular recognition as a chemical code for modulating interactions in active matter.
items.authors: Salah Eddine Ghellab, Valiyakath Abdul Rinshad, Aaranda Arooj, Xuemao Zhou, Angela Beth Grommet

items.title: Accelerating the Design of New Natural Deep Eutectic Solvents with Supervised Variational Autoencoders
items.abstract: The rational design of natural deep eutectic solvents (NaDESs) is hindered by the vast combinatorial space arising from the possible combinations of hydrogen bond donors and acceptors. This enormous design space limits the systematic experimental exploration of their physicochemical properties. In this work, we propose a supervised variational autoencoder (SVAE) framework to efficiently explore this chemical space by coupling generative modeling with property prediction. The model is trained on a curated dataset of deep eutectic solvents to learn simultaneously the latent structural representations and correlations with target properties, including melting point, density, and viscosity. The SVAE generates virtual NaDES candidates characterized by molecular descriptors, component ratios, and target property values. To associate these virtual candidates with real molecules, a descriptor matching strategy is applied using the COCONUT natural product database. The resulting NaDES candidates are subsequently validated using predictive models trained on experimental DES data. The results show strong agreement between the SVAE-generated target property values and the corresponding predictions of the regression models (R2 = 0.89, RMSE=21.7 K for melting point; R2 = 0.91, RMSE = 0.04 g·cm-3 for density; and R2 = 0.89, RMSE=0.47 cP for ln(viscosity)). This workflow demonstrates how guided generative models can be combined with machine learning models to accelerate the discovery of sustainable solvents. Beyond NaDESs, the proposed strategy provides a general and transferable framework for the rational design of other chemical systems, where combinatorial complexity limits conventional experimental approaches.
items.authors: Rachid Laref, Mehdi Oubahmane, Najwa Harrati, Nicolas Rolland, Véronique Nardello-Rataj, Adlane Sayede

items.title: Direct Observation of Ligand Exchange Dynamics on Atomically Precise Gold Clusters
items.abstract: Ligand exchange reactions provide a route to modify the monolayers of atomically precise gold clusters, but the structural dynamics of the process remain poorly understood. In this work, we use collision-initiated direct dynamics driven by a semiempirical electronic-structure method to study ligand exchange on Au38(PET)24, where PET denotes 2-phenylethanethiolate. The incoming ligands are thiophenol and two para-substituted derivatives, each considered in both its thiol and thiophenolate forms. The trajectories resolve the proposed associative mechanism as a sequence of ligand addition and elimination, followed by substantial restructuring of the core-monolayer interface and incorporation of the incoming ligand into the monolayer. The displaced PET ligand remains associated with the cluster, making desorption a distinct subsequent step required to form fully separated products. Comparisons among the incoming ligands show that both protonation state and para substitution influence how far the trajectories progress. These simulations provide a direct atomistic view of ligand exchange and show that the process involves extensive reorganization of the cluster–monolayer interface.
items.authors: Jesse Delmage, Irina Paci

items.title: Computer Learning Can Streamline Development of Lipid Nanoparticle Vaccine Delivery Constructs
items.abstract: Lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery constructs provide a precise and targeted therapeutic platform for nucleic-acid and subunit vaccines. By shielding fragile antigens and genetic cargo from premature degradation, these constructs help vaccines overcome the physiological barriers that separate an injection site from its intracellular target, increasing specificity, potency, and the precision of controlled release. This capability has broadened the range of immunomodulatory targets in the fight against infectious disease and has opened the door to vaccines that treat tumors and cancer. Increasingly, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are being applied to predict the LNP formulations that maximize mRNA-vaccine efficacy, and the same computational strategies are now being extended across diverse vaccine modalities. By approximating in vivo pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, in silico methods promote rational, data-driven design that is reshaping the drug-development pipeline. In this Review we summarize current literature on the optimization of LNP delivery constructs for vaccine therapeutics using ML, survey the rapid clinical translation of LNP-mRNA technology since 2021, and discuss the limitations and predictive capabilities of computer-simulated experimental models.
items.authors: Eric H. Rosenn, Max Engel, Violet Munarova, Maya Lipshitz, Nata Edell, Dania Halperin

items.title: Suberin-Cutin inspired copolyester films as bio-based packaging materials
items.abstract: Fossil-based plastics are widely used in packaging because of their low cost, processability, and exceptional barrier performance. However, their nonrenewable origin, short lifespan, and resistance to degradation in the environment present major challenges. Suberin and cutin are two types of biopolyesters found in plants, which can be used as renewable feedstock for the synthesis of bio-based plastics. Here, we extracted suberin monomers from birch bark and combined them with two building-blocks monomers found in cutin; a long chain ω-hydroxy fatty acid and a diacid, to produce cross-linked semi crystalline polyester films by melt polycondensation and thermoforming. Increasing the cutin monomer content promoted crystallization and increased the films’ stiffness and strength. Additionally, it reduced water vapor transmission rates and oxygen permeability, reaching properties comparable to short chain polyesters such as polylactide and poly ε-caprolactone. All films blocked the UV radiation below 400 nm. The resulting properties highlight suberin/cutin-based plastics as a potential future green packaging material.
items.authors: Zahra Maghazeh, Raffaele Perrotta, Katarina Jonasson, Martin Gunnarsson, Hanna Eliasson, Christian Möller

items.title: Hypervelocity impact mass spectrometry enables membrane phospholipid detection in ocean-world plumes
items.abstract: Saturn's ocean moon Enceladus and Jupiter's moon Europa expel subsurface material into space, enabling direct sampling of potentially habitable ocean environments without landing on their surfaces. Previous spacecraft analyses of plume ice grains revealed salts, simple organic compounds, and degraded macromolecular material, but no unambiguous molecular biosignatures. A fundamental question is whether diagnostic components of living cells can survive hypervelocity impact ionization during spacecraft flyby sampling. Here, we demonstrate that phospholipid membranes produce distinct and diagnostic negative-ion signatures following hypervelocity impacts of nanometer-sized ice particles at velocities up to 3.7 km s⁻¹. Using artificial vesicles composed of the phospholipid 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (POPC), we obtained single-particle time-of-flight mass spectra containing characteristic phosphate-derived and fatty-acid fragment ions together with higher-mass species. Assignments were supported by collision-induced dissociation measurements using high-resolution Orbitrap mass spectrometry. The persistence of these membrane-specific anions demonstrates that hypervelocity impact ionization preserves molecular signatures diagnostic of phospholipid bilayers, identifying cell membranes or their components as a detectable class of biosignatures for plume-sampling missions. Our results provide an experimental framework for interpreting complex negative-ion spectra from future ocean-world missions, including Europa Clipper and proposed Enceladus missions, and highlight the scientific value of high-resolution negative-ion impact mass spectrometry for the search for extraterrestrial life.
items.authors: Anatolii Spesyvyi, Chen Wang, Ales Charvat, Heber Octavio Barragán Mayet, Marek Cebecauer, Agnieszka Olżyńska

items.title: A Non-Nuclear Attractor-Mediated 𝟑𝒄–𝟐𝒆 𝝈-Aromatic Core in Triberyllium Hexaoxide
items.abstract: Low-valent main-group clusters that activate small molecules represent an intriguing frontier in modern coordination and cluster chemistry. Herein, the structural topology, correlated electronic structure, excited states, and real-space chemical bonding of the cyclic triberyllium hexaoxide complex Be3(O2)3 are investigated using meta-GGA density functional theory (TPSS), domain-based local pair natural orbital coupled-cluster theory [DLPNO-CCSD(T)], local energy decomposition (LED), similarity transformed equation-of-motion coupled-cluster theory (STEOM-DLPNO-CCSD), and the Quantum Theory of Atoms in Molecules (QTAIM). The cluster features an equilateral triangular Be3 core (d(Be–Be) = 2.103–2.105 Å) coordinated radially to three end-on dioxygen units (d(O–O) = 1.297 Å). High-level DLPNO-CCSD(T)/def2-TZVP benchmarks establish a correlation energy of −1.751222 Eh and a total electronic energy of −494.527653 Eh. Extended transition state natural orbitals for chemical valence (ETS-NOCV) analysis reveals that core-to-ligand assembly is driven by strong orbital stabilization (ΔEorb = −503.51 kcal/mol) overcoming Pauli steric repulsion (ΔEPauli = +767.52 kcal/mol), mediated by dative charge flow into the dioxygen π* manifold. Topological gradient vector field analysis demonstrates that the Be3 ring lacks classical pairwise Be–Be bond critical points; instead, gradient trajectories converge into a central Non-Nuclear Attractor (NNA) at the ring centroid. Real-space electron localization function (ELF), localized orbital locator (LOL), source function integrations, and delocalization indices (Σ δ(Be, Bq) = 0.971 e) confirm that the Be3 core is sustained by a central three-center two-electron (3c–2e) σaromatic bond.
items.authors: D K Jha, M Pathak

items.title: Azopyrazole boronic ester crosslinks with long thermal half-lives for phototunable viscoelastic hydrogels
items.abstract: Covalent adaptable networks (CANs) based on boronic acid–ester exchange undergo rapid network reconfiguration in ambient conditions, making them useful materials for biomedical applications. The combination of photoswitches and dynamic bonds imparts reversible spatiotemporal control over mechanical properties for smart and responsive materials. Here, we report azopyrazole boronic acids that undergo rapid photoisomerization to their metastable Z isomers, which have extremely long thermal half-lives (over a year at 25 °C) and a 3-fold enhancement in binding affinity for diols compared to the E isomer. When incorporated into hydrogels, these photoswitchable dynamic bonds enable reversible changes in stiffness and stress relaxation time with at least 6 cycles of visible and UV light. Despite only containing dynamic crosslinks, these hydrogels are comparable in stiffness to our previously reported hybrid materials containing dynamic azobenzene boronic ester and static bis(acrylamide) crosslinks. This work demonstrates an alternative strategy to tuning boronic acid-ester equilibria with light while maintaining strong binding in both isomers.
items.authors: Mara L. Paterson, Tomas Castillo, Sarah Lin, Julia A. Kalow

items.title: Orange hydrogen production with fayalite slag: identifying reaction bottlenecks
items.abstract: Orange hydrogen (H2) is generated through stimulated water–rock reactions, analogous to natural hydrogen formation via serpentinization, and offers a potential pathway for clean H2 production from Fe(II)-bearing minerals and mineral side streams. Here, we investigate orange H2 production based on fayalite slag, an Fe(II)-rich metallurgical waste that has not previously been studied for this purpose. H2 generation from fayalite slag was evaluated in a stirred hydrothermal reactor pressurized with Ar and experiments were carried out at initial pressures of 5, 50, and 100 bar and temperatures of 160 and 230 °C. The highest H2 production was observed at 230 °C and an initial pressure of 5 bar in 1 M KOH (pH 14) after 48 h, reaching 0.45 g H2 kg-1 fayalite slag, corresponding to ⁓7.2% of the theoretical maximum H2 yield. During the reaction, the fayalite content decreased, while magnetite and a K-bearing mica phase formed as secondary products. These secondary phases may have limited further reaction by reducing water access to Fe(II)-bearing regions. This is evidenced by the fact that H2 generation plateaued after 48 h of reaction time. Overall, the results show that fayalite slag is a potential feedstock for orange H2 production under comparatively mild hydrothermal conditions, while also indicating that secondary phase formation and surface passivation are important reaction bottlenecks.
items.authors: Somayeh Karandish Marvasti, Rossella Greco, Juho Yliniemi, Tero Luukkonen

items.title: A Reported Featurizer Ranking Instability Is Noise Between Inseparable Arms
items.abstract: Representation comparisons are commonly published from one split at one seed on uncurated public sets. Repeating one, the count of endpoints whose best featurizer changes with the split read three, one, one and three under two choices, seeds and deduplication, and every reorder lay between arms whose intervals overlap. Only the fingerprint baseline separated anywhere, by being worse; duplicates placed up to 3.8% of random-split test rows in training. A four-step remedy is given.
items.authors: Phani Kumar Balagam

items.title: Transport and mechanical properties of pseudo-zwitterionic polymer electrolytes from non-equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations
items.abstract: Pseudo-zwitterionic polymer electrolytes (PZPEs) are promising multifunctional copolymers for solid-state batteries, where efficient ion transport must be balanced against mechanical robustness. Here, we used non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to determine how polymer composition, LiTFSI concentration, and copolymer sequence govern coupled transport and mechanical properties in MIL:PEGMbased PZPEs. A calibrated field-driven NEMD protocol enables ionic conductivity to be obtained within a few nanoseconds while preserving the equilibrium salt-concentration dependence. It is found that Li+ self-diffusion decreases with increasing salt concentration in PEGM-rich systems but can increase in MIL-rich systems, accompanied by a shift toward TFSI− rich coordination. Onsager analysis further shows that cation–anion correlations strongly influence electrophoretic mobility. The resulting conductivity–modulus maps reveal a clear trade-off: PEGM-rich systems are more conductive but softer, whereas MIL-rich systems are stiffer but less conductive. NEMD simulations suggest that salt concentration and copolymer sequence provide additional handles for tuning this balance.
items.authors: Jichen Li, Gabriele Lingua, Movaffaq Kateb, Kristina Edström, Nerea Casado, Daniel Brandell

items.title: Fully Reversible High-Capacity Ammonia Storage in a Series of Phase-Transformable Molecular Nickel Thiocarboxylates
items.abstract: Ammonia (NH 3 ) is an indispensable chemical commodity in modern society, but its nature as a toxic and corrosive gas makes its storage and transport difficult. Here, we report non-porous molecular nickel thiobenzoate [Ni 2 (PhCOS) 4 ] and derivatives, as a distinct class of phase-transformable adsorbents for reversible and high-density ammonia storage in ambient conditions. Despite lacking intrinsic porosity, [Ni 2 (PhCOS) 4 ] presented excellent sorption capacity of 23.5 mmol/g (effective reversible capacity: 22.0 mmol/g) at 298 K and 1 bar. The multi-sigmoidal adsorption profile, arising from solid-state chemical transformation into well-defined compounds of formulas {Ni 2 (PhCOS) 4 (NH 3 ) n } (n = 1, 8 and 16), provides a large pressure-swing working capacity (11.4 mmol/g between 0.1 and 1.0 bar) and enables complete, energy-efficient regeneration under remarkably mild conditions (60–80 °C). The transformation was associated with drastic changes in the coordination environment of Ni centers yet was fast and fully reversible. Phase transformation-induced self-fragmentation generates hierarchical diffusion pathways, driving rapid kinetics (50% uptake in 95 s). Furthermore, the complex demonstrates outstanding ambient moisture tolerance, 10-cycle durability, scalable one-pot synthesis exceeding 60 g (81% yield), and practical cartridge-level storage (+36wt% mass increase), demonstrating dynamic molecular complexes as a practical platform for gas management.
items.authors: Benjamin Le Ouay, Yume Matsumoto, Ao Zhang, Manami Ueno, Ryo Ohtani, Masaaki Ohba

items.title: Atomic Environment Aware Lennard-Jones Parameterization for Electrostatic Embedding ML/MM Simulations
items.abstract: Hybrid machine learning/molecular mechanics (ML/MM) methods have emerged as a powerful approach to multiscale modelling. Recent advances have focused on electrostatic embedding schemes, in which atoms in the ML region are polarized by the surrounding MM environment. Consequently, ML/MM electrostatics have been the subject of extensive study, whereas dispersion and close-range repulsive interactions remain comparatively underexplored. In analogy to established QM/MM practice, exchange-repulsion and dispersion interactions are commonly described using Lennard-Jones (LJ) 12-6 potentials with parameters transferred from existing force field libraries. However, such transferable parameters may be suboptimal for ML/MM interfaces, where consistency with the electrostatic embedding model is desirable. Here, we develop methodologies for deriving dynamic LJ parameters based on the exchange-hole dipole moment (XDM) model and the Fedorov polarizability scaling relation. Moreover, we propose a one-shot procedure for fine-tuning LJ parameters to experimental free energies. Focusing on the electrostatic machine learning embedding (EMLE) scheme, we show that these approaches yield EMLE models with competitive accuracy relative to conventional force fields and mechanical embedding schemes, while additionally providing chemically environment-aware LJ parameters. This capability offers a route to improved accuracy in demanding applications such as reactive modelling, where dispersion coefficients may depend strongly on the local chemical environment.
items.authors: João Morado, Kirill Zinovjev, Lester O. Hedges, Julien Michel, Daniel J. Cole

items.title: Atomic Chalcogen Substitution Modulates Photophysical Properties and Electronic Structure in Donor–Acceptor Covalent Organic Frameworks
items.abstract: While chalcogen substitution has recently emerged as a means for tuning the properties of covalent organic frameworks (COFs), its influence on the intrinsic photophysical and charge-transport properties of isoreticular donor–acceptor COFs remains largely unknown. Here, an isoreticular series of novel donor–acceptor COFs was constructed from a tetrathienonaphthalene-based (TTNTA) node and linear donor–acceptor–donor linkers containing oxygen (O), sulfur (S), or selenium (Se) within their acceptor cores. Highly crystalline COFs with identical topology and comparable structural order were obtained, while the synthesis of preferentially oriented thin films enabled direct comparison of chalcogen-dependent optoelectronic properties. Time-resolved photoluminescence measurements revealed progressively shorter emissive-state lifetimes from the O- to the S- and Se-containing COFs. Optical-pump terahertz-probe spectroscopy showed a parallel decrease in effective charge-carrier mobility across the same series, with the O-containing COF exhibiting the highest value of 0.19 ±0.02 cm 2 V −1 s −1 . Density functional theory (DFT) and time-dependent DFT calculations further revealed that valence-band dispersion originates from coupling between TTNTA- and linker-derived states and that the low-energy absorption involves linker-centered mixed excitations with progressively decreasing oscillator strength from O to Se. Collectively, these findings establish systematic structure–property relationships between acceptor-core chalcogen substitution and the photophysical and electronic properties of donor–acceptor COFs, providing mechanistic insights into their composition-dependent behavior and guidance for the design of future COF-based semiconductors.
items.authors: Tianhao Xue, Laura Fuchs, Bembe C. Mackintosh, Mariia Ferree, Roman Guntermann, Shuo Sun

items.title: Influence of Electrode Potential on Biased Reaction Sampling: NVT, NVTΦ or µVT?
items.abstract: Incorporating applied electrode potential into density functional theory molecular dynamics simulations of solid-liquid interfaces has developed remarkably in recent years. Current approaches based on constant-charge or constant-potential schemes remain limited in their ability to accurately describe the physical electrode-electrolyte interface, as they can create artificial effects, such as inducing a dipole, shifting the target potential of the simulation, or requiring instantaneous relaxation of the interface. In this work, the effect of applying the fluctuation-dissipation theorem to the applied potential on reaction barriers in ab initio slow-growth molecular dynamics simulations is investigated. Three simulation schemes are compared: the NVT ensemble (constant charge), the µVT ensemble (constant potential), and NVTΦ, realized through FLEX++, a Python wrapper for VASPsol++ that controls the number of electrons at each simulation step according to the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. The reaction barrier of the Volmer step of the HER on Au(110)/water and Cu metal leaching from a CuN4HC single-atom catalyst during CO2RR are calculated as test cases. For the Volmer step, the reaction barrier increases with the applied potential for all ensembles, but each simulation repetition yields a considerably different barrier for the NVT and µVT ensembles, whereas NVTΦ yields a more consistent estimate. The reason is that FLEX++ maintains the electrode potential more consistently along the reaction coordinate, while letting the electrode potential vary to accommodate the reaction event. These differences in barrier height between the repetitions originate from the covalent bonds and H-bond network around the O donating the H in the Volmer step. For Cu metal leaching, NVTΦ shows an increased barrier of 0.1 eV, on average, over standard NVT. This decreased NVT barrier is rationalized by a lack of charge fluctuations that would otherwise destabilize the solvated leaching metal complex, if present.
items.authors: Renata Sechi, Ronan Gleeson, Arghya Bhowmik, Heine Anton Hansen

items.title: Accessing an Extreme Steric Regime of C–O Atropisomerism through Overcrowded Iodane-Mediated Rearrangement
items.abstract: C–O atropisomerism in aryl ethers is intrinsically difficult to stabilize because oxygen provides limited steric leverage and the two C–O bonds may undergo concerted rotation (gearing). Here, we report that the reaction of an overcrowded (diacetoxyiodo)arene with cyclic 1,3-diketones generates aryliodonium ylides that undergo spontaneous rearrangement to furnish highly congested atropisomeric aryl vinyl ethers. These compounds occupy a previously unexplored steric regime of C–O atropisomerism and display configurational stability that strongly depends on the cyclic 1,3-diketone framework. Whereas the cyclopentane-1,3-dione derivative exhibits an enantiomerization barrier of 32.9 kcal mol–1, the corresponding cyclohexane-1,3-dione and dimedone derivatives reach barriers approaching 40 kcal mol–1. The alkenyl C–I bond serves as both a major contributor to atropostability and a synthetic handle for systematic modulation of the enantiomerization barrier through deiodination and cross-coupling. Computational studies revealed a striking energetic separation between gearing and enantiomerization. Even in this extreme steric regime, gearing remains accessible with barriers of ~15 kcal mol–1 and is only weakly affected by the iodine substituent, whereas enantiomerization requires substantially higher-energy rotational pathways. These findings provide a mechanistic picture of molecular motion under extreme steric constraints and establish overcrowded iodanemediated rearrangement as a route to previously inaccessible C–O atropisomeric architectures.
items.authors: Bin Li, Jun Kikuchi, Arimasa Matsumoto, Naohiko Yoshikai

items.title: GXNU MolStudio: An Integrated Open-Source Platform for Molecular Visualization and Quantum Chemical Analysis
items.abstract: We report GXNU MolStudio, an open-source, bilingual (Chinese/English) desktop application that integrates real-time molecular visualization with a broad suite of quantum chemical analyses in a single interactive environment. MolStudio embeds a purpose-built OpenGL 3.3 renderer that presents molecules, orbitals, and property-colored isosurfaces in a publication-ready style, and couples it to scripted invocations of the external wavefunction analysis program Multiwfn. The current version provides 14 panels (11 analysis panels plus 3 workflow panels) covering: orbital browsing and isosurface generation (including spin-density visualization for open-shell systems); six atomic charge schemes (ADCH, Hirshfeld, Mulliken, CM5, SCPA, and VDD); Mayer bond orders; NBO donor–acceptor (E(2)) analysis; electrostatic potential (ESP) surfaces with extrema and surface-area distributions; IGMH/IRI weak-interaction analysis; QTAIM topology; ETS-NOCV energy decomposition; molecular planarity parameters (MPP); IRC energy/bond-order profiles; distortion–interaction (DI) decomposition; the energetic span model (ESM); and activation strain scans along the IRC (ASM), multi-CUB overlay, and IRC splitting. All panels share one canvas and one atomic-picking protocol, so that results from different analyses can be compared immediately on the same structure. A retained VMD/Tachyon channel delivers ray-traced journal-quality figures in more than 30 curated styles. MolStudio is distributed as Python source (PyQt5, Python ≥ 3.8) and as a standalone Windows executable, under the GNU General Public License, version 3 (GPLv3only). Its rendering pipeline is a Python port of the GPLv3-licensed IboView engine — a derivative relationship that is declared explicitly in Section 7 and itemized in the code repository — and all third-party components are credited. The software is freely available at https://cnb.cool/chem311/GXNU-MolStudio.
items.authors: Cheng Hou

items.title: Solid-Phase Standard Enthalpies of Formation from SMILES with a Calibrated Per-Molecule Uncertainty: Application to a 13 606-Compound CHONFCl Inventory
items.abstract: The standard enthalpy of formation of a solid, ∆fH ◦(s, 298 K), governs the detonation performance and the thermal hazard of an energetic material, yet it is measured for only a few hundred compounds, and 30 % of the compounds measured more than once carry determinations that disagree by more than 20 kJ mol−1. I report a route from a SMILES string to ∆fH ◦(s, 298 K) that returns, together with the value, a molecule-specific standard deviation calibrated against experiment. The gas-phase enthalpy is obtained from the ANI-2x neural network potential evaluated on a connectivity-based hierarchy (CBH-2, with CBH-1 fallback) isodesmic balance in which the nitro group is treated as a single pseudo-atom, without which the balance cannot be closed on a charge-separated nitrogen; a rigid-rotor harmonic-oscillator correction supplies the thermal terms. The sublimation enthalpy is a 32-descriptor additive model fitted to 229 measurements harvested from the NIST Chemistry WebBook. Two systematic shifts that survive leave-one-out validation are removed. The uncertainty is a heteroscedastic Gaussian variance model. The whole chain is validated by a nested leave-one-out procedure in which the sublimation model, the acceptance threshold, the systematic shifts and the variance model are all re-estimated without the compound they predict, and that compound’s own gas-phase reference is withheld: over 281 compounds the mean absolute error is 26.1 kJ mol−1, the mean |z| is 0.80 against 0.80 expected for a well-calibrated Gaussian, and the coverage is 71.2 % at one standard deviation and 93.6 % at two, against 68.3 % and 95.4 % expected. For scale, independent experimental determinations of the same solid deviate from their own median by 7.6 kJ mol−1 on average, so two determinations of one compound typically differ by about twice that. The procedure was applied to an inventory of 13 606 CHONFCl compounds; 13 267 (97.5 %) were predicted in 314 core-hours on a single desktop machine, the remainder being open-shell radicals outside the domain of ANI-2x. I state explicitly, and quantify, the size beyond which the uncertainty model itself extrapolates.
items.authors: Luc E. Brunet

items.title: High-Field Spin Dynamics of Photoexcited Pentacene at 9.2 T by Time-Resolved Pulsed EPR and Vector DC Magnetic-Field Sensing
items.abstract: Photoexcited triplet spin states of pentacene molecules are promising for dynamic nuclear polarization (DNP) and quantum sensing, yet their spin properties at high magnetic fields remain largely unexplored. Here, we study the high field spin dynamics of the photoexcited pentacene using highfrequency time-resolved pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) at 260 GHz (∼ 9.2 T). Using pulsed EPR synchronized with optical excitation, we determine triplet sublevel populations, decay rates, spin relaxations, and the g-tensor. The transient triplet remains a strongly non-Boltzmann sublevel population, with a dominant |TX⟩ population of 0.86 ± 0.05, while the triplet lifetimes, spin-lattice relaxation, and coherence remain favorable for triplet-DNP and quantum sensing applications. We further develop a vector DC magnetic-field sensing protocol that combines the transition resonances of the two crystallographically inequivalent pentacene sites with orientation-dependent triplet decay to determine the field magnitude and orientation. These results establish the high-field spin properties of photoexcited pentacene and provide a foundation for its triplet-DNP and quantum sensing at high magnetic fields.
items.authors: Duhan Zhang, Zeyu Wang, Johan van Tol, Yifan Quan

items.title: AI-Driven Optimization of Electrochemical Fertilizer Processes
items.abstract: Conventional fertilizer production relies on centralized, fossil-fuel-intensive processes such as Haber–Bosch ammonia synthesis, with high energy demand and associated carbon emissions. Electrochemical routes to nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizers offer a potentially decentralized, renewable-powered alternative, but their practical performance remains limited by the interaction of catalyst structure, electrolyte composition, reactor architecture, and operating conditions. These variables do not act independently: fertilizer synthesis is fundamentally a coupled, high-dimensional optimization problem that is difficult to address by varying one factor at a time. This chapter argues that artificial intelligence becomes genuinely useful for this problem not as an isolated computational tool, but as a layer connecting experimental and sensor data with prediction, optimization, and control. The chapter examines four electrochemical fertilizer pathways nitrogen reduction, nitrate reduction, urea synthesis, and phosphorus recovery alongside the functional materials and electrode architectures used to catalyze them. It then considers the reactors, analytical instrumentation, and real-time, in-situ sensors that generate the data on which these AI applications depend, treating this measurement infrastructure as inseparable from AI-enabled optimization. Three distinct roles for AI and machine learning are developed: discovering and screening catalyst candidates across combinatorial design spaces; predicting process behavior under coupled and time-varying operating conditions; and identifying and maintaining optimal conditions through Bayesian optimization, multi-objective search, and autonomous control. Techno-economic and life-cycle assessment are introduced as additional decision criteria, since chemical performance alone cannot define an optimal process once cost and environmental impact are considered. A fully integrated, autonomous electrochemical fertilizer platform has not yet been demonstrated in the literature reviewed here. Instead, the chapter shows that individual components of such a system, together with several partial integrations from adjacent process industries, already exist and provide a technically credible foundation for future integration. Data scarcity, the DFT–experiment gap, sensor reliability, reproducibility, interpretability, and scale-up nevertheless remain major barriers to realizing this integration in practice.
items.authors: Muhammad Bilal

items.title: Data-driven models for performance prediction in a microalgae-based wastewater treatment process
items.abstract: Microalgae-based wastewater treatment has the potential to advance tertiary phosphorus recovery while producing biomass for resource valorization. The development of reliable near-term prediction models can help reduce system upsets, support proactive process control, and optimize resource utilization. In this study, Light Gradient-Boosting Machine (LGBM), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models were comparatively evaluated for predicting effluent ammonium, nitrate, and orthophosphate concentrations and biomass dynamics in a full-scale (568 m 3 ·d -1 ) microalgal system using 25 months of operational and microalgal community structure data. LSTM consistently achieved the highest prediction accuracy while effectively capturing system upset events. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis provided interpretable insights into feature importance across both feature and temporal dimensions, with SHAP-guided feature reduction substantially reducing computational requirements without compromising predictive performance. Benchmarking against the mechanistic process model further identified the complementary application niches of mechanistic and data-driven approaches, providing practical guidance for model selection.
items.authors: Ga-Yeong Kim, JooMan Kim, Jeremy S. Guest

items.title: Mechanochemical Degradation of Activated Carbon-Adsorbed PFAS and Fluorinated Gases
items.abstract: Fluorochemicals are widely used in modern society due to their unique and valuable properties. From the perspective of sustainable fluorine resource utilization, technologies that enable the recovery and reuse of fluorine from waste or captured fluorochemicals are crucial. However, efficient strategies for recovering fluorine from these materials remain limited. Herein, we report a mechanochemical strategy for the direct conversion of activated carbon-adsorbed PFAS and fluorinated gases into potassium fluoride (KF), a valuable fluorination reagent, by ball milling with potassium metal. The process proceeds rapidly and efficiently under solvent-free conditions. The method is applicable to a variety of PFAS, including perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), perfluoroheptanoic acid (PFHpA), and perfluorobutanesulfonic acid (PFBS), as well as fluorinated gases such as SF6, HFC-125, and HFC-23. This work provides a sustainable strategy toward a fluoro-circular economy through the recovery of fluorine as a valuable chemical resource.
items.authors: Masashi Hattori, Kouki Nagano, Moe Fujishiro, Kanako Inoo, Yosuke Kishikawa, Zhengyu Zhao

items.title: Lighting the Way to Sustainability with Refractory Plasmonic Materials
items.abstract: The search for plasmonic materials that combine strong light-matter interactions with stability under demanding operating conditions has driven growing interest in transition metal nitrides and carbides. These refractory materials offer tunable optical properties, thermal and chemical stability, and diverse electronic structures that distinguish them from conventional noble-metal plasmonic materials. This Review examines the development of refractory plasmonic materials from their fundamental photophysical properties and synthesis to their use in water-energy systems, climate-resilient infrastructure, and solar-driven chemical transformations. Attention is given to how composition, stoichiometry, particle morphology, and surface chemistry influence localized surface plasmon resonance, hot-carrier dynamics, and photothermal conversion. We critically assess the sustainability of refractory plasmonics beyond noble-metal replacement, considering resource availability and criticality, synthesis and processing requirements, material complexity, and functional lifetime. Finally, we outline key challenges and emerging opportunities in positioning refractory plasmonic materials as the cornerstone of a sustainable economy.
items.authors: Vanshika Jain, Dreenan Shea, Blaine G. Fiss, Mita Dasog

items.title: Solid-state synthesis of high-purity mixed-chalcogenide perovskites
items.abstract: Recently, chalcogenide perovskites that are fully inorganic and composed of earth-abundant elements are emerging as non-toxic alternatives to established lead-halide perovskite materials. However, chalcogenide perovskite compositions relevant for optoelectronic applications such as solar cells remain largely unexplored due to the complex, high-temperature synthesis routes involved and difficulties in obtaining high purities. Here, we present a new solid-state synthesis route for facile fabrication of mixed-chalcogenide perovskite powders BaZr(S 1−x Se x ) 3 , where 0 ≤ x ≤ 0.3. We obtain high-purity chalcogenide perovskite powders at moderate temperatures (600 ◦ C) and short reaction times (24 hours). We demonstrate that precursor selection and chalcogen stoichiometry can effectively be used to control the perovskite composition. By increasing Se content (x), the band gaps of the mixed-chalcogenide perovskites can be controllably tuned from 1.83 to 1.58 eV, spanning the desired range for single-and multi-junction solar cells. Broadly, our findings establish a generalisable synthesis method for preparing several mixed-chalcogenide perovskite compositions, including BaZr(S 1−x Se x ) 3 and BaHf(S 1−x Se x ) 3 .
items.authors: Mo El Maoued, Benjamin M. Gallant, Matteo Paloni, Luis Simbari, Shams Elnawawi, Matteo Salvalaglio

items.title: Approaching Chemical Accuracy for Neutral and Ionic Water Clusters with the bn-r2SCAN Meta-GGA
items.abstract: Gas-phase neutral and ion–water clusters are fundamental models for hydrogen bonding, many-body interactions, proton transfer, and ionic hydration in liquid water and aqueous environments, and they are stringent tests for density functional approximations: semilocal functionals without exact exchange or an explicit self-interaction correction have typically described their interaction and binding energies poorly.
